```typescript
import { MapLocation } from '../types';

// Google Maps configuration
export const GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG = {
  apiKey: import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY || '',
  libraries: ['places', 'geometry'] as const,
  region: 'TW' as const,
  language: 'zh-TW' as const,
};

// NTU coordinates
export const NTU_COORDINATES: MapLocation = {
  lat: 25.0172,
  lng: 121.5395,
};

// Default map options
export const DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS = {
  zoom: 15,
  center: NTU_COORDINATES,
  mapTypeId: 'roadmap' as const,
  disableDefaultUI: false,
  zoomControl: true,
  mapTypeControl: true,
  scaleControl: true,
  streetViewControl: true,
  rotateControl: true,
  fullscreenControl: true,
};

// Map bounds for NTU area
export const NTU_BOUNDS = {
  north: 25.03,
  south: 25.00,
  east: 121.55,
  west: 121.52,
};

// Calculate distance between two points
export const calculateDistance = (
  lat1: number,
  lng1: number,
  lat2: number,
  lng2: number
): number => {
  const R = 6371; // Earth's radius in km
  const dLat = toRadians(lat2 - lat1);
  const dLng = toRadians(lng2 - lng1);
  
  const a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
            Math.cos(toRadians(lat1)) * Math.cos(toRadians(lat2)) *
            Math.sin(dLng / 2) * Math.sin(dLng / 2);
  
  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  return R * c;
};

// Convert degrees to radians
const toRadians = (degrees: number): number => {
  return degrees * (Math.PI / 180);
};

// Check if location is within NTU area
export const isWithinNTUArea = (
  lat: number,
  lng: number,
  radiusKm: number = 2
): boolean => {
  const distance = calculateDistance(lat, lng, NTU_COORDINATES.lat, NTU_COORDINATES.lng);
  return distance <= radiusKm;
};

// Get current user location
export const getCurrentLocation = (): Promise<MapLocation> => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      reject(new Error('Geolocation is not supported by this browser'));
      return;
    }

    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (position) => {
        const location: MapLocation = {
          lat: position.coords.latitude,
          lng: position.coords.longitude,
        };
        resolve(location);
      },
      (error) => {
        reject(error);
      },
      {
        enableHighAccuracy: true,
        timeout: 10000,
        maximumAge: 300000,
      }
    );
  });
};

// Format address for display
export const formatAddress = (address: string): string => {
  // Remove Taiwan country code if present
  return address.replace(/, Taiwan$/, '').replace(/, ROC$/, '');
};

// Get marker icon based on rating
export const getMarkerIcon = (rating?: number): string => {
  if (!rating) return '🔴'; // Default red marker
  
  if (rating >= 4.5) return '🟢'; // Green for excellent
  if (rating >= 3.5) return '🟡'; // Yellow for good
  if (rating >= 2.5) return '🟠'; // Orange for average
  return '🔴'; // Red for poor
};

// Get marker size based on rating
export const getMarkerSize = (rating?: number): { width: number; height: number } => {
  if (!rating) return { width: 30, height: 30 };
  
  if (rating >= 4.5) return { width: 35, height: 35 }; // Larger for excellent
  if (rating >= 3.5) return { width: 32, height: 32 }; // Medium for good
  return { width: 30, height: 30 }; // Default size
};
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { GoogleMap, useJsApiLoader, Marker, InfoWindow } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { Box, Typography, CircularProgress } from '@mui/material';
import { GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG, DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS, NTU_COORDINATES } from '../../services/googleMaps';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../../services/api';
import RestroomMarker from './RestroomMarker';

interface MapViewProps {
  onRestroomSelect?: (restroom: Restroom) => void;
  selectedRestroom?: Restroom | null;
  filters?: any;
}

const MapView: React.FC<MapViewProps> = ({ 
  onRestroomSelect, 
  selectedRestroom, 
  filters 
}) => {
  const [restrooms, setRestrooms] = useState<Restroom[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mapCenter, setMapCenter] = useState(NTU_COORDINATES);
  const [mapZoom, setMapZoom] = useState(15);

  const { isLoaded, loadError } = useJsApiLoader({
    id: 'google-map-script',
    googleMapsApiKey: GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG.apiKey,
    libraries: GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG.libraries,
  });

  const fetchRestrooms = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.getAll(filters);
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestrooms(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restrooms');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restrooms');
      console.error('Error fetching restrooms:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoaded) {
      fetchRestrooms();
    }
  }, [isLoaded, fetchRestrooms]);

  const handleMarkerClick = (restroom: Restroom) => {
    if (onRestroomSelect) {
      onRestroomSelect(restroom);
    }
  };

  const handleMapClick = () => {
    if (onRestroomSelect) {
      onRestroomSelect(null);
    }
  };

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <Typography color="error">
          Error loading Google Maps. Please check your API key.
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
        <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>Loading map...</Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: '100%', height: '500px', position: 'relative' }}>
      <GoogleMap
        mapContainerStyle={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
        center={mapCenter}
        zoom={mapZoom}
        options={DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS}
        onClick={handleMapClick}
      >
        {restrooms.map((restroom) => (
          <RestroomMarker
            key={restroom.id}
            restroom={restroom}
            onClick={() => handleMarkerClick(restroom)}
            isSelected={selectedRestroom?.id === restroom.id}
          />
        ))}
      </GoogleMap>
      
      {loading && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
            boxShadow: 1,
          }}
        >
          <CircularProgress size={20} />
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            Loading restrooms...
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
      
      {error && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'error.light',
            color: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="caption">{error}</Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapView;
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Marker } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { InfoWindow } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { Box, Typography, Chip, Rating } from '@mui/material';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { getMarkerIcon, getMarkerSize } from '../../services/googleMaps';

interface RestroomMarkerProps {
  restroom: Restroom;
  onClick: () => void;
  isSelected?: boolean;
}

const RestroomMarker: React.FC<RestroomMarkerProps> = ({ 
  restroom, 
  onClick, 
  isSelected = false 
}) => {
  const [showInfoWindow, setShowInfoWindow] = useState(false);

  const handleMarkerClick = () => {
    setShowInfoWindow(true);
    onClick();
  };

  const handleInfoWindowClose = () => {
    setShowInfoWindow(false);
  };

  const markerIcon = getMarkerIcon(restroom.average_rating);
  const markerSize = getMarkerSize(restroom.average_rating);

  return (
    <>
      <Marker
        position={{ lat: restroom.latitude, lng: restroom.longitude }}
        onClick={handleMarkerClick}
        icon={{
          url: `data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,${encodeURIComponent(`
            <svg width="${markerSize.width}" height="${markerSize.height}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
              <path d="M12 2C8.13 2 5 5.13 5 9c0 5.25 7 13 7 13s7-7.75 7-13c0-3.87-3.13-7-7-7zm0 9.5c-1.38 0-2.5-1.12-2.5-2.5s1.12-2.5 2.5-2.5 2.5 1.12 2.5 2.5-1.12 2.5-2.5 2.5z" fill="#1976d2"/>
            </svg>
          `)}`,
          scaledSize: new google.maps.Size(markerSize.width, markerSize.height),
          anchor: new google.maps.Point(markerSize.width / 2, markerSize.height),
        }}
      />
      
      {showInfoWindow && (
        <InfoWindow
          position={{ lat: restroom.latitude, lng: restroom.longitude }}
          onCloseClick={handleInfoWindowClose}
        >
          <Box sx={{ p: 1, minWidth: 200 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
              {restroom.name}
            </Typography>
            
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              {restroom.address}
            </Typography>
            
            {restroom.average_rating && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', mb: 1 }}>
                <Rating 
                  value={restroom.average_rating} 
                  readOnly 
                  size="small"
                />
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
                  ({restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)})
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            )}
            
            {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5, mt: 1 }}>
                {restroom.tags.slice(0, 3).map((tag, index) => (
                  <Chip
                    key={index}
                    label={tag.tag_value}
                    size="small"
                    color="primary"
                    variant="outlined"
                  />
                ))}
                {restroom.tags.length > 3 && (
                  <Chip
                    label={`+${restroom.tags.length - 3}`}
                    size="small"
                    color="default"
                    variant="outlined"
                  />
                )}
              </Box>
            )}
            
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
              Click for details
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </InfoWindow>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default RestroomMarker;
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Paper,
  Typography,
  FormGroup,
  FormControlLabel,
  Checkbox,
  Slider,
  Button,
  Box,
  Chip,
  Select,
  MenuItem,
  FormControl,
  InputLabel,
} from '@mui/material';
import { RestroomFilters } from '../../types';

interface FilterPanelProps {
  filters: RestroomFilters;
  onFiltersChange: (filters: RestroomFilters) => void;
  onFindNearest: () => void;
}

const FilterPanel: React.FC<FilterPanelProps> = ({
  filters,
  onFiltersChange,
  onFindNearest,
}) => {
  const [localFilters, setLocalFilters] = useState<RestroomFilters>(filters);

  const handleFilterChange = (key: keyof RestroomFilters, value: any) => {
    const newFilters = { ...localFilters, [key]: value };
    setLocalFilters(newFilters);
    onFiltersChange(newFilters);
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    const clearedFilters: RestroomFilters = {};
    setLocalFilters(clearedFilters);
    onFiltersChange(clearedFilters);
  };

  const getActiveFiltersCount = () => {
    return Object.values(localFilters).filter(value => 
      value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== ''
    ).length;
  };

  return (
    <Paper sx={{ p: 2, mb: 2 }}>
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', mb: 2 }}>
        <Typography variant="h6">篩選條件</Typography>
        {getActiveFiltersCount() > 0 && (
          <Chip
            label={`${getActiveFiltersCount()} 個篩選`}
            color="primary"
            size="small"
          />
        )}
      </Box>

      <FormGroup>
        {/* 基本設施 */}
        <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
          基本設施
        </Typography>
        
        <FormControlLabel
          control={
            <Checkbox
              checked={localFilters.bidet || false}
              onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('bidet', e.target.checked)}
            />
          }
          label="免治馬桶"
        />
        
        <FormControlLabel
          control={
            <Checkbox
              checked={localFilters.accessible || false}
              onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('accessible', e.target.checked)}
            />
          }
          label="無障礙設施"
        />
        
        <FormControlLabel
          control={
            <Checkbox
              checked={localFilters.tissue_supply || false}
              onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('tissue_supply', e.target.checked)}
            />
          }
          label="衛生紙供應"
        />
        
        <FormControlLabel
          control={
            <Checkbox
              checked={localFilters.open_24h || false}
              onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('open_24h', e.target.checked)}
            />
          }
          label="24小時開放"
        />

        {/* 環境品質 */}
        <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
          環境品質
        </Typography>
        
        <FormControl fullWidth size="small" sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
          <InputLabel>氣味</InputLabel>
          <Select
            value={localFilters.smell || ''}
            onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('smell', e.target.value || undefined)}
            label="氣味"
          >
            <MenuItem value="">不限</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="good">良好</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="neutral">普通</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="bad">不佳</MenuItem>
          </Select>
        </FormControl>
        
        <FormControl fullWidth size="small" sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
          <InputLabel>光線</InputLabel>
          <Select
            value={localFilters.lighting || ''}
            onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('lighting', e.target.value || undefined)}
            label="光線"
          >
            <MenuItem value="">不限</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="bright">明亮</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="dim">昏暗</MenuItem>
          </Select>
        </FormControl>

        {/* 評分 */}
        <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
          最低評分
        </Typography>
        <Box sx={{ px: 2 }}>
          <Slider
            value={localFilters.min_rating || 0}
            onChange={(_, value) => handleFilterChange('min_rating', value as number)}
            min={0}
            max={5}
            step={0.5}
            marks={[
              { value: 0, label: '0' },
              { value: 2.5, label: '2.5' },
              { value: 5, label: '5' },
            ]}
            valueLabelDisplay="auto"
            valueLabelFormat={(value) => `${value} 星`}
          />
        </Box>

        {/* 搜尋範圍 */}
        <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
          搜尋範圍
        </Typography>
        <Box sx={{ px: 2 }}>
          <Slider
            value={localFilters.radius || 2}
            onChange={(_, value) => handleFilterChange('radius', value as number)}
            min={0.5}
            max={5}
            step={0.5}
            marks={[
              { value: 0.5, label: '0.5km' },
              { value: 2, label: '2km' },
              { value: 5, label: '5km' },
            ]}
            valueLabelDisplay="auto"
            valueLabelFormat={(value) => `${value}km`}
          />
        </Box>
      </FormGroup>

      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1, mt: 2 }}>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          onClick={onFindNearest}
          fullWidth
          sx={{ flex: 2 }}
        >
          找最近的廁所
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="outlined"
          onClick={handleClearFilters}
          fullWidth
          sx={{ flex: 1 }}
        >
          清除篩選
        </Button>
      </Box>
    </Paper>
  );
};

export default FilterPanel;
```

現在更新地圖頁面來整合這些組件：


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Grid,
  Fab,
  Alert,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Logout as LogoutIcon,
  Add as AddIcon,
  MyLocation as MyLocationIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import MapView from '../components/Map/MapView';
import FilterPanel from '../components/Map/FilterPanel';
import { Restroom, RestroomFilters } from '../types';
import { getCurrentLocation } from '../services/googleMaps';

const MapPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [selectedRestroom, setSelectedRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<RestroomFilters>({});
  const [userLocation, setUserLocation] = useState<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>(null);
  const [locationError, setLocationError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleLogout = () => {
    logout();
  };

  const handleRestroomSelect = (restroom: Restroom | null) => {
    setSelectedRestroom(restroom);
    if (restroom) {
      navigate(`/restroom/${restroom.id}`);
    }
  };

  const handleFiltersChange = (newFilters: RestroomFilters) => {
    setFilters(newFilters);
  };

  const handleFindNearest = async () => {
    try {
      if (!userLocation) {
        const location = await getCurrentLocation();
        setUserLocation(location);
        setFilters({ ...filters, latitude: location.lat, longitude: location.lng });
      } else {
        setFilters({ ...filters, latitude: userLocation.lat, longitude: userLocation.lng });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setLocationError('無法獲取您的位置，請檢查瀏覽器權限設定');
    }
  };

  const handleGetLocation = async () => {
    try {
      setLocationError(null);
      const location = await getCurrentLocation();
      setUserLocation(location);
    } catch (error) {
      setLocationError('無法獲取您的位置，請檢查瀏覽器權限設定');
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // 嘗試獲取用戶位置
    handleGetLocation();
  }, []);

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, height: '100vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="home"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            🗺️ 地圖瀏覽
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={handleGetLocation}
            title="獲取我的位置"
          >
            <MyLocationIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mr: 2 }}>
            {user?.username}
          </Typography>
          <IconButton color="inherit" onClick={handleLogout}>
            <LogoutIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      {locationError && (
        <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ m: 1 }}>
          {locationError}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, display: 'flex', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        {/* 篩選面板 */}
        <Box sx={{ width: 300, p: 2, overflow: 'auto', borderRight: 1, borderColor: 'divider' }}>
          <FilterPanel
            filters={filters}
            onFiltersChange={handleFiltersChange}
            onFindNearest={handleFindNearest}
          />
        </Box>

        {/* 地圖區域 */}
        <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, position: 'relative' }}>
          <MapView
            onRestroomSelect={handleRestroomSelect}
            selectedRestroom={selectedRestroom}
            filters={filters}
          />
          
          {/* 新增廁所按鈕 */}
          <Fab
            color="primary"
            aria-label="add restroom"
            sx={{
              position: 'absolute',
              bottom: 16,
              right: 16,
            }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/add-restroom')}
          >
            <AddIcon />
          </Fab>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapPage;
```

現在建立廁所詳情頁面：


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Button,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardMedia,
  Grid,
  Chip,
  Rating,
  TextField,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  Divider,
  Avatar,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemAvatar,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Send as SendIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { Restroom, Comment, Rating as RatingType } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI, commentAPI } from '../services/api';

const RestroomDetailPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [restroom, setRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');
  const [newRating, setNewRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      fetchRestroom();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const fetchRestroom = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const response = await restroomAPI.getById(parseInt(id!));
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestroom(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restroom details');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restroom details');
      console.error('Error fetching restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitComment = async () => {
    if (!newComment.trim() || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.add(restroom.id, { content: newComment.trim() });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewComment('');
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get new comment
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting comment:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitRating = async () => {
    if (!newRating || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.rate(restroom.id, { rating: newRating });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewRating(0);
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get updated rating
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting rating:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
          <CircularProgress />
          <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>載入中...</Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (error || !restroom) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
          <Alert severity="error">{error || '廁所不存在'}</Alert>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            sx={{ mt: 2 }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            返回地圖
          </Button>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            🚽 {restroom.name}
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Grid container spacing={3}>
          {/* 廁所資訊 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={8}>
            <Card>
              {restroom.picture_url && (
                <CardMedia
                  component="img"
                  height="200"
                  image={restroom.picture_url}
                  alt={restroom.name}
                />
              )}
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
                  {restroom.name}
                </Typography>
                
                <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                  📍 {restroom.address}
                </Typography>
                
                {restroom.description && (
                  <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    {restroom.description}
                  </Typography>
                )}

                {/* 標籤 */}
                {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Box sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                      特色標籤
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {restroom.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Box>
                )}

                {/* 評分 */}
                <Box sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分
                  </Typography>
                  {restroom.average_rating ? (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                      <Rating value={restroom.average_rating} readOnly />
                      <Typography variant="h6">
                        {restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)} / 5.0
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        ({restroom.ratings?.length || 0} 個評分)
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  ) : (
                    <Typography color="text.secondary">尚無評分</Typography>
                  )}
                </Box>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 評論區 */}
            <Card sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  評論 ({restroom.comments?.length || 0})
                </Typography>
                
                {/* 新增評論 */}
                {user && (
                  <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      multiline
                      rows={3}
                      placeholder="分享你的使用心得..."
                      value={newComment}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={submitting}
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<SendIcon />}
                      onClick={handleSubmitComment}
                      disabled={!newComment.trim() || submitting}
                      sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                    >
                      發表評論
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                )}

                <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />

                {/* 評論列表 */}
                {restroom.comments && restroom.comments.length > 0 ? (
                  <List>
                    {restroom.comments.map((comment) => (
                      <ListItem key={comment.id} alignItems="flex-start">
                        <ListItemAvatar>
                          <Avatar>
                            {comment.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}
                          </Avatar>
                        </ListItemAvatar>
                        <ListItemText
                          primary={comment.username || '匿名用戶'}
                          secondary={
                            <Box>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                {new Date(comment.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                                {comment.content}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          }
                        />
                      </ListItem>
                    ))}
                  </List>
                ) : (
                  <Typography color="text.secondary" textAlign="center" sx={{ py: 4 }}>
                    尚無評論，成為第一個評論的人吧！
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>

          {/* 側邊欄 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
            {/* 評分廁所 */}
            {user && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分這個廁所
                  </Typography>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}>
                    <Rating
                      value={newRating}
                      onChange={(_, value) => setNewRating(value || 0)}
                      size="large"
                    />
                    {newRating > 0 && (
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        {newRating} 星
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    startIcon={<StarIcon />}
                    onClick={handleSubmitRating}
                    disabled={!newRating || submitting}
                    fullWidth
                  >
                    提交評分
                  </Button>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 廁所資訊 */}
            <Card>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  廁所資訊
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立者：{restroom.creator?.username || '未知'}
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立時間：{new Date(restroom.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                </Typography>
                {restroom.distance && (
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    距離：{restroom.distance.toFixed(2)} km
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RestroomDetailPage;
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Button,
  TextField,
  FormControl,
  InputLabel,
  Select,
  MenuItem,
  Chip,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Grid,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  FormGroup,
  FormControlLabel,
  Checkbox,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Save as SaveIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { RestroomCreate, RestroomTagCreate } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../services/api';

const AddRestroomPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<RestroomCreate>({
    name: '',
    address: '',
    description: '',
    picture_url: '',
    tags: [],
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);

  const tagOptions = [
    { type: 'bidet', label: '免治馬桶', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'smell', label: '氣味', values: ['良好', '普通', '不佳'] },
    { type: 'lighting', label: '光線', values: ['明亮', '昏暗'] },
    { type: 'accessible', label: '無障礙設施', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'tissue_supply', label: '衛生紙供應', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'open_24h', label: '24小時開放', values: ['是', '否'] },
  ];

  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof RestroomCreate, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleTagChange = (tagType: string, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => {
      const newTags = prev.tags?.filter(tag => tag.tag_type !== tagType) || [];
      if (value) {
        newTags.push({ tag_type: tagType as any, tag_value: value });
      }
      return { ...prev, tags: newTags };
    });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!formData.name.trim() || !formData.address.trim()) {
      setError('請填寫廁所名稱和地址');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.create(formData);
      if (response.success) {
        setSuccess(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          navigate('/map');
        }, 2000);
      } else {
        setError(response.error || '新增廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('新增廁所時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error creating restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (success) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 4 }}>
          <Alert severity="success" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
            廁所新增成功！正在跳轉到地圖頁面...
          </Alert>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            ➕ 新增廁所
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Card>
          <CardContent>
            <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              分享你發現的廁所，幫助更多人找到適合的廁所！
            </Typography>

            {error && (
              <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                {error}
              </Alert>
            )}

            <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
              <Grid container spacing={3}>
                {/* 基本資訊 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    基本資訊
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="廁所名稱 *"
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('name', e.target.value)}
                    required
                    placeholder="例如：台大總圖一樓廁所"
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="地址 *"
                    value={formData.address}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('address', e.target.value)}
                    required
                    placeholder="例如：台北市大安區羅斯福路四段1號"
                    helperText="請輸入完整地址，系統會自動轉換為座標"
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    multiline
                    rows={3}
                    label="描述"
                    value={formData.description || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('description', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="分享這個廁所的特色或使用心得..."
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="照片網址"
                    value={formData.picture_url || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('picture_url', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="https://example.com/photo.jpg"
                    helperText="可選：上傳廁所照片的網址"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 標籤 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    廁所特色
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                    選擇這個廁所的特色標籤
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                {tagOptions.map((option) => (
                  <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} key={option.type}>
                    <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
                      <InputLabel>{option.label}</InputLabel>
                      <Select
                        value={formData.tags?.find(tag => tag.tag_type === option.type)?.tag_value || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleTagChange(option.type, e.target.value)}
                        label={option.label}
                      >
                        <MenuItem value="">不限</MenuItem>
                        {option.values.map((value) => (
                          <MenuItem key={value} value={value}>
                            {value}
                          </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                  </Grid>
                ))}

                {/* 已選擇的標籤 */}
                {formData.tags && formData.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                      已選擇的標籤：
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {formData.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          onDelete={() => handleTagChange(tag.tag_type, '')}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                )}

                {/* 提交按鈕 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
                      disabled={loading}
                    >
                      取消
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="submit"
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <SaveIcon />}
                      disabled={loading || !formData.name.trim() || !formData.address.trim()}
                    >
                      {loading ? '新增中...' : '新增廁所'}
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
            </Box>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AddRestroomPage;
```

現在建立好友系統頁面：


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Button,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Grid,
  TextField,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemAvatar,
  Avatar,
  Chip,
  Tabs,
  Tab,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  PersonAdd as PersonAddIcon,
  Search as SearchIcon,
  Check as CheckIcon,
  Close as CloseIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { User, Friendship, Activity } from '../types';
import { friendAPI } from '../services/api';

interface TabPanelProps {
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  index: number;
  value: number;
}

function TabPanel(props: TabPanelProps) {
  const { children, value, index, ...other } = props;
  return (
    <div
      role="tabpanel"
      hidden={value !== index}
      id={`friends-tabpanel-${index}`}
      aria-labelledby={`friends-tab-${index}`}
      {...other}
    >
      {value === index && <Box sx={{ p: 3 }}>{children}</Box>}
    </div>
  );
}

const FriendsPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [tabValue, setTabValue] = useState(0);
  const [friends, setFriends] = useState<Friendship[]>([]);
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState<{ incoming: Friendship[]; outgoing: Friendship[] }>({ incoming: [], outgoing: [] });
  const [activities, setActivities] = useState<Activity[]>([]);
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState<User[]>([]);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [searchDialogOpen, setSearchDialogOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchFriendsData();
  }, []);

  const fetchFriendsData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      const [friendsRes, requestsRes, activitiesRes] = await Promise.all([
        friendAPI.getFriends(),
        friendAPI.getRequests(),
        friendAPI.getActivity(),
      ]);

      if (friendsRes.success) setFriends(friendsRes.data || []);
      if (requestsRes.success) setRequests(requestsRes.data || { incoming: [], outgoing: [] });
      if (activitiesRes.success) setActivities(activitiesRes.data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      setError('載入好友資料時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error fetching friends data:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSearchUsers = async () => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return;

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const response = await friendAPI.searchUsers(searchQuery);
      if (response.success) {
        setSearchResults(response.data || []);
        setSearchDialogOpen(true);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('搜尋用戶時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error searching users:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSendFriendRequest = async (friendId: number) => {
    try {
      const response = await friendAPI.sendRequest({ friend_id: friendId });
      if (response.success) {
        fetchFriendsData();
        setSearchDialogOpen(false);
        setSearchQuery('');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('發送好友請求時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error sending friend request:', err);
    }
  };

  const handleAcceptRequest = async (requestId: number) => {
    try {
      const response = await friendAPI.acceptRequest(requestId);
      if (response.success) {
        fetchFriendsData();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('接受好友請求時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error accepting friend request:', err);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveFriend = async (friendId: number) => {
    try {
      const response = await friendAPI.removeFriend(friendId);
      if (response.success) {
        fetchFriendsData();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('移除好友時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error removing friend:', err);
    }
  };

  const handleTabChange = (event: React.SyntheticEvent, newValue: number) => {
    setTabValue(newValue);
  };

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            👥 好友系統
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => setSearchDialogOpen(true)}
          >
            <SearchIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
        {error && (
          <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
            {error}
          </Alert>
        )}

        <Box sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: 'divider' }}>
          <Tabs value={tabValue} onChange={handleTabChange}>
            <Tab label="好友列表" />
            <Tab label="好友請求" />
            <Tab label="好友動態" />
          </Tabs>
        </Box>

        {/* 好友列表 */}
        <TabPanel value={tabValue} index={0}>
          <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
            我的好友 ({friends.length})
          </Typography>
          {loading ? (
            <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" p={3}>
              <CircularProgress />
            </Box>
          ) : friends.length > 0 ? (
            <Grid container spacing={2}>
              {friends.map((friendship) => (
                <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} md={4} key={friendship.id}>
                  <Card>
                    <CardContent>
                      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', mb: 2 }}>
                        <Avatar sx={{ mr: 2 }}>
                          {friendship.friend?.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'F'}
                        </Avatar>
                        <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
                          <Typography variant="h6">
                            {friendship.friend?.username || '未知用戶'}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {friendship.friend?.email}
                          </Typography>
                        </Box>
                      </Box>
                      <Button
                        variant="outlined"
                        color="error"
                        size="small"
                        onClick={() => handleRemoveFriend(friendship.friend_id)}
                      >
                        移除好友
                      </Button>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </Grid>
              ))}
            </Grid>
          ) : (
            <Box textAlign="center" py={4}>
              <Typography color="text.secondary">
                還沒有好友，快去搜尋並添加好友吧！
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          )}
        </TabPanel>

        {/* 好友請求 */}
        <TabPanel value={tabValue} index={1}>
          <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
            好友請求
          </Typography>
          
          {/* 收到的請求 */}
          <Typography variant="subtitle1" gutterBottom sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
            收到的請求 ({requests.incoming.length})
          </Typography>
          {requests.incoming.length > 0 ? (
            <List>
              {requests.incoming.map((request) => (
                <ListItem key={request.id}>
                  <ListItemAvatar>
                    <Avatar>
                      {request.friend?.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}
                    </Avatar>
                  </ListItemAvatar>
                  <ListItemText
                    primary={request.friend?.username || '未知用戶'}
                    secondary={request.friend?.email}
                  />
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1 }}>
                    <Button
                      size="small"
                      variant="contained"
                      color="primary"
                      startIcon={<CheckIcon />}
                      onClick={() => handleAcceptRequest(request.id)}
                    >
                      接受
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      size="small"
                      variant="outlined"
                      color="error"
                      startIcon={<CloseIcon />}
                    >
                      拒絕
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                </ListItem>
              ))}
            </List>
          ) : (
            <Typography color="text.secondary" sx={{ py: 2 }}>
              沒有收到的好友請求
            </Typography>
          )}

          {/* 發出的請求 */}
          <Typography variant="subtitle1" gutterBottom sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
            發出的請求 ({requests.outgoing.length})
          </Typography>
          {requests.outgoing.length > 0 ? (
            <List>
              {requests.outgoing.map((request) => (
                <ListItem key={request.id}>
                  <ListItemAvatar>
                    <Avatar>
                      {request.friend?.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}
                    </Avatar>
                  </ListItemAvatar>
                  <ListItemText
                    primary={request.friend?.username || '未知用戶'}
                    secondary={request.friend?.email}
                  />
                  <Chip label="等待回應" color="warning" size="small" />
                </ListItem>
              ))}
            </List>
          ) : (
            <Typography color="text.secondary" sx={{ py: 2 }}>
              沒有發出的好友請求
            </Typography>
          )}
        </TabPanel>

        {/* 好友動態 */}
        <TabPanel value={tabValue} index={2}>
          <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
            好友動態
          </Typography>
          {activities.length > 0 ? (
            <List>
              {activities.map((activity, index) => (
                <ListItem key={index} divider>
                  <ListItemAvatar>
                    <Avatar>
                      {activity.type === 'restroom_added' ? '🚽' : '💬'}
                    </Avatar>
                  </ListItemAvatar>
                  <ListItemText
                    primary={
                      activity.type === 'restroom_added' 
                        ? `新增了廁所：${activity.data.name}`
                        : `評論了廁所：${activity.data.restroom_name}`
                    }
                    secondary={
                      <Box>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                          {new Date(activity.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                        </Typography>
                        {activity.type === 'comment_added' && (
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                            "{activity.data.content}"
                          </Typography>
                        )}
                      </Box>
                    }
                  />
                </ListItem>
              ))}
            </List>
          ) : (
            <Box textAlign="center" py={4}>
              <Typography color="text.secondary">
                沒有好友動態
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          )}
        </TabPanel>
      </Container>

      {/* 搜尋用戶對話框 */}
      <Dialog open={searchDialogOpen} onClose={() => setSearchDialogOpen(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>搜尋用戶</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}>
            <TextField
              fullWidth
              label="搜尋用戶"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="輸入用戶名稱或電子郵件"
            />
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              onClick={handleSearchUsers}
              disabled={loading || !searchQuery.trim()}
              startIcon={<SearchIcon />}
            >
              搜尋
            </Button>
          </Box>
          
          {searchResults.length > 0 ? (
            <List>
              {searchResults.map((user) => (
                <ListItem key={user.id}>
                  <ListItemAvatar>
                    <Avatar>
                      {user.username.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                    </Avatar>
                  </ListItemAvatar>
                  <ListItemText
                    primary={user.username}
                    secondary={user.email}
                  />
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    size="small"
                    startIcon={<PersonAddIcon />}
                    onClick={() => handleSendFriendRequest(user.id)}
                  >
                    加好友
                  </Button>
                </ListItem>
              ))}
            </List>
          ) : searchQuery && !loading ? (
            <Typography color="text.secondary" textAlign="center" py={2}>
              沒有找到用戶
            </Typography>
          ) : null}
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setSearchDialogOpen(false)}>關閉</Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default FriendsPage;
```

```typescriptreact
        setRestrooms(response.data);

        setError('Failed to fetch restrooms');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restrooms');
      console.error('Error fetching restrooms:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoaded) {
      fetchRestrooms();
    }
  }, [isLoaded, fetchRestrooms]);

  const handleMarkerClick = (restroom: Restroom) => {
    if (onRestroomSelect) {
      onRestroomSelect(restroom);
    }
  };

  const handleMapClick = () => {
    if (onRestroomSelect) {
      onRestroomSelect(null);
    }
  };

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <Typography color="error">
          Error loading Google Maps. Please check your API key.
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
        <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>Loading map...</Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: '100%', height: '500px', position: 'relative' }}>
      <GoogleMap
        mapContainerStyle={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
        center={mapCenter}
        zoom={mapZoom}
        options={DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS}
        onClick={handleMapClick}
      >
        {restrooms.map((restroom) => (
          <RestroomMarker
            key={restroom.id}
            restroom={restroom}
            onClick={() => handleMarkerClick(restroom)}
            isSelected={selectedRestroom?.id === restroom.id}
          />
        ))}
      </GoogleMap>
      
      {loading && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
            boxShadow: 1,
          }}
        >
          <CircularProgress size={20} />
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            Loading restrooms...
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
      
      {error && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'error.light',
            color: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="caption">{error}</Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapView;
```

```typescriptreact
}

}) => {

        center={mapCenter}

        options={DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS}
        onClick={handleMapClick}
      >

};
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Marker } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { InfoWindow } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { Box, Typography, Chip, Rating } from '@mui/material';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { getMarkerIcon, getMarkerSize } from '../../services/googleMaps';

interface RestroomMarkerProps {
  restroom: Restroom;
  onClick: () => void;
  isSelected?: boolean;
}

const RestroomMarker: React.FC<RestroomMarkerProps> = ({ 
  restroom, 
  onClick
}) => {
  const [showInfoWindow, setShowInfoWindow] = useState(false);

  const handleMarkerClick = () => {
    setShowInfoWindow(true);
    onClick();
  };

  const handleInfoWindowClose = () => {
    setShowInfoWindow(false);
  };

  const markerIcon = getMarkerIcon(restroom.average_rating);
  const markerSize = getMarkerSize(restroom.average_rating);

  return (
    <>
      <Marker
        position={{ lat: restroom.latitude, lng: restroom.longitude }}
        onClick={handleMarkerClick}
        icon={{
          url: `data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,${encodeURIComponent(`
            <svg width="${markerSize.width}" height="${markerSize.height}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
              <path d="M12 2C8.13 2 5 5.13 5 9c0 5.25 7 13 7 13s7-7.75 7-13c0-3.87-3.13-7-7-7zm0 9.5c-1.38 0-2.5-1.12-2.5-2.5s1.12-2.5 2.5-2.5 2.5 1.12 2.5 2.5-1.12 2.5-2.5 2.5z" fill="#1976d2"/>
            </svg>
          `)}`,
          scaledSize: new google.maps.Size(markerSize.width, markerSize.height),
          anchor: new google.maps.Point(markerSize.width / 2, markerSize.height),
        }}
      />
      
      {showInfoWindow && (
        <InfoWindow
          position={{ lat: restroom.latitude, lng: restroom.longitude }}
          onCloseClick={handleInfoWindowClose}
        >
          <Box sx={{ p: 1, minWidth: 200 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
              {restroom.name}
            </Typography>
            
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              {restroom.address}
            </Typography>
            
            {restroom.average_rating && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', mb: 1 }}>
                <Rating 
                  value={restroom.average_rating} 
                  readOnly 
                  size="small"
                />
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
                  ({restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)})
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            )}
            
            {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5, mt: 1 }}>
                {restroom.tags.slice(0, 3).map((tag, index) => (
                  <Chip
                    key={index}
                    label={tag.tag_value}
                    size="small"
                    color="primary"
                    variant="outlined"
                  />
                ))}
                {restroom.tags.length > 3 && (
                  <Chip
                    label={`+${restroom.tags.length - 3}`}
                    size="small"
                    color="default"
                    variant="outlined"
                  />
                )}
              </Box>
            )}
            
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
              Click for details
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </InfoWindow>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default RestroomMarker;
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Button,
  TextField,
  FormControl,
  InputLabel,
  Select,
  MenuItem,
  Chip,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Grid,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Save as SaveIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { RestroomCreate, RestroomTagCreate } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../services/api';

const AddRestroomPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<RestroomCreate>({
    name: '',
    address: '',
    description: '',
    picture_url: '',
    tags: [],
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);

  const tagOptions = [
    { type: 'bidet', label: '免治馬桶', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'smell', label: '氣味', values: ['良好', '普通', '不佳'] },
    { type: 'lighting', label: '光線', values: ['明亮', '昏暗'] },
    { type: 'accessible', label: '無障礙設施', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'tissue_supply', label: '衛生紙供應', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'open_24h', label: '24小時開放', values: ['是', '否'] },
  ];

  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof RestroomCreate, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleTagChange = (tagType: string, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => {
      const newTags = prev.tags?.filter(tag => tag.tag_type !== tagType) || [];
      if (value) {
        newTags.push({ tag_type: tagType as any, tag_value: value });
      }
      return { ...prev, tags: newTags };
    });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!formData.name.trim() || !formData.address.trim()) {
      setError('請填寫廁所名稱和地址');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.create(formData);
      if (response.success) {
        setSuccess(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          navigate('/map');
        }, 2000);
      } else {
        setError(response.error || '新增廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('新增廁所時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error creating restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (success) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 4 }}>
          <Alert severity="success" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
            廁所新增成功！正在跳轉到地圖頁面...
          </Alert>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            ➕ 新增廁所
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Card>
          <CardContent>
            <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              分享你發現的廁所，幫助更多人找到適合的廁所！
            </Typography>

            {error && (
              <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                {error}
              </Alert>
            )}

            <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
              <Grid container spacing={3}>
                {/* 基本資訊 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    基本資訊
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="廁所名稱 *"
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('name', e.target.value)}
                    required
                    placeholder="例如：台大總圖一樓廁所"
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="地址 *"
                    value={formData.address}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('address', e.target.value)}
                    required
                    placeholder="例如：台北市大安區羅斯福路四段1號"
                    helperText="請輸入完整地址，系統會自動轉換為座標"
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    multiline
                    rows={3}
                    label="描述"
                    value={formData.description || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('description', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="分享這個廁所的特色或使用心得..."
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="照片網址"
                    value={formData.picture_url || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('picture_url', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="https://example.com/photo.jpg"
                    helperText="可選：上傳廁所照片的網址"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 標籤 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    廁所特色
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                    選擇這個廁所的特色標籤
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                {tagOptions.map((option) => (
                  <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} key={option.type}>
                    <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
                      <InputLabel>{option.label}</InputLabel>
                      <Select
                        value={formData.tags?.find(tag => tag.tag_type === option.type)?.tag_value || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleTagChange(option.type, e.target.value)}
                        label={option.label}
                      >
                        <MenuItem value="">不限</MenuItem>
                        {option.values.map((value) => (
                          <MenuItem key={value} value={value}>
                            {value}
                          </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                  </Grid>
                ))}

                {/* 已選擇的標籤 */}
                {formData.tags && formData.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                      已選擇的標籤：
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {formData.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          onDelete={() => handleTagChange(tag.tag_type, '')}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                )}

                {/* 提交按鈕 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
                      disabled={loading}
                    >
                      取消
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="submit"
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <SaveIcon />}
                      disabled={loading || !formData.name.trim() || !formData.address.trim()}
                    >
                      {loading ? '新增中...' : '新增廁所'}
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
            </Box>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AddRestroomPage;
```
