現在讓我為小螢幕添加一個篩選面板的抽屜式選單。首先更新 MapPage 來添加篩選按鈕：


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Fab,
  Alert,
  Drawer,
  useMediaQuery,
  useTheme,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Logout as LogoutIcon,
  Add as AddIcon,
  MyLocation as MyLocationIcon,
  FilterList as FilterIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import MapView from '../components/Map/MapView';
import FilterPanel from '../components/Map/FilterPanel';
import { Restroom, RestroomFilters } from '../types';
import { getCurrentLocation } from '../services/googleMaps';

const MapPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [selectedRestroom, setSelectedRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<RestroomFilters>({});
  const [userLocation, setUserLocation] = useState<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>(null);
  const [locationError, setLocationError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleLogout = () => {
    logout();
  };

  const handleRestroomSelect = (restroom: Restroom | null) => {
    setSelectedRestroom(restroom);
    if (restroom) {
      navigate(`/restroom/${restroom.id}`);
    }
  };

  const handleFiltersChange = (newFilters: RestroomFilters) => {
    setFilters(newFilters);
  };

  const handleFindNearest = async () => {
    try {
      if (!userLocation) {
        const location = await getCurrentLocation();
        setUserLocation(location);
        setFilters({ ...filters, latitude: location.lat, longitude: location.lng });
      } else {
        setFilters({ ...filters, latitude: userLocation.lat, longitude: userLocation.lng });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setLocationError('無法獲取您的位置，請檢查瀏覽器權限設定');
    }
  };

  const handleGetLocation = async () => {
    try {
      setLocationError(null);
      const location = await getCurrentLocation();
      setUserLocation(location);
    } catch (error) {
      setLocationError('無法獲取您的位置，請檢查瀏覽器權限設定');
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // 嘗試獲取用戶位置
    handleGetLocation();
  }, []);

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, height: '100vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="home"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            🗺️ 地圖瀏覽
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={handleGetLocation}
            title="獲取我的位置"
          >
            <MyLocationIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mr: 2 }}>
            {user?.username}
          </Typography>
          <IconButton color="inherit" onClick={handleLogout}>
            <LogoutIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      {locationError && (
        <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ m: 1 }}>
          {locationError}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, display: 'flex', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        {/* 篩選面板 - 響應式寬度 */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          width: { xs: '100%', sm: '100%', md: 300, lg: 320 },
          minWidth: { md: 280 },
          maxWidth: { xs: '100%', sm: '100%', md: 400 },
          p: { xs: 1, sm: 2 },
          overflow: 'auto', 
          borderRight: { xs: 0, md: 1 }, 
          borderColor: 'divider',
          display: { xs: 'none', md: 'block' } // 在小螢幕上隱藏
        }}>
          <FilterPanel
            filters={filters}
            onFiltersChange={handleFiltersChange}
            onFindNearest={handleFindNearest}
          />
        </Box>

        {/* 地圖區域 */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flexGrow: 1, 
          position: 'relative',
          minHeight: { xs: 'calc(100vh - 64px)', md: 'calc(100vh - 64px)' }
        }}>
          <MapView
            onRestroomSelect={handleRestroomSelect}
            selectedRestroom={selectedRestroom}
            filters={filters}
          />
          
          {/* 新增廁所按鈕 */}
          <Fab
            color="primary"
            aria-label="add restroom"
            sx={{
              position: 'absolute',
              bottom: 16,
              right: 16,
              zIndex: 1000
            }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/add-restroom')}
          >
            <AddIcon />
          </Fab>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapPage;
```

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Fab,
  Alert,
  Drawer,
  useMediaQuery,
  useTheme,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Logout as LogoutIcon,
  Add as AddIcon,
  MyLocation as MyLocationIcon,
  FilterList as FilterIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import MapView from '../components/Map/MapView';
import FilterPanel from '../components/Map/FilterPanel';
import { Restroom, RestroomFilters } from '../types';
import { getCurrentLocation } from '../services/googleMaps';

const MapPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('md'));
  const [selectedRestroom, setSelectedRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<RestroomFilters>({});
  const [userLocation, setUserLocation] = useState<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>(null);
  const [locationError, setLocationError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filterDrawerOpen, setFilterDrawerOpen] = useState(false);

  const handleLogout = () => {
    logout();
  };

  const handleRestroomSelect = (restroom: Restroom | null) => {
    setSelectedRestroom(restroom);
    if (restroom) {
      navigate(`/restroom/${restroom.id}`);
    }
  };

  const handleFiltersChange = (newFilters: RestroomFilters) => {
    setFilters(newFilters);
  };

  const handleFindNearest = async () => {
    try {
      if (!userLocation) {
        const location = await getCurrentLocation();
        setUserLocation(location);
        setFilters({ ...filters, latitude: location.lat, longitude: location.lng });
      } else {
        setFilters({ ...filters, latitude: userLocation.lat, longitude: userLocation.lng });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setLocationError('無法獲取您的位置，請檢查瀏覽器權限設定');
    }
  };

  const handleGetLocation = async () => {
    try {
      setLocationError(null);
      const location = await getCurrentLocation();
      setUserLocation(location);
    } catch (error) {
      setLocationError('無法獲取您的位置，請檢查瀏覽器權限設定');
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // 嘗試獲取用戶位置
    handleGetLocation();
  }, []);

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, height: '100vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="home"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            🗺️ 地圖瀏覽
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={handleGetLocation}
            title="獲取我的位置"
          >
            <MyLocationIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mr: 2 }}>
            {user?.username}
          </Typography>
          <IconButton color="inherit" onClick={handleLogout}>
            <LogoutIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      {locationError && (
        <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ m: 1 }}>
          {locationError}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, display: 'flex', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        {/* 篩選面板 - 響應式寬度 */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          width: { xs: '100%', sm: '100%', md: 300, lg: 320 },
          minWidth: { md: 280 },
          maxWidth: { xs: '100%', sm: '100%', md: 400 },
          p: { xs: 1, sm: 2 },
          overflow: 'auto', 
          borderRight: { xs: 0, md: 1 }, 
          borderColor: 'divider',
          display: { xs: 'none', md: 'block' } // 在小螢幕上隱藏
        }}>
          <FilterPanel
            filters={filters}
            onFiltersChange={handleFiltersChange}
            onFindNearest={handleFindNearest}
          />
        </Box>

        {/* 地圖區域 */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flexGrow: 1, 
          position: 'relative',
          minHeight: { xs: 'calc(100vh - 64px)', md: 'calc(100vh - 64px)' }
        }}>
          <MapView
            onRestroomSelect={handleRestroomSelect}
            selectedRestroom={selectedRestroom}
            filters={filters}
          />
          
          {/* 新增廁所按鈕 */}
          <Fab
            color="primary"
            aria-label="add restroom"
            sx={{
              position: 'absolute',
              bottom: 16,
              right: 16,
              zIndex: 1000
            }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/add-restroom')}
          >
            <AddIcon />
          </Fab>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapPage;
```

  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('md'));
  const [selectedRestroom, setSelectedRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<RestroomFilters>({});
  const [userLocation, setUserLocation] = useState<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>(null);
  const [locationError, setLocationError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filterDrawerOpen, setFilterDrawerOpen] = useState(false);

  const handleLogout = () => {
    logout();
  };

  const handleRestroomSelect = (restroom: Restroom | null) => {
    setSelectedRestroom(restroom);
    if (restroom) {
      navigate(`/restroom/${restroom.id}`);
    }
  };

  const handleFiltersChange = (newFilters: RestroomFilters) => {
    setFilters(newFilters);
  };

  const handleFindNearest = async () => {
    try {
      if (!userLocation) {
        const location = await getCurrentLocation();
        setUserLocation(location);
        setFilters({ ...filters, latitude: location.lat, longitude: location.lng });
      } else {
        setFilters({ ...filters, latitude: userLocation.lat, longitude: userLocation.lng });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setLocationError('無法獲取您的位置，請檢查瀏覽器權限設定');
    }
  };

  const handleGetLocation = async () => {
    try {
      setLocationError(null);
      const location = await getCurrentLocation();
      setUserLocation(location);
    } catch (error) {
      setLocationError('無法獲取您的位置，請檢查瀏覽器權限設定');
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // 嘗試獲取用戶位置
    handleGetLocation();
  }, []);

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, height: '100vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="home"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            🗺️ 地圖瀏覽
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={handleGetLocation}
            title="獲取我的位置"
          >
            <MyLocationIcon />
          </IconButton>
          {isMobile && (
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => setFilterDrawerOpen(true)}
              title="篩選條件"
            >
              <FilterIcon />
            </IconButton>
          )}
          <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mr: 2 }}>
            {user?.username}
          </Typography>
          <IconButton color="inherit" onClick={handleLogout}>
            <LogoutIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      {locationError && (
        <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ m: 1 }}>
          {locationError}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, display: 'flex', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        {/* 篩選面板 - 響應式寬度 */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          width: { xs: '100%', sm: '100%', md: 300, lg: 320 },
          minWidth: { md: 280 },
          maxWidth: { xs: '100%', sm: '100%', md: 400 },
          p: { xs: 1, sm: 2 },
          overflow: 'auto', 
          borderRight: { xs: 0, md: 1 }, 
          borderColor: 'divider',
          display: { xs: 'none', md: 'block' } // 在小螢幕上隱藏
        }}>
          <FilterPanel
            filters={filters}
            onFiltersChange={handleFiltersChange}
            onFindNearest={handleFindNearest}
          />
        </Box>

        {/* 地圖區域 */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flexGrow: 1, 
          position: 'relative',
          minHeight: { xs: 'calc(100vh - 64px)', md: 'calc(100vh - 64px)' }
        }}>
          <MapView
            onRestroomSelect={handleRestroomSelect}
            selectedRestroom={selectedRestroom}
            filters={filters}
          />
          
          {/* 新增廁所按鈕 */}
          <Fab
            color="primary"
            aria-label="add restroom"
            sx={{
              position: 'absolute',
              bottom: 16,
              right: 16,
              zIndex: 1000
            }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/add-restroom')}
          >
            <AddIcon />
          </Fab>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* 手機版篩選抽屜 */}
      <Drawer
        anchor="bottom"
        open={filterDrawerOpen}
        onClose={() => setFilterDrawerOpen(false)}
        sx={{
          '& .MuiDrawer-paper': {
            height: '70vh',
            borderTopLeftRadius: 16,
            borderTopRightRadius: 16,
          },
        }}
      >
        <Box sx={{ p: 2, height: '100%', overflow: 'auto' }}>
          <Box sx={{ 
            display: 'flex', 
            justifyContent: 'space-between', 
            alignItems: 'center', 
            mb: 2 
          }}>
            <Typography variant="h6">篩選條件</Typography>
            <IconButton onClick={() => setFilterDrawerOpen(false)}>
              <CloseIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Box>
          <FilterPanel
            filters={filters}
            onFiltersChange={handleFiltersChange}
            onFindNearest={() => {
              handleFindNearest();
              setFilterDrawerOpen(false);
            }}
          />
        </Box>
      </Drawer>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapPage;
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { GoogleMap, useJsApiLoader } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { Box, Typography, CircularProgress } from '@mui/material';
import { GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG, DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS, NTU_COORDINATES } from '../../services/googleMaps';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../../services/api';
import RestroomMarker from './RestroomMarker';

interface MapViewProps {
  onRestroomSelect?: (restroom: Restroom) => void;
  selectedRestroom?: Restroom | null;
  filters?: any;
}

const MapView: React.FC<MapViewProps> = ({ 
  onRestroomSelect, 
  selectedRestroom, 
  filters 
}) => {
  const [restrooms, setRestrooms] = useState<Restroom[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mapCenter] = useState(NTU_COORDINATES);
  const [mapZoom] = useState(15);

  const { isLoaded, loadError } = useJsApiLoader({
    id: 'google-map-script',
    googleMapsApiKey: GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG.apiKey,
    libraries: ['places', 'geometry'],
  });

  const fetchRestrooms = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.getAll(filters);
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestrooms(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restrooms');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restrooms');
      console.error('Error fetching restrooms:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoaded) {
      fetchRestrooms();
    }
  }, [isLoaded, fetchRestrooms]);

  const handleMarkerClick = (restroom: Restroom) => {
    if (onRestroomSelect) {
      onRestroomSelect(restroom);
    }
  };

  const handleMapClick = () => {
    // Map click handler - could be used for future features
  };

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <Typography color="error">
          Error loading Google Maps. Please check your API key.
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
        <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>Loading map...</Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ 
      width: '100%', 
      height: { xs: 'calc(100vh - 64px)', sm: 'calc(100vh - 64px)', md: '500px' }, 
      position: 'relative' 
    }}>
      <GoogleMap
        mapContainerStyle={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
        center={mapCenter}
        zoom={mapZoom}
        options={DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS}
        onClick={handleMapClick}
      >
        {restrooms.map((restroom) => (
          <RestroomMarker
            key={restroom.id}
            restroom={restroom}
            onClick={() => handleMarkerClick(restroom)}
            isSelected={selectedRestroom?.id === restroom.id}
          />
        ))}
      </GoogleMap>
      
      {loading && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
            boxShadow: 1,
          }}
        >
          <CircularProgress size={20} />
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            Loading restrooms...
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
      
      {error && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'error.light',
            color: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="caption">{error}</Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapView;

```

```markdown
# 響應式設計 (RWD) 改進總結

## 🎯 問題分析
根據用戶反饋「頁面大小怪怪的 應該要調整一下RWD之類的」，我們對 NTU 廁所地圖應用程式進行了全面的響應式設計優化。

## 🔧 主要改進

### 1. 地圖頁面佈局優化

#### 桌面版 (md+)
- **篩選面板**：固定寬度 300-320px，左側顯示
- **地圖區域**：佔據剩餘空間，高度 500px
- **佈局**：水平分割，篩選面板 + 地圖

#### 平板版 (sm)
- **篩選面板**：隱藏，使用抽屜式選單
- **地圖區域**：全寬顯示
- **操作**：點擊篩選按鈕開啟抽屜

#### 手機版 (xs)
- **篩選面板**：完全隱藏
- **地圖區域**：全螢幕高度 `calc(100vh - 64px)`
- **抽屜選單**：從底部滑出，高度 70vh

### 2. 篩選面板響應式設計

#### 基本設施區塊
```tsx
// 網格佈局：手機版 1 欄，平板版 2 欄
<Box sx={{ 
  display: 'grid', 
  gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', sm: '1fr 1fr' },
  gap: { xs: 0.5, sm: 1 }
}}>
```

#### 環境品質區塊
- **手機版**：垂直排列
- **平板版**：2 欄網格佈局
- **字體大小**：響應式調整

#### 滑桿組件
- **手機版**：較小的標籤字體
- **桌面版**：標準字體大小
- **間距**：響應式 padding

#### 按鈕區域
```tsx
// 手機版：垂直排列，桌面版：水平排列
<Box sx={{ 
  flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' }
}}>
```

### 3. 導航列優化

#### 響應式按鈕
- **定位按鈕**：所有尺寸都顯示
- **篩選按鈕**：僅在手機版顯示
- **用戶資訊**：響應式隱藏/顯示

### 4. 地圖組件優化

#### 高度調整
```tsx
// 響應式高度
height: { 
  xs: 'calc(100vh - 64px)', 
  sm: 'calc(100vh - 64px)', 
  md: '500px' 
}
```

#### 浮動按鈕
- **z-index**：確保在地圖上方
- **位置**：固定右下角
- **大小**：響應式調整

### 5. 抽屜式篩選選單

#### 手機版專用功能
- **觸發**：導航列篩選按鈕
- **動畫**：從底部滑出
- **高度**：70vh，圓角設計
- **關閉**：點擊 X 按鈕或背景

#### 內容優化
- **滾動**：內容過多時可滾動
- **間距**：適合觸控操作
- **字體**：手機友好的大小

## 📱 斷點設計

### Material-UI 斷點系統
- **xs**: 0px+ (手機)
- **sm**: 600px+ (平板)
- **md**: 900px+ (桌面)
- **lg**: 1200px+ (大螢幕)

### 自定義斷點
```tsx
const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('md'));
```

## 🎨 視覺改進

### 1. 字體大小響應式
```tsx
fontSize: { xs: '0.8rem', sm: '0.875rem' }
```

### 2. 間距響應式
```tsx
p: { xs: 1, sm: 2 }
gap: { xs: 0.5, sm: 1 }
```

### 3. 組件大小響應式
```tsx
size="small"  // 手機版使用小尺寸組件
```

## 🚀 效能優化

### 1. 條件渲染
- 手機版隱藏篩選面板
- 桌面版顯示完整佈局

### 2. 懶加載

- 地圖組件優化

### 3. 記憶體管理

- 事件監聽器清理

## 📋 測試建議

### 1. 裝置測試
- **iPhone SE** (375px): 最小手機螢幕
- **iPad** (768px): 平板螢幕
- **Desktop** (1200px+): 桌面螢幕

### 2. 功能測試

### 3. 效能測試
- 頁面載入速度
- 滾動流暢度
- 記憶體使用量

## 🔧 技術實現

### 1. Material-UI 響應式系統
```tsx
sx={{ 
  width: { xs: '100%', md: 300 },
  display: { xs: 'none', md: 'block' }
}}
```

### 2. useMediaQuery Hook

```

## 📈 改進效果

### 1. 用戶體驗

## 🎯 總結

通過這次 RWD 改進，NTU 廁所地圖應用程式現在能夠：

1. **完美適配**各種螢幕尺寸
2. **提供最佳**的用戶體驗

**Cursor**

好問題！關於編輯後是否需要重新啟動，這取決於你使用的是哪種模式：

## 🔄 開發模式 vs 生產模式

### 1. **開發模式** (`npm run dev`)
- ✅ **熱重載 (Hot Reload)**：編輯後會自動重新編譯並刷新瀏覽器
- ✅ **即時更新**：修改 TypeScript/React 代碼後立即生效
- ✅ **無需手動重啟**：只要開發伺服器在運行，修改會自動反映

### 2. **生產模式** (`npm run build` + `npm start`)
- ❌ **需要重新建置**：修改代碼後需要重新 `npm run build`
- ❌ **需要重啟伺服器**：建置完成後需要重新 `npm start`

## 🚀 建議的開發流程

### 開發階段：
```bash
# 後端
cd backend
npm run dev  # 熱重載，修改後自動重啟

# 前端  
cd frontend
npm run dev  # 熱重載，修改後自動刷新瀏覽器
```

### 部署階段：
```bash
# 建置生產版本
cd frontend
npm run build

# 啟動生產伺服器
cd backend
npm start
```

## 📝 你目前的情況

由於你剛才執行了 `npm run build`，這表示你建置了生產版本。如果你想要：

1. **繼續開發**：使用 `npm run dev` 來獲得熱重載功能
2. **測試生產版本**：使用 `npm start` 來啟動建置好的版本

## 💡 最佳實踐

- **開發時**：使用 `npm run dev`，享受熱重載的便利
- **測試時**：偶爾用 `npm run build` + `npm start` 測試生產版本
- **部署時**：使用建置好的版本

所以回答你的問題：**在開發模式下，編輯後會直接顯示，無需重新啟動！** 🎉

```shellscript
# 後端
cd backend
npm run dev  # 熱重載，修改後自動重啟

# 前端  
cd frontend
npm run dev  # 熱重載，修改後自動刷新瀏覽器
```

```shellscript
# 建置生產版本
cd frontend
npm run build

# 啟動生產伺服器
cd backend
npm start
```

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {

  AppBar,

  FormControl,

} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,

  Save as SaveIcon,
  LocationOn as LocationOnIcon,
  Edit as EditIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { RestroomCreate } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../services/api';
import MapView from '../components/Map/MapView';

const AddRestroomPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<RestroomCreate>({
    name: '',
    address: '',
    description: '',
    picture_url: '',
    tags: [],
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);

  const tagOptions = [
    { type: 'bidet', label: '免治馬桶', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'smell', label: '氣味', values: ['良好', '普通', '不佳'] },
    { type: 'lighting', label: '光線', values: ['明亮', '昏暗'] },
    { type: 'accessible', label: '無障礙設施', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'tissue_supply', label: '衛生紙供應', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'open_24h', label: '24小時開放', values: ['是', '否'] },
  ];

  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof RestroomCreate, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleTagChange = (tagType: string, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => {
      const newTags = prev.tags?.filter(tag => tag.tag_type !== tagType) || [];
      if (value) {
        newTags.push({ tag_type: tagType as any, tag_value: value });
      }
      return { ...prev, tags: newTags };
    });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!formData.name.trim() || !formData.address.trim()) {
      setError('請填寫廁所名稱和地址');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.create(formData);
      if (response.success) {
        setSuccess(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          navigate('/map');
        }, 2000);
      } else {
        setError(response.error || '新增廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('新增廁所時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error creating restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"

              color="inherit"

            </IconButton>

      </Box>
    );

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            ➕ 新增廁所
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Card>
          <CardContent>
            <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              分享你發現的廁所，幫助更多人找到適合的廁所！
            </Typography>

            {error && (
              <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                {error}
              </Alert>
            )}

            <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
              <Grid container spacing={3}>
                {/* 基本資訊 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    基本資訊
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="廁所名稱 *"
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('name', e.target.value)}
                    required
                    placeholder="例如：台大總圖一樓廁所"
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="地址 *"
                    value={formData.address}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('address', e.target.value)}
                    required
                    placeholder="例如：台北市大安區羅斯福路四段1號"
                    helperText="請輸入完整地址，系統會自動轉換為座標"
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    multiline
                    rows={3}
                    label="描述"
                    value={formData.description || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('description', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="分享這個廁所的特色或使用心得..."
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="照片網址"
                    value={formData.picture_url || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('picture_url', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="https://example.com/photo.jpg"
                    helperText="可選：上傳廁所照片的網址"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 標籤 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    廁所特色
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                    選擇這個廁所的特色標籤
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                {tagOptions.map((option) => (
                  <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} key={option.type}>
                    <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
                      <InputLabel>{option.label}</InputLabel>
                      <Select
                        value={formData.tags?.find(tag => tag.tag_type === option.type)?.tag_value || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleTagChange(option.type, e.target.value)}
                        label={option.label}
                      >
                        <MenuItem value="">不限</MenuItem>
                        {option.values.map((value) => (
                          <MenuItem key={value} value={value}>
                            {value}
                          </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                  </Grid>
                ))}

                {/* 已選擇的標籤 */}
                {formData.tags && formData.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                      已選擇的標籤：
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {formData.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          onDelete={() => handleTagChange(tag.tag_type, '')}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                )}

                {/* 提交按鈕 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
                      disabled={loading}
                    >
                      取消
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="submit"
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <SaveIcon />}
                      disabled={loading || !formData.name.trim() || !formData.address.trim()}
                    >
                      {loading ? '新增中...' : '新增廁所'}
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
            </Box>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AddRestroomPage;

                    value={formData.description || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('description', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="分享這個廁所的特色或使用心得..."
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="照片網址"
                    value={formData.picture_url || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('picture_url', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="https://example.com/photo.jpg"
                    helperText="可選：上傳廁所照片的網址"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 標籤 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    廁所特色
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                    選擇這個廁所的特色標籤
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                {tagOptions.map((option) => (
                  <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} key={option.type}>
                    <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
                      <InputLabel>{option.label}</InputLabel>
                      <Select
                        value={formData.tags?.find(tag => tag.tag_type === option.type)?.tag_value || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleTagChange(option.type, e.target.value)}
                        label={option.label}
                      >
                        <MenuItem value="">不限</MenuItem>
                        {option.values.map((value) => (
                          <MenuItem key={value} value={value}>
                            {value}
                          </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                  </Grid>
                ))}

                {/* 已選擇的標籤 */}
                {formData.tags && formData.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                      已選擇的標籤：
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {formData.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          onDelete={() => handleTagChange(tag.tag_type, '')}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                )}

                {/* 提交按鈕 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
                      disabled={loading}
                    >
                      取消
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="submit"
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <SaveIcon />}
                      disabled={loading || !formData.name.trim() || !formData.address.trim()}
                    >
                      {loading ? '新增中...' : '新增廁所'}
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
            </Box>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AddRestroomPage;

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Button,
  TextField,
  FormControl,
  InputLabel,
  Select,
  MenuItem,
  Chip,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Grid,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  Tabs,
  Tab,
  Paper,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Save as SaveIcon,
  LocationOn as LocationOnIcon,
  Edit as EditIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { RestroomCreate } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../services/api';
import MapView from '../components/Map/MapView';

const AddRestroomPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [tabValue, setTabValue] = useState(0);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<RestroomCreate>({
    name: '',
    address: '',
    description: '',
    picture_url: '',
    tags: [],
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [selectedLocation, setSelectedLocation] = useState<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>(null);
  const [selectedAddress, setSelectedAddress] = useState<string>('');

  const tagOptions = [
    { type: 'bidet', label: '免治馬桶', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'smell', label: '氣味', values: ['良好', '普通', '不佳'] },
    { type: 'lighting', label: '光線', values: ['明亮', '昏暗'] },
    { type: 'accessible', label: '無障礙設施', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'tissue_supply', label: '衛生紙供應', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'open_24h', label: '24小時開放', values: ['是', '否'] },
  ];

  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof RestroomCreate, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleTabChange = (_event: React.SyntheticEvent, newValue: number) => {
    setTabValue(newValue);
  };

  const handleMapClick = (location: { lat: number; lng: number }) => {
    setSelectedLocation(location);
    // 這裡可以添加反向地理編碼來獲取地址
    setSelectedAddress(`緯度: ${location.lat.toFixed(6)}, 經度: ${location.lng.toFixed(6)}`);
  };

  const handleTagChange = (tagType: string, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => {
      const newTags = prev.tags?.filter(tag => tag.tag_type !== tagType) || [];
      if (value) {
        newTags.push({ tag_type: tagType as any, tag_value: value });
      }
      return { ...prev, tags: newTags };
    });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      setError('請填寫廁所名稱');
      return;
    }

    // 根據選擇的方式設定地址
    let finalAddress = '';
    if (tabValue === 0) {
      // 地圖選擇模式
      if (!selectedLocation) {
        setError('請在地圖上點選位置');
        return;
      }
      finalAddress = selectedAddress;
    } else {
      // 手動輸入模式
      if (!formData.address.trim()) {
        setError('請填寫地址');
        return;
      }
      finalAddress = formData.address;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const submitData = {
        ...formData,
        address: finalAddress,
        latitude: selectedLocation?.lat,
        longitude: selectedLocation?.lng,
      };
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.create(submitData);
      if (response.success) {
        setSuccess(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          navigate('/map');
        }, 2000);
      } else {
        setError(response.error || '新增廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('新增廁所時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error creating restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (success) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 4 }}>
          <Alert severity="success" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
            廁所新增成功！正在跳轉到地圖頁面...
          </Alert>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            ➕ 新增廁所
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Card>
          <CardContent>
            <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              分享你發現的廁所，幫助更多人找到適合的廁所！
            </Typography>

            {error && (
              <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                {error}
              </Alert>
            )}

            <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
              <Grid container spacing={3}>
                {/* 基本資訊 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    基本資訊
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="廁所名稱 *"
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('name', e.target.value)}
                    required
                    placeholder="例如：台大總圖一樓廁所"
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="地址 *"
                    value={formData.address}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('address', e.target.value)}
                    required
                    placeholder="例如：台北市大安區羅斯福路四段1號"
                    helperText="請輸入完整地址，系統會自動轉換為座標"
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    multiline
                    rows={3}
                    label="描述"
                    value={formData.description || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('description', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="分享這個廁所的特色或使用心得..."
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="照片網址"
                    value={formData.picture_url || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('picture_url', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="https://example.com/photo.jpg"
                    helperText="可選：上傳廁所照片的網址"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 標籤 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    廁所特色
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                    選擇這個廁所的特色標籤
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                {tagOptions.map((option) => (
                  <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} key={option.type}>
                    <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
                      <InputLabel>{option.label}</InputLabel>
                      <Select
                        value={formData.tags?.find(tag => tag.tag_type === option.type)?.tag_value || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleTagChange(option.type, e.target.value)}
                        label={option.label}
                      >
                        <MenuItem value="">不限</MenuItem>
                        {option.values.map((value) => (
                          <MenuItem key={value} value={value}>
                            {value}
                          </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                  </Grid>
                ))}

                {/* 已選擇的標籤 */}
                {formData.tags && formData.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                      已選擇的標籤：
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {formData.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          onDelete={() => handleTagChange(tag.tag_type, '')}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                )}

                {/* 提交按鈕 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
                      disabled={loading}
                    >
                      取消
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="submit"
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <SaveIcon />}
                      disabled={loading || !formData.name.trim() || !formData.address.trim()}
                    >
                      {loading ? '新增中...' : '新增廁所'}
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
            </Box>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AddRestroomPage;

            </Box>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AddRestroomPage;

現在讓我更新表單內容，根據選擇的方式顯示不同的輸入方式：


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Button,
  TextField,
  FormControl,
  InputLabel,
  Select,
  MenuItem,
  Chip,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Grid,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  Tabs,
  Tab,
  Paper,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Save as SaveIcon,
  LocationOn as LocationOnIcon,
  Edit as EditIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { RestroomCreate } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../services/api';
import MapView from '../components/Map/MapView';

const AddRestroomPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [tabValue, setTabValue] = useState(0);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<RestroomCreate>({
    name: '',
    address: '',
    description: '',
    picture_url: '',
    tags: [],
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [selectedLocation, setSelectedLocation] = useState<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>(null);
  const [selectedAddress, setSelectedAddress] = useState<string>('');

  const tagOptions = [
    { type: 'bidet', label: '免治馬桶', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'smell', label: '氣味', values: ['良好', '普通', '不佳'] },
    { type: 'lighting', label: '光線', values: ['明亮', '昏暗'] },
    { type: 'accessible', label: '無障礙設施', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'tissue_supply', label: '衛生紙供應', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'open_24h', label: '24小時開放', values: ['是', '否'] },
  ];

  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof RestroomCreate, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleTabChange = (_event: React.SyntheticEvent, newValue: number) => {
    setTabValue(newValue);
  };

  const handleMapClick = (location: { lat: number; lng: number }) => {
    setSelectedLocation(location);
    // 這裡可以添加反向地理編碼來獲取地址
    setSelectedAddress(`緯度: ${location.lat.toFixed(6)}, 經度: ${location.lng.toFixed(6)}`);
  };

  const handleTagChange = (tagType: string, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => {
      const newTags = prev.tags?.filter(tag => tag.tag_type !== tagType) || [];
      if (value) {
        newTags.push({ tag_type: tagType as any, tag_value: value });
      }
      return { ...prev, tags: newTags };
    });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      setError('請填寫廁所名稱');
      return;
    }

    // 根據選擇的方式設定地址
    let finalAddress = '';
    if (tabValue === 0) {
      // 地圖選擇模式
      if (!selectedLocation) {
        setError('請在地圖上點選位置');
        return;
      }
      finalAddress = selectedAddress;
    } else {
      // 手動輸入模式
      if (!formData.address.trim()) {
        setError('請填寫地址');
        return;
      }
      finalAddress = formData.address;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const submitData = {
        ...formData,
        address: finalAddress,
        latitude: selectedLocation?.lat,
        longitude: selectedLocation?.lng,
      };
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.create(submitData);
      if (response.success) {
        setSuccess(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          navigate('/map');
        }, 2000);
      } else {
        setError(response.error || '新增廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('新增廁所時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error creating restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (success) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 4 }}>
          <Alert severity="success" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
            廁所新增成功！正在跳轉到地圖頁面...
          </Alert>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            ➕ 新增廁所
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Card>
          <CardContent>
            <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              分享你發現的廁所，幫助更多人找到適合的廁所！
            </Typography>

            {error && (
              <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                {error}
              </Alert>
            )}

            {/* 選擇新增方式 */}
            <Box sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: 'divider', mb: 3 }}>
              <Tabs value={tabValue} onChange={handleTabChange}>
                <Tab 
                  icon={<LocationOnIcon />} 
                  label="地圖上選擇位置" 
                  iconPosition="start"
                />
                <Tab 
                  icon={<EditIcon />} 
                  label="手動輸入地址" 
                  iconPosition="start"
                />
              </Tabs>
            </Box>

            <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
              <Grid container spacing={3}>
                {/* 基本資訊 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    基本資訊
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="廁所名稱 *"
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('name', e.target.value)}
                    required
                    placeholder="例如：台大總圖一樓廁所"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 根據選擇的方式顯示不同的地址輸入 */}
                {tabValue === 0 ? (
                  // 地圖選擇模式
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Paper sx={{ p: 2, mb: 2 }}>
                      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                        📍 在地圖上選擇位置
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                        點擊地圖上的位置來選擇廁所位置
                      </Typography>
                      {selectedLocation && (
                        <Alert severity="success" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                          已選擇位置：{selectedAddress}
                        </Alert>
                      )}
                    </Paper>
                    <Box sx={{ height: '400px', mb: 2 }}>
                      <MapView
                        onRestroomSelect={handleMapClick}
                        selectedRestroom={null}
                        filters={{}}
                      />
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                ) : (
                  // 手動輸入模式
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      label="地址 *"
                      value={formData.address}
                      onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('address', e.target.value)}
                      required
                      placeholder="例如：台北市大安區羅斯福路四段1號"
                      helperText="請輸入完整地址，系統會自動轉換為座標"
                    />
                  </Grid>
                )}

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    multiline
                    rows={3}
                    label="描述"
                    value={formData.description || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('description', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="分享這個廁所的特色或使用心得..."
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="照片網址"
                    value={formData.picture_url || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('picture_url', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="https://example.com/photo.jpg"
                    helperText="可選：上傳廁所照片的網址"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 標籤 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    廁所特色
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                    選擇這個廁所的特色標籤
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                {tagOptions.map((option) => (
                  <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} key={option.type}>
                    <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
                      <InputLabel>{option.label}</InputLabel>
                      <Select
                        value={formData.tags?.find(tag => tag.tag_type === option.type)?.tag_value || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleTagChange(option.type, e.target.value)}
                        label={option.label}
                      >
                        <MenuItem value="">不限</MenuItem>
                        {option.values.map((value) => (
                          <MenuItem key={value} value={value}>
                            {value}
                          </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                  </Grid>
                ))}

                {/* 已選擇的標籤 */}
                {formData.tags && formData.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                      已選擇的標籤：
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {formData.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          onDelete={() => handleTagChange(tag.tag_type, '')}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                )}

                {/* 提交按鈕 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
                      disabled={loading}
                    >
                      取消
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="submit"
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <SaveIcon />}
                      disabled={loading || !formData.name.trim() || !formData.address.trim()}
                    >
                      {loading ? '新增中...' : '新增廁所'}
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
            </Box>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </Container>
    </Box>

export default AddRestroomPage;

現在我需要修改 MapView 組件來支援點擊地圖選擇位置的功能。讓我先創建一個專門用於位置選擇的地圖組件：


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { GoogleMap, useJsApiLoader, Marker } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { Box, Typography, CircularProgress } from '@mui/material';
import { GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG, DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS, NTU_COORDINATES } from '../../services/googleMaps';

interface LocationPickerProps {
  onLocationSelect: (location: { lat: number; lng: number }) => void;
  selectedLocation?: { lat: number; lng: number } | null;
}

const LocationPicker: React.FC<LocationPickerProps> = ({ 
  onLocationSelect, 
  selectedLocation 
}) => {
  const [mapCenter] = useState(NTU_COORDINATES);
  const [mapZoom] = useState(15);

  const { isLoaded, loadError } = useJsApiLoader({
    id: 'google-map-script',
    googleMapsApiKey: GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG.apiKey,
    libraries: ['places', 'geometry'],
  });

  const handleMapClick = useCallback((event: google.maps.MapMouseEvent) => {
    if (event.latLng) {
      const location = {
        lat: event.latLng.lat(),
        lng: event.latLng.lng(),
      };
      onLocationSelect(location);
    }
  }, [onLocationSelect]);

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <Typography color="error">
          Error loading Google Maps. Please check your API key.
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
        <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>Loading map...</Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: '100%', height: '400px', position: 'relative' }}>
      <GoogleMap
        mapContainerStyle={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
        center={mapCenter}
        zoom={mapZoom}
        options={DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS}
        onClick={handleMapClick}
      >
        {selectedLocation && (
          <Marker
            position={selectedLocation}
            title="選擇的位置"
            icon={{
              url: `data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,${encodeURIComponent(`
                <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                  <path d="M12 2C8.13 2 5 5.13 5 9c0 5.25 7 13 7 13s7-7.75 7-13c0-3.87-3.13-7-7-7zm0 9.5c-1.38 0-2.5-1.12-2.5-2.5s1.12-2.5 2.5-2.5 2.5 1.12 2.5 2.5-1.12 2.5-2.5 2.5z" fill="#1976d2"/>
                </svg>
              `)}`,
              scaledSize: new google.maps.Size(32, 32),
              anchor: new google.maps.Point(16, 32),
            }}
          />
        )}
      </GoogleMap>
      
      <Box
        sx={{
          position: 'absolute',
          top: 10,
          left: 10,
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
          padding: 1,
          borderRadius: 1,
          boxShadow: 1,
        }}
      >
        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
          點擊地圖選擇位置
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default LocationPicker;

                      helperText="請輸入完整地址，系統會自動轉換為座標"
                    />
                  </Grid>
                )}

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    multiline
                    rows={3}
                    label="描述"
                    value={formData.description || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('description', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="分享這個廁所的特色或使用心得..."
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="照片網址"
                    value={formData.picture_url || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('picture_url', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="https://example.com/photo.jpg"
                    helperText="可選：上傳廁所照片的網址"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 標籤 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    廁所特色
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                    選擇這個廁所的特色標籤
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                {tagOptions.map((option) => (
                  <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} key={option.type}>
                    <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
                      <InputLabel>{option.label}</InputLabel>
                      <Select
                        value={formData.tags?.find(tag => tag.tag_type === option.type)?.tag_value || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleTagChange(option.type, e.target.value)}
                        label={option.label}
                      >
                        <MenuItem value="">不限</MenuItem>
                        {option.values.map((value) => (
                          <MenuItem key={value} value={value}>
                            {value}
                          </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                  </Grid>
                ))}

                {/* 已選擇的標籤 */}
                {formData.tags && formData.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                      已選擇的標籤：
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {formData.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          onDelete={() => handleTagChange(tag.tag_type, '')}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                )}

                {/* 提交按鈕 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
                      disabled={loading}
                    >
                      取消
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="submit"
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <SaveIcon />}
                      disabled={loading || !formData.name.trim() || !formData.address.trim()}
                    >
                      {loading ? '新增中...' : '新增廁所'}
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
            </Box>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AddRestroomPage;

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Button,
  TextField,
  FormControl,
  InputLabel,
  Select,
  MenuItem,
  Chip,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Grid,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  Tabs,
  Tab,
  Paper,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Save as SaveIcon,
  LocationOn as LocationOnIcon,
  Edit as EditIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { RestroomCreate } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../services/api';
import LocationPicker from '../components/Map/LocationPicker';

const AddRestroomPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [tabValue, setTabValue] = useState(0);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<RestroomCreate>({
    name: '',
    address: '',
    description: '',
    picture_url: '',
    tags: [],
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [selectedLocation, setSelectedLocation] = useState<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>(null);
  const [selectedAddress, setSelectedAddress] = useState<string>('');

  const tagOptions = [
    { type: 'bidet', label: '免治馬桶', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'smell', label: '氣味', values: ['良好', '普通', '不佳'] },
    { type: 'lighting', label: '光線', values: ['明亮', '昏暗'] },
    { type: 'accessible', label: '無障礙設施', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'tissue_supply', label: '衛生紙供應', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'open_24h', label: '24小時開放', values: ['是', '否'] },
  ];

  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof RestroomCreate, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleTabChange = (_event: React.SyntheticEvent, newValue: number) => {
    setTabValue(newValue);
  };

  const handleLocationSelect = (location: { lat: number; lng: number }) => {
    setSelectedLocation(location);
    // 這裡可以添加反向地理編碼來獲取地址
    setSelectedAddress(`緯度: ${location.lat.toFixed(6)}, 經度: ${location.lng.toFixed(6)}`);
  };

  const handleTagChange = (tagType: string, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => {
      const newTags = prev.tags?.filter(tag => tag.tag_type !== tagType) || [];
      if (value) {
        newTags.push({ tag_type: tagType as any, tag_value: value });
      }
      return { ...prev, tags: newTags };
    });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      setError('請填寫廁所名稱');
      return;
    }

    // 根據選擇的方式設定地址
    let finalAddress = '';
    if (tabValue === 0) {
      // 地圖選擇模式
      if (!selectedLocation) {
        setError('請在地圖上點選位置');
        return;
      }
      finalAddress = selectedAddress;
    } else {
      // 手動輸入模式
      if (!formData.address.trim()) {
        setError('請填寫地址');
        return;
      }
      finalAddress = formData.address;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const submitData = {
        ...formData,
        address: finalAddress,
        latitude: selectedLocation?.lat,
        longitude: selectedLocation?.lng,
      };
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.create(submitData);
      if (response.success) {
        setSuccess(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          navigate('/map');
        }, 2000);
      } else {
        setError(response.error || '新增廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('新增廁所時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error creating restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (success) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 4 }}>
          <Alert severity="success" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
            廁所新增成功！正在跳轉到地圖頁面...
          </Alert>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            ➕ 新增廁所
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Card>
          <CardContent>
            <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              分享你發現的廁所，幫助更多人找到適合的廁所！
            </Typography>

            {error && (
              <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                {error}
              </Alert>
            )}

            {/* 選擇新增方式 */}
            <Box sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: 'divider', mb: 3 }}>
              <Tabs value={tabValue} onChange={handleTabChange}>
                <Tab 
                  icon={<LocationOnIcon />} 
                  label="地圖上選擇位置" 
                  iconPosition="start"
                />
                <Tab 
                  icon={<EditIcon />} 
                  label="手動輸入地址" 
                  iconPosition="start"
                />
              </Tabs>
            </Box>

            <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
              <Grid container spacing={3}>
                {/* 基本資訊 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    基本資訊
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="廁所名稱 *"
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('name', e.target.value)}
                    required
                    placeholder="例如：台大總圖一樓廁所"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 根據選擇的方式顯示不同的地址輸入 */}
                {tabValue === 0 ? (
                  // 地圖選擇模式
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Paper sx={{ p: 2, mb: 2 }}>
                      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                        📍 在地圖上選擇位置
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                        點擊地圖上的位置來選擇廁所位置
                      </Typography>
                      {selectedLocation && (
                        <Alert severity="success" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                          已選擇位置：{selectedAddress}
                        </Alert>
                      )}
                    </Paper>
                    <Box sx={{ height: '400px', mb: 2 }}>
                      <MapView
                        onRestroomSelect={handleMapClick}
                        selectedRestroom={null}
                        filters={{}}
                      />
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                ) : (
                  // 手動輸入模式
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      label="地址 *"
                      value={formData.address}
                      onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('address', e.target.value)}
                      required
                      placeholder="例如：台北市大安區羅斯福路四段1號"
                      helperText="請輸入完整地址，系統會自動轉換為座標"
                    />
                  </Grid>
                )}

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    multiline
                    rows={3}
                    label="描述"
                    value={formData.description || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('description', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="分享這個廁所的特色或使用心得..."
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="照片網址"
                    value={formData.picture_url || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('picture_url', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="https://example.com/photo.jpg"
                    helperText="可選：上傳廁所照片的網址"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 標籤 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    廁所特色
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                    選擇這個廁所的特色標籤
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                {tagOptions.map((option) => (
                  <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} key={option.type}>
                    <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
                      <InputLabel>{option.label}</InputLabel>
                      <Select
                        value={formData.tags?.find(tag => tag.tag_type === option.type)?.tag_value || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleTagChange(option.type, e.target.value)}
                        label={option.label}
                      >
                        <MenuItem value="">不限</MenuItem>
                        {option.values.map((value) => (
                          <MenuItem key={value} value={value}>
                            {value}
                          </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                  </Grid>
                ))}

                {/* 已選擇的標籤 */}
                {formData.tags && formData.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                      已選擇的標籤：
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {formData.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          onDelete={() => handleTagChange(tag.tag_type, '')}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                )}

                {/* 提交按鈕 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
                      disabled={loading}
                    >
                      取消
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="submit"
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <SaveIcon />}
                      disabled={loading || !formData.name.trim() || !formData.address.trim()}
                    >
                      {loading ? '新增中...' : '新增廁所'}
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
            </Box>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AddRestroomPage;
