                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="照片網址"
                    value={formData.picture_url || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('picture_url', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="https://example.com/photo.jpg"
                    helperText="可選：上傳廁所照片的網址"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 標籤 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    廁所特色
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                    選擇這個廁所的特色標籤
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                {tagOptions.map((option) => (
                  <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} key={option.type}>
                    <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
                      <InputLabel>{option.label}</InputLabel>
                      <Select
                        value={formData.tags?.find(tag => tag.tag_type === option.type)?.tag_value || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleTagChange(option.type, e.target.value)}
                        label={option.label}
                      >
                        <MenuItem value="">不限</MenuItem>
                        {option.values.map((value) => (
                          <MenuItem key={value} value={value}>
                            {value}
                          </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                  </Grid>
                ))}

                {/* 已選擇的標籤 */}
                {formData.tags && formData.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                      已選擇的標籤：
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {formData.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          onDelete={() => handleTagChange(tag.tag_type, '')}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                )}

                {/* 提交按鈕 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
                      disabled={loading}
                    >
                      取消
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="submit"
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <SaveIcon />}
                      disabled={loading || !formData.name.trim() || !formData.address.trim()}
                    >
                      {loading ? '新增中...' : '新增廁所'}
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
            </Box>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AddRestroomPage;

```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Button,
  TextField,
  FormControl,
  InputLabel,
  Select,
  MenuItem,
  Chip,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Grid,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  Tabs,
  Tab,
  Paper,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Save as SaveIcon,
  LocationOn as LocationOnIcon,
  Edit as EditIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { RestroomCreate } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../services/api';
import LocationPicker from '../components/Map/LocationPicker';

const AddRestroomPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [tabValue, setTabValue] = useState(0);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<RestroomCreate>({
    name: '',
    address: '',
    description: '',
    picture_url: '',
    tags: [],
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [selectedLocation, setSelectedLocation] = useState<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>(null);
  const [selectedAddress, setSelectedAddress] = useState<string>('');

  const tagOptions = [
    { type: 'bidet', label: '免治馬桶', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'smell', label: '氣味', values: ['良好', '普通', '不佳'] },
    { type: 'lighting', label: '光線', values: ['明亮', '昏暗'] },
    { type: 'accessible', label: '無障礙設施', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'tissue_supply', label: '衛生紙供應', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'open_24h', label: '24小時開放', values: ['是', '否'] },
  ];

  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof RestroomCreate, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleTabChange = (_event: React.SyntheticEvent, newValue: number) => {
    setTabValue(newValue);
  };

  const handleLocationSelect = (location: { lat: number; lng: number }) => {
    setSelectedLocation(location);
    // 這裡可以添加反向地理編碼來獲取地址
    setSelectedAddress(`緯度: ${location.lat.toFixed(6)}, 經度: ${location.lng.toFixed(6)}`);
  };

  const handleTagChange = (tagType: string, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => {
      const newTags = prev.tags?.filter(tag => tag.tag_type !== tagType) || [];
      if (value) {
        newTags.push({ tag_type: tagType as any, tag_value: value });
      }
      return { ...prev, tags: newTags };
    });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      setError('請填寫廁所名稱');
      return;
    }

    // 根據選擇的方式設定地址
    let finalAddress = '';
    if (tabValue === 0) {
      // 地圖選擇模式
      if (!selectedLocation) {
        setError('請在地圖上點選位置');
        return;
      }
      finalAddress = selectedAddress;
    } else {
      // 手動輸入模式
      if (!formData.address.trim()) {
        setError('請填寫地址');
        return;
      }
      finalAddress = formData.address;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const submitData = {
        ...formData,
        address: finalAddress,
        latitude: selectedLocation?.lat,
        longitude: selectedLocation?.lng,
      };
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.create(submitData);
      if (response.success) {
        setSuccess(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          navigate('/map');
        }, 2000);
      } else {
        setError(response.error || '新增廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('新增廁所時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error creating restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (success) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 4 }}>
          <Alert severity="success" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
            廁所新增成功！正在跳轉到地圖頁面...
          </Alert>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            ➕ 新增廁所
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Card>
          <CardContent>
            <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              分享你發現的廁所，幫助更多人找到適合的廁所！
            </Typography>

            {error && (
              <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                {error}
              </Alert>
            )}

            {/* 選擇新增方式 */}
            <Box sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: 'divider', mb: 3 }}>
              <Tabs value={tabValue} onChange={handleTabChange}>
                <Tab 
                  icon={<LocationOnIcon />} 
                  label="地圖上選擇位置" 
                  iconPosition="start"
                />
                <Tab 
                  icon={<EditIcon />} 
                  label="手動輸入地址" 
                  iconPosition="start"
                />
              </Tabs>
            </Box>

            <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
              <Grid container spacing={3}>
                {/* 基本資訊 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    基本資訊
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="廁所名稱 *"
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('name', e.target.value)}
                    required
                    placeholder="例如：台大總圖一樓廁所"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 根據選擇的方式顯示不同的地址輸入 */}
                {tabValue === 0 ? (
                  // 地圖選擇模式
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Paper sx={{ p: 2, mb: 2 }}>
                      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                        📍 在地圖上選擇位置
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                        點擊地圖上的位置來選擇廁所位置
                      </Typography>
                      {selectedLocation && (
                        <Alert severity="success" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                          已選擇位置：{selectedAddress}
                        </Alert>
                      )}
                    </Paper>
                    <Box sx={{ height: '400px', mb: 2 }}>
                      <LocationPicker
                        onLocationSelect={handleLocationSelect}
                        selectedLocation={selectedLocation}
                      />
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                ) : (
                  // 手動輸入模式
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      label="地址 *"
                      value={formData.address}
                      onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('address', e.target.value)}
                      required
                      placeholder="例如：台北市大安區羅斯福路四段1號"
                      helperText="請輸入完整地址，系統會自動轉換為座標"
                    />
                  </Grid>
                )}

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    multiline
                    rows={3}
                    label="描述"
                    value={formData.description || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('description', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="分享這個廁所的特色或使用心得..."
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="照片網址"
                    value={formData.picture_url || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('picture_url', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="https://example.com/photo.jpg"
                    helperText="可選：上傳廁所照片的網址"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 標籤 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    廁所特色
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                    選擇這個廁所的特色標籤
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                {tagOptions.map((option) => (
                  <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} key={option.type}>
                    <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
                      <InputLabel>{option.label}</InputLabel>
                      <Select
                        value={formData.tags?.find(tag => tag.tag_type === option.type)?.tag_value || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleTagChange(option.type, e.target.value)}
                        label={option.label}
                      >
                        <MenuItem value="">不限</MenuItem>
                        {option.values.map((value) => (
                          <MenuItem key={value} value={value}>
                            {value}
                          </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                  </Grid>
                ))}

                {/* 已選擇的標籤 */}
                {formData.tags && formData.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                      已選擇的標籤：
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {formData.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          onDelete={() => handleTagChange(tag.tag_type, '')}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                )}

                {/* 提交按鈕 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
                      disabled={loading}
                    >
                      取消
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="submit"
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <SaveIcon />}
                      disabled={
                        loading || 
                        !formData.name.trim() || 
                        (tabValue === 0 && !selectedLocation) ||
                        (tabValue === 1 && !formData.address.trim())
                      }
                    >
                      {loading ? '新增中...' : '新增廁所'}
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
            </Box>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AddRestroomPage;

```markdown
# 🗺️ 位置選擇功能 - 新增廁所改進

## 🎯 功能概述

為 NTU 廁所地圖應用程式新增了更直觀的位置選擇方式，讓用戶可以選擇在地圖上點選位置或手動輸入地址來新增廁所。

## ✨ 新功能特色

### 1. **雙重選擇方式**
- **📍 地圖上選擇位置**：直接在地圖上點擊選擇廁所位置
- **✏️ 手動輸入地址**：傳統的文字輸入方式

### 2. **直觀的用戶介面**
- **標籤頁設計**：清楚區分兩種選擇方式
- **即時反饋**：選擇位置後立即顯示座標資訊
- **視覺提示**：地圖上顯示選擇的位置標記

### 3. **智能驗證**
- **地圖模式**：必須點擊地圖選擇位置
- **輸入模式**：必須填寫完整地址
- **動態按鈕**：根據選擇方式啟用/禁用提交按鈕

## 🔧 技術實現

### 新增組件

#### 1. **LocationPicker 組件**
```tsx
// frontend/src/components/Map/LocationPicker.tsx
- 專門用於位置選擇的地圖組件
- 支援點擊地圖選擇位置
- 顯示選擇的位置標記
- 提供操作提示
```

#### 2. **改進的 AddRestroomPage**
```tsx
// frontend/src/pages/AddRestroomPage.tsx
- 新增標籤頁切換功能
- 條件式渲染不同輸入方式
- 智能表單驗證
- 統一的提交邏輯
```

### 核心功能

#### 1. **標籤頁切換**
```tsx
<Tabs value={tabValue} onChange={handleTabChange}>
  <Tab icon={<LocationOnIcon />} label="地圖上選擇位置" />
  <Tab icon={<EditIcon />} label="手動輸入地址" />
</Tabs>
```

#### 2. **地圖位置選擇**
```tsx
const handleLocationSelect = (location: { lat: number; lng: number }) => {
  setSelectedLocation(location);
  setSelectedAddress(`緯度: ${location.lat.toFixed(6)}, 經度: ${location.lng.toFixed(6)}`);
};
```

#### 3. **智能表單驗證**
```tsx
disabled={
  loading || 
  !formData.name.trim() || 
  (tabValue === 0 && !selectedLocation) ||
  (tabValue === 1 && !formData.address.trim())
}
```

## 📱 用戶體驗流程

### 地圖選擇模式
1. **選擇標籤**：點擊「地圖上選擇位置」
2. **查看地圖**：顯示互動式 Google Maps
3. **點擊位置**：在地圖上點擊選擇廁所位置
4. **確認選擇**：顯示選擇的座標資訊
5. **填寫其他資訊**：廁所名稱、描述、標籤等
6. **提交**：完成新增

### 手動輸入模式
1. **選擇標籤**：點擊「手動輸入地址」
2. **輸入地址**：在文字框中輸入完整地址
3. **填寫其他資訊**：廁所名稱、描述、標籤等
4. **提交**：系統自動轉換地址為座標

## 🎨 視覺設計

### 1. **地圖選擇介面**
- **地圖高度**：400px，適合操作
- **位置標記**：藍色圖釘，清楚標示選擇位置
- **操作提示**：左上角顯示「點擊地圖選擇位置」
- **成功提示**：選擇後顯示綠色確認訊息

### 2. **標籤頁設計**
- **圖示**：📍 地圖圖示 vs ✏️ 編輯圖示
- **標籤**：清楚說明功能
- **切換**：平滑的標籤頁切換動畫

### 3. **響應式設計**
- **桌面版**：完整功能顯示
- **平板版**：適配中等螢幕
- **手機版**：優化觸控操作

## 🔄 資料流程

### 1. **地圖選擇流程**
```
用戶點擊地圖 → handleLocationSelect → 更新 selectedLocation → 顯示座標資訊 → 提交時包含座標
```

### 2. **手動輸入流程**
```
用戶輸入地址 → 更新 formData.address → 提交時使用地址 → 後端進行地理編碼
```

### 3. **統一提交邏輯**
```tsx
const submitData = {
  ...formData,
  address: finalAddress,
  latitude: selectedLocation?.lat,
  longitude: selectedLocation?.lng,
};
```

## 🚀 優勢

### 1. **用戶友好**
- ✅ 直觀的地圖操作
- ✅ 靈活的選擇方式
- ✅ 即時視覺反饋

### 2. **技術優勢**
- ✅ 模組化設計
- ✅ 可重用的組件
- ✅ 型別安全

### 3. **擴展性**
- ✅ 易於添加新功能
- ✅ 支援反向地理編碼
- ✅ 可整合更多地圖功能

## 📋 使用說明

### 開發者
1. **LocationPicker 組件**：可重複使用於其他需要位置選擇的場景
2. **AddRestroomPage**：展示了如何整合地圖選擇功能
3. **型別定義**：確保型別安全的位置資料處理

### 用戶
1. **選擇方式**：根據喜好選擇地圖點選或手動輸入
2. **操作簡單**：直觀的介面設計
3. **即時反饋**：清楚知道選擇狀態

## 🔮 未來擴展

### 1. **反向地理編碼**
- 地圖選擇後自動獲取地址
- 顯示更詳細的位置資訊

### 2. **位置搜尋**
- 整合 Google Places API
- 支援地址自動完成

### 3. **位置驗證**
- 檢查位置是否在合理範圍內
- 防止重複位置提交

## 🎉 總結

這個位置選擇功能大大提升了用戶新增廁所的體驗，提供了更直觀和靈活的方式來指定廁所位置。無論是喜歡視覺化操作的用戶還是習慣文字輸入的用戶，都能找到適合自己的方式。

通過模組化的設計，這個功能也為未來的擴展奠定了良好的基礎，可以輕鬆添加更多地圖相關的功能。

#### 核心功能：
- 標籤頁切換（地圖選擇 vs 手動輸入）
- 地圖點擊位置選擇
- 智能表單驗證
- 統一提交邏輯

### 📱 用戶體驗：

#### 地圖選擇模式：
1. 點擊「地圖上選擇位置」標籤
2. 在地圖上點擊選擇廁所位置
3. 查看選擇的座標資訊
4. 填寫其他廁所資訊
5. 提交完成

#### 手動輸入模式：
1. 點擊「手動輸入地址」標籤
2. 在文字框中輸入完整地址
3. 填寫其他廁所資訊
4. 提交完成

### 🎯 優勢：

- **用戶友好**：直觀的地圖操作和靈活的選擇方式
- **技術優勢**：模組化設計、可重用組件、型別安全
- **擴展性**：易於添加新功能，支援反向地理編碼

現在你的用戶可以選擇最適合自己的方式來新增廁所位置了！無論是喜歡視覺化操作的用戶還是習慣文字輸入的用戶，都能找到適合的方式。🎊

**User**

那個被ignore掉的dist資料夾是幹嘛用的

---

**Cursor**

`dist` 資料夾是 **建置輸出目錄**，讓我解釋一下它的用途：

## 📁 `dist` 資料夾的作用

### 1. **建置產物存放**
- 當你執行 `npm run build` 時，Vite 會將你的原始碼編譯、打包、優化
- 所有處理後的檔案都會放在 `dist` 資料夾中
- 包含：HTML、CSS、JavaScript 等最終要部署的檔案

### 2. **為什麼要 ignore 掉？**

#### ✅ **應該忽略的原因：**
- **自動生成**：每次 `npm run build` 都會重新產生
- **檔案很大**：包含所有依賴和編譯後的代碼
- **版本控制不需要**：原始碼已經在 Git 中了
- **環境相關**：不同環境建置結果可能不同

#### 🔄 **開發流程：**
```
原始碼 (src/) → npm run build → dist/ → 部署到伺服器
```

### 3. **你的專案中的 dist 內容**
從你看到的檔案：
- `dist/assets/index-JPW7w7tt.js` - 編譯後的 JavaScript 檔案
- `dist/assets/index-BmeGit54.css` - 編譯後的 CSS 檔案  
- `dist/index.html` - 最終的 HTML 檔案

### 4. **部署時的使用**
- 將 `dist` 資料夾的內容上傳到網頁伺服器
- 用戶訪問網站時，伺服器提供 `dist` 中的檔案
- 這些是經過優化、壓縮的生產版本

## 💡 總結

`dist` 就像是一個「成品倉庫」，存放所有準備好要給用戶使用的檔案。因為它是自動產生的，所以不需要放在 Git 版本控制中，這就是為什麼要把它加到 `.gitignore` 的原因！

```plaintext
原始碼 (src/) → npm run build → dist/ → 部署到伺服器
```

**User**

我如果把database.sqlite ignore掉的話 是不是上傳上去的就沒有data了

---

**Cursor**

是的！你說得對，如果把 `database.sqlite` ignore 掉，上傳到伺服器後就沒有資料了。

## 🗄️ 資料庫檔案的處理方式

### 1. **SQLite 資料庫的特性**
- `database.sqlite` 是一個**檔案型資料庫**
- 所有資料都儲存在這個檔案中
- 如果檔案不存在，資料庫就是空的

### 2. **ignore 的影響**
```bash
# 如果 .gitignore 包含：
*.sqlite
database.sqlite
```
- ✅ 本地開發：正常使用
- ❌ 部署後：空的資料庫，沒有資料

### 3. **解決方案**

#### 方案 A：**不 ignore 資料庫**（適合小型專案）
```bash
# 在 .gitignore 中移除或註解掉：
# *.sqlite
# database.sqlite
```
- ✅ 簡單直接
- ✅ 資料會一起上傳
- ❌ 資料庫檔案會越來越大
- ❌ 版本控制會追蹤資料變更

#### 方案 B：**使用資料庫初始化腳本**（推薦）
```sql
-- 建立 schema.sql 檔案
CREATE TABLE users (...);
CREATE TABLE restrooms (...);
-- 插入初始資料
INSERT INTO users VALUES (...);
```

#### 方案 C：**使用環境變數設定資料庫**
```bash
# 開發環境
DATABASE_PATH=./database.sqlite

# 生產環境  
DATABASE_PATH=/var/lib/app/database.sqlite
```

### 4. **最佳實踐建議**

對於你的 NTU 廁所地圖專案，我建議：

1. **保留資料庫檔案**：暫時不要 ignore `database.sqlite`
2. **建立初始資料**：在 `schema.sql` 中加入一些範例資料
3. **未來升級**：考慮使用 PostgreSQL 或 MySQL

### 5. **修改建議**

你可以這樣調整 `.gitignore`：

```bash
# 註解掉資料庫忽略
# *.sqlite
# database.sqlite

# 或者只忽略開發用的測試資料庫
# test.sqlite
# dev.sqlite
```

這樣你的資料庫和資料就會一起上傳到伺服器了！🎯

```shellscript
# 如果 .gitignore 包含：
*.sqlite
database.sqlite
```

```shellscript
# 在 .gitignore 中移除或註解掉：
# *.sqlite
# database.sqlite
```

```sql
-- 建立 schema.sql 檔案
CREATE TABLE users (...);
CREATE TABLE restrooms (...);
-- 插入初始資料
INSERT INTO users VALUES (...);
```

```shellscript
# 開發環境
DATABASE_PATH=./database.sqlite

# 生產環境  
DATABASE_PATH=/var/lib/app/database.sqlite
```

# 或者只忽略開發用的測試資料庫

```

```markdown
# 📁 .gitignore 設定說明

## 🎯 修改內容

### 1. **主要 .gitignore 檔案**
- ✅ 保留 `database.sqlite` 檔案（資料庫會一起上傳）
- ✅ 忽略 `node_modules/` 目錄
- ✅ 忽略 `.env` 檔案（環境變數）
- ✅ 忽略 `dist/` 建置輸出目錄
- ✅ 忽略測試用的資料庫檔案

### 2. **後端 .gitignore**
- ✅ 保留主要資料庫檔案
- ✅ 忽略開發和測試資料庫
- ✅ 忽略建置輸出和依賴

### 3. **前端 .gitignore**
- ✅ 忽略建置輸出 `dist/`
- ✅ 忽略依賴 `node_modules/`
- ✅ 忽略環境變數檔案

## 📋 被忽略的檔案類型

### ✅ **正確忽略的檔案：**
- `node_modules/` - 依賴套件
- `.env` - 環境變數（包含敏感資訊）
- `dist/` - 建置輸出
- `*.log` - 日誌檔案
- `.DS_Store` - 系統檔案
- `test.sqlite` - 測試資料庫

### ✅ **保留追蹤的檔案：**
- `database.sqlite` - 主要資料庫（包含資料）
- `src/` - 原始碼
- `package.json` - 專案配置
- `README.md` - 說明文件

## 🔍 驗證結果

### Git 狀態檢查：
```bash
# 被忽略的檔案
backend/.env          # ✅ 環境變數被忽略
backend/node_modules/ # ✅ 依賴被忽略
backend/dist/         # ✅ 建置輸出被忽略
frontend/dist/        # ✅ 建置輸出被忽略

# 被追蹤的檔案
backend/database.sqlite # ✅ 資料庫檔案會被追蹤
backend/src/           # ✅ 原始碼會被追蹤
```

## 🚀 部署影響

### ✅ **優點：**
- 資料庫和資料會一起上傳到伺服器
- 部署後立即有資料可以使用
- 不需要額外的資料庫初始化步驟

### ⚠️ **注意事項：**
- 資料庫檔案會隨著資料增加而變大
- 版本控制會追蹤資料變更
- 建議未來考慮使用雲端資料庫

## 📝 使用建議

### 開發階段：
1. 正常開發，資料庫檔案會被追蹤
2. 測試資料使用 `test.sqlite`（會被忽略）
3. 敏感資訊放在 `.env`（會被忽略）

### 部署階段：
1. 資料庫檔案會一起上傳
2. 伺服器上會有完整的資料
3. 不需要額外的資料庫設定

## 🎉 總結

現在的 `.gitignore` 設定：
- ✅ 保護敏感資訊（`.env`）
- ✅ 避免不必要的檔案（`node_modules/`, `dist/`）
- ✅ 保留重要資料（`database.sqlite`）
- ✅ 支援完整的部署流程

你的專案現在可以安全地進行版本控制，同時確保部署時有完整的資料！🎯

## 🎯 **關鍵寬度控制邏輯**

### **響應式斷點：**
- `xs` (0-599px): 手機
- `sm` (600-899px): 平板  
- `md` (900px+): 桌面

### **寬度分配策略：**
1. **桌面版 (md+)**: 篩選面板固定 320px + 地圖佔剩餘空間
2. **平板版 (sm)**: 篩選面板隱藏，地圖全寬
3. **手機版 (xs)**: 篩選面板隱藏，地圖全寬 + 底部抽屜

### **核心 CSS 屬性：**
- `flexGrow: 1` - 佔據剩餘空間
- `width: { xs: '100%', md: 320 }` - 響應式寬度
- `display: { xs: 'none', md: 'block' }` - 響應式顯示/隱藏
- `gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', sm: '1fr 1fr' }` - 響應式網格

這樣的設計確保了在不同螢幕尺寸下都有最佳的用戶體驗！📱💻

**Cursor**

我來幫你修改，讓頁面寬度佔滿整個網頁，消除旁邊的空白區域。


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Fab,
  Alert,
  Drawer,
  useMediaQuery,
  useTheme,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Logout as LogoutIcon,
  Add as AddIcon,
  MyLocation as MyLocationIcon,
  FilterList as FilterIcon,
  Close as CloseIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import MapView from '../components/Map/MapView';
import FilterPanel from '../components/Map/FilterPanel';
import { Restroom, RestroomFilters } from '../types';
import { getCurrentLocation } from '../services/googleMaps';

const MapPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('md'));
  const [selectedRestroom, setSelectedRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<RestroomFilters>({});
  const [userLocation, setUserLocation] = useState<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>(null);
  const [locationError, setLocationError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filterDrawerOpen, setFilterDrawerOpen] = useState(false);

  const handleLogout = () => {
    logout();
  };

  const handleRestroomSelect = (restroom: Restroom | null) => {
    setSelectedRestroom(restroom);
    if (restroom) {
      navigate(`/restroom/${restroom.id}`);
    }
  };

  const handleFiltersChange = (newFilters: RestroomFilters) => {
    setFilters(newFilters);
  };

  const handleFindNearest = async () => {
    try {
      if (!userLocation) {
        const location = await getCurrentLocation();
        setUserLocation(location);
        setFilters({ ...filters, latitude: location.lat, longitude: location.lng });
      } else {
        setFilters({ ...filters, latitude: userLocation.lat, longitude: userLocation.lng });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setLocationError('無法獲取您的位置，請檢查瀏覽器權限設定');
    }
  };

  const handleGetLocation = async () => {
    try {
      setLocationError(null);
      const location = await getCurrentLocation();
      setUserLocation(location);
    } catch (error) {
      setLocationError('無法獲取您的位置，請檢查瀏覽器權限設定');
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // 嘗試獲取用戶位置
    handleGetLocation();
  }, []);

  return (
    <Box sx={{ 
      width: '100vw', 
      height: '100vh', 
      display: 'flex', 
      flexDirection: 'column',
      margin: 0,
      padding: 0,
      overflow: 'hidden'
    }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="home"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            🗺️ 地圖瀏覽
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={handleGetLocation}
            title="獲取我的位置"
          >
            <MyLocationIcon />
          </IconButton>
          {isMobile && (
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => setFilterDrawerOpen(true)}
              title="篩選條件"
            >
              <FilterIcon />
            </IconButton>
          )}
          <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mr: 2 }}>
            {user?.username}
          </Typography>
          <IconButton color="inherit" onClick={handleLogout}>
            <LogoutIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      {locationError && (
        <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ m: 1 }}>
          {locationError}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ 
        flexGrow: 1, 
        display: 'flex', 
        overflow: 'hidden',
        width: '100%'
      }}>
        {/* 篩選面板 - 響應式寬度 */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          width: { xs: 0, sm: 0, md: 320, lg: 320 },
          minWidth: { md: 320 },
          maxWidth: { md: 320 },
          p: { xs: 0, sm: 0, md: 2 },
          overflow: 'auto', 
          borderRight: { xs: 0, md: 1 }, 
          borderColor: 'divider',
          display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'none', md: 'block' }
        }}>
          <FilterPanel
            filters={filters}
            onFiltersChange={handleFiltersChange}
            onFindNearest={handleFindNearest}
          />
        </Box>

        {/* 地圖區域 */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flexGrow: 1, 
          position: 'relative',
          width: '100%',
          height: { xs: 'calc(100vh - 64px)', md: 'calc(100vh - 64px)' }
        }}>
          <MapView
            onRestroomSelect={handleRestroomSelect}
            selectedRestroom={selectedRestroom}
            filters={filters}
          />
          
          {/* 新增廁所按鈕 */}
          <Fab
            color="primary"
            aria-label="add restroom"
            sx={{
              position: 'absolute',
              bottom: 16,
              right: 16,
              zIndex: 1000
            }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/add-restroom')}
          >
            <AddIcon />
          </Fab>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* 手機版篩選抽屜 */}
      <Drawer
        anchor="bottom"
        open={filterDrawerOpen}
        onClose={() => setFilterDrawerOpen(false)}
        sx={{
          '& .MuiDrawer-paper': {
            height: '70vh',
            borderTopLeftRadius: 16,
            borderTopRightRadius: 16,
          },
        }}
      >
        <Box sx={{ p: 2, height: '100%', overflow: 'auto' }}>
          <Box sx={{ 
            display: 'flex', 
            justifyContent: 'space-between', 
            alignItems: 'center', 
            mb: 2 
          }}>
            <Typography variant="h6">篩選條件</Typography>
            <IconButton onClick={() => setFilterDrawerOpen(false)}>
              <CloseIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Box>
          <FilterPanel
            filters={filters}
            onFiltersChange={handleFiltersChange}
            onFindNearest={() => {
              handleFindNearest();
              setFilterDrawerOpen(false);
            }}
          />
        </Box>
      </Drawer>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapPage;
```

現在讓我也修改地圖組件，確保它也能佔滿整個寬度：


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { GoogleMap, useJsApiLoader } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { Box, Typography, CircularProgress } from '@mui/material';
import { GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG, DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS, NTU_COORDINATES } from '../../services/googleMaps';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../../services/api';
import RestroomMarker from './RestroomMarker';

interface MapViewProps {
  onRestroomSelect?: (restroom: Restroom) => void;
  selectedRestroom?: Restroom | null;
  filters?: any;
}

const MapView: React.FC<MapViewProps> = ({ 
  onRestroomSelect, 
  selectedRestroom, 
  filters 
}) => {
  const [restrooms, setRestrooms] = useState<Restroom[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mapCenter] = useState(NTU_COORDINATES);
  const [mapZoom] = useState(15);

  const { isLoaded, loadError } = useJsApiLoader({
    id: 'google-map-script',
    googleMapsApiKey: GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG.apiKey,
    libraries: ['places', 'geometry'],
  });

  const fetchRestrooms = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.getAll(filters);
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestrooms(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restrooms');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restrooms');
      console.error('Error fetching restrooms:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoaded) {
      fetchRestrooms();
    }
  }, [isLoaded, fetchRestrooms]);

  const handleMarkerClick = (restroom: Restroom) => {
    if (onRestroomSelect) {
      onRestroomSelect(restroom);
    }
  };

  const handleMapClick = () => {
    // Map click handler - could be used for future features
  };

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <Typography color="error">
          Error loading Google Maps. Please check your API key.
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
        <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>Loading map...</Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ 
      width: '100%', 
      height: '100%', 
      position: 'relative',
      minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 64px)'
    }}>
      <GoogleMap
        mapContainerStyle={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
        center={mapCenter}
        zoom={mapZoom}
        options={DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS}
        onClick={handleMapClick}
      >
        {restrooms.map((restroom) => (
          <RestroomMarker
            key={restroom.id}
            restroom={restroom}
            onClick={() => handleMarkerClick(restroom)}
            isSelected={selectedRestroom?.id === restroom.id}
          />
        ))}
      </GoogleMap>
      
      {loading && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
            boxShadow: 1,
          }}
        >
          <CircularProgress size={20} />
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            Loading restrooms...
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
      
      {error && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'error.light',
            color: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="caption">{error}</Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapView;

```

我看到問題了。前端在發送數據時包含了 `latitude` 和 `longitude` 字段，但後端的 `createRestroom` 函數沒有處理這些字段。讓我修改後端代碼來處理這個問題：


```typescript
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import db from '../config/database';
import { GoogleMapsService } from '../services/googleMapsService';
import { 
  Restroom, 
  RestroomCreate, 
  RestroomUpdate, 
  RestroomFilters,
  RestroomTag,
  Comment,
  Rating,
  User
} from '../types';

export const getAllRestrooms = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const filters = req.query as RestroomFilters;
    let query = `
      SELECT r.*, u.username as creator_username
      FROM restrooms r
      LEFT JOIN users u ON r.creator_id = u.id
    `;
    const conditions: string[] = [];
    const params: any[] = [];

    // Apply filters
    if (filters.latitude && filters.longitude && filters.radius) {
      // Add distance calculation (simplified)
      conditions.push(`
        (6371 * acos(cos(radians(?)) * cos(radians(latitude)) * 
        cos(radians(longitude) - radians(?)) + sin(radians(?)) * 
        sin(radians(latitude)))) <= ?
      `);
      params.push(filters.latitude, filters.longitude, filters.latitude, filters.radius);
    }

    if (conditions.length > 0) {
      query += ` WHERE ${conditions.join(' AND ')}`;
    }

    query += ' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC';

    const restrooms = db.prepare(query).all(...params) as (Restroom & { creator_username: string })[];

    // Get tags, comments, and ratings for each restroom
    const restroomsWithDetails = restrooms.map(restroom => {
      const tags = db.prepare(
        'SELECT * FROM restroom_tags WHERE restroom_id = ?'
      ).all(restroom.id) as RestroomTag[];

      const comments = db.prepare(`
        SELECT c.*, u.username 
        FROM comments c
        LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id
        WHERE c.restroom_id = ?
        ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
      `).all(restroom.id) as (Comment & { username: string })[];

      const ratings = db.prepare(
        'SELECT * FROM ratings WHERE restroom_id = ?'
      ).all(restroom.id) as Rating[];

      const averageRating = ratings.length > 0 
        ? ratings.reduce((sum, rating) => sum + rating.rating, 0) / ratings.length 
        : 0;

      return {
        ...restroom,
        creator: { username: restroom.creator_username },
        tags,
        comments,
        ratings,
        average_rating: Math.round(averageRating * 10) / 10
      };
    });

    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: restroomsWithDetails
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get restrooms error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to fetch restrooms'
    });
  }
};

export const getNearbyRestrooms = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { lat, lng, radius = 2 } = req.query;
    
    if (!lat || !lng) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Latitude and longitude are required'
      });
    }

    const filters = req.query as RestroomFilters;
    
    // Calculate distance and get nearby restrooms
    let query = `
      SELECT r.*, u.username as creator_username,
      (6371 * acos(cos(radians(?)) * cos(radians(latitude)) * 
      cos(radians(longitude) - radians(?)) + sin(radians(?)) * 
      sin(radians(latitude)))) AS distance
      FROM restrooms r
      LEFT JOIN users u ON r.creator_id = u.id
      WHERE (6371 * acos(cos(radians(?)) * cos(radians(latitude)) * 
      cos(radians(longitude) - radians(?)) + sin(radians(?)) * 
      sin(radians(latitude)))) <= ?
    `;
    
    const params = [lat, lng, lat, lat, lng, lat, radius];

    // Apply additional filters
    if (filters.min_rating) {
      query += ` AND r.id IN (
        SELECT restroom_id FROM ratings 
        GROUP BY restroom_id 
        HAVING AVG(rating) >= ?
      )`;
      params.push(filters.min_rating);
    }

    query += ' ORDER BY distance ASC';

    const restrooms = db.prepare(query).all(...params) as (Restroom & { 
      creator_username: string;
      distance: number;
    })[];

    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: restrooms
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get nearby restrooms error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to fetch nearby restrooms'
    });
  }
};

export const getRestroomById = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;

    const restroom = db.prepare(`
      SELECT r.*, u.username as creator_username
      FROM restrooms r
      LEFT JOIN users u ON r.creator_id = u.id
      WHERE r.id = ?
    `).get(id) as (Restroom & { creator_username: string }) | undefined;

    if (!restroom) {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Restroom not found'
      });
    }

    // Get tags
    const tags = db.prepare(
      'SELECT * FROM restroom_tags WHERE restroom_id = ?'
    ).all(id) as RestroomTag[];

    // Get comments with user info
    const comments = db.prepare(`
      SELECT c.*, u.username 
      FROM comments c
      LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id
      WHERE c.restroom_id = ?
      ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
    `).all(id) as (Comment & { username: string })[];

    // Get ratings
    const ratings = db.prepare(
      'SELECT * FROM ratings WHERE restroom_id = ?'
    ).all(id) as Rating[];

    const averageRating = ratings.length > 0 
      ? ratings.reduce((sum, rating) => sum + rating.rating, 0) / ratings.length 
      : 0;

    const restroomWithDetails = {
      ...restroom,
      creator: { username: restroom.creator_username },
      tags,
      comments,
      ratings,
      average_rating: Math.round(averageRating * 10) / 10
    };

    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: restroomWithDetails
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get restroom error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to fetch restroom'
    });
  }
};

export const createRestroom = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user?.userId;
    if (!userId) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Authentication required'
      });
    }

    const restroomData: RestroomCreate & { latitude?: number; longitude?: number } = req.body;
    const { name, address, description, picture_url, tags, latitude, longitude } = restroomData;

    // Validate input
    if (!name || !address) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Name and address are required'
      });
    }

    let finalLatitude: number;
    let finalLongitude: number;
    let finalAddress: string;

    // If coordinates are provided directly (from map selection), use them
    if (latitude && longitude) {
      finalLatitude = latitude;
      finalLongitude = longitude;
      finalAddress = address;
      
      // Check if location is near NTU
      if (!GoogleMapsService.isNearNTU(finalLatitude, finalLongitude)) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Location must be within 2km of National Taiwan University'
        });
      }
    } else {
      // Geocode address if coordinates not provided
      try {
        const geocodeResult = await GoogleMapsService.geocodeAddress(address);
        finalLatitude = geocodeResult.latitude;
        finalLongitude = geocodeResult.longitude;
        finalAddress = geocodeResult.formatted_address;
        
        // Check if location is near NTU
        if (!GoogleMapsService.isNearNTU(finalLatitude, finalLongitude)) {
          return res.status(400).json({
            success: false,
            error: 'Location must be within 2km of National Taiwan University'
          });
        }
      } catch (geocodeError) {
        console.error('Geocoding error:', geocodeError);
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Unable to find the specified address. Please check the address or try selecting a location on the map.'
        });
      }
    }

    // Create restroom
    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO restrooms (name, address, latitude, longitude, description, creator_id, picture_url)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);

    const result = stmt.run(
      name,
      finalAddress,
      finalLatitude,
      finalLongitude,
      description || null,
      userId,
      picture_url || null
    );

    const restroomId = result.lastInsertRowid;

    // Add tags if provided
    if (tags && tags.length > 0) {
      const tagStmt = db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO restroom_tags (restroom_id, tag_type, tag_value)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?)
      `);

      for (const tag of tags) {
        tagStmt.run(restroomId, tag.tag_type, tag.tag_value);
      }
    }

    // Get created restroom with details
    const createdRestroom = db.prepare(`
      SELECT r.*, u.username as creator_username
      FROM restrooms r
      LEFT JOIN users u ON r.creator_id = u.id
      WHERE r.id = ?
    `).get(restroomId) as (Restroom & { creator_username: string });

    res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      data: createdRestroom,
      message: 'Restroom created successfully'
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Create restroom error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to create restroom'
    });
  }
};

export const updateRestroom = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user?.userId;
    if (!userId) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Authentication required'
      });
    }

    const { id } = req.params;
    const updateData: RestroomUpdate = req.body;

    // Check if restroom exists and user owns it
    const existingRestroom = db.prepare(
      'SELECT * FROM restrooms WHERE id = ? AND creator_id = ?'
    ).get(id, userId);

    if (!existingRestroom) {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Restroom not found or you do not have permission to edit it'
      });
    }

    // Update restroom
    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      UPDATE restrooms 
      SET name = COALESCE(?, name),
          address = COALESCE(?, address),
          description = COALESCE(?, description),
          picture_url = COALESCE(?, picture_url)
      WHERE id = ?
    `);

    stmt.run(
      updateData.name || null,
      updateData.address || null,
      updateData.description || null,
      updateData.picture_url || null,
      id
    );

    // Get updated restroom
    const updatedRestroom = db.prepare(`
      SELECT r.*, u.username as creator_username
      FROM restrooms r
      LEFT JOIN users u ON r.creator_id = u.id
      WHERE r.id = ?
    `).get(id);

    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: updatedRestroom,
      message: 'Restroom updated successfully'
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Update restroom error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to update restroom'
    });
  }
};

export const deleteRestroom = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user?.userId;
    if (!userId) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Authentication required'
      });
    }

    const { id } = req.params;

    // Check if restroom exists and user owns it
    const existingRestroom = db.prepare(
      'SELECT * FROM restrooms WHERE id = ? AND creator_id = ?'
    ).get(id, userId);

    if (!existingRestroom) {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Restroom not found or you do not have permission to delete it'
      });
    }

    // Delete restroom (cascade will handle related records)
    const stmt = db.prepare('DELETE FROM restrooms WHERE id = ?');
    stmt.run(id);

    res.json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Restroom deleted successfully'
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Delete restroom error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to delete restroom'
    });
  }
};

```

# 廁所新增功能修復總結

## 問題描述

在新增廁所時遇到 500 Internal Server Error，主要原因是：

1. **缺少環境變數檔案**：後端沒有 `.env` 檔案，導致 Google Maps API Key 為空
2. **數據處理問題**：後端沒有正確處理前端傳送的 `latitude` 和 `longitude` 字段

## 修復內容

### 1. 環境變數設定

```env
PORT=5000
JWT_SECRET=your-super-secret-jwt-key-change-this-in-production

NODE_ENV=development
```

### 2. 後端控制器修改

修改了 `backend/src/controllers/restroomController.ts` 中的 `createRestroom` 函數：

#### 修改前
- 只處理地址字串，必須通過 Google Geocoding API 轉換為座標
- 沒有處理前端直接傳送的座標數據

#### 修改後
- 支援兩種模式：
  1. **地圖選擇模式**：直接使用前端傳送的 `latitude` 和 `longitude`
  2. **手動輸入模式**：使用 Google Geocoding API 轉換地址為座標
- 改進錯誤處理，提供更清楚的錯誤訊息
- 保持 NTU 附近位置檢查功能

### 3. 主要改進

#### 數據處理邏輯
```typescript
// 如果直接提供了座標（地圖選擇模式）
if (latitude && longitude) {
  finalLatitude = latitude;
  finalLongitude = longitude;
  finalAddress = address;
} else {
  // 否則使用 Geocoding API（手動輸入模式）
  const geocodeResult = await GoogleMapsService.geocodeAddress(address);
  finalLatitude = geocodeResult.latitude;
  finalLongitude = geocodeResult.longitude;
  finalAddress = geocodeResult.formatted_address;
}
```

#### 錯誤處理改進
- 更清楚的錯誤訊息
- 區分 Geocoding 錯誤和其他錯誤
- 提供用戶友好的錯誤提示

## 功能流程

### 地圖選擇模式
1. 用戶在地圖上點選位置
2. 前端獲取座標並傳送給後端

2. 前端傳送地址給後端
3. 後端使用 Google Geocoding API 轉換地址為座標
4. 檢查位置是否在 NTU 附近
5. 創建廁所記錄

```markdown
# NTU 廁所地圖 - 全端網頁應用程式

一個專為台灣大學及周邊地區設計的廁所地圖應用程式，讓用戶可以找到、新增、評分和分享廁所資訊。

## 🚀 功能特色

### 核心功能
- 🗺️ **互動式地圖**：使用 Google Maps 顯示廁所位置
- 🔍 **智能搜尋**：根據位置、評分、標籤篩選廁所
- ➕ **新增廁所**：用戶可以新增新的廁所資訊
- ⭐ **評分系統**：1-5 星評分和評論功能
- 🏷️ **標籤系統**：免治馬桶、無障礙設施、24小時開放等標籤
- 👥 **好友系統**：添加好友、查看好友動態
- 📱 **響應式設計**：支援手機、平板、桌面裝置

### 技術特色
- **前端**：React + TypeScript + Material UI
- **後端**：Node.js + Express + TypeScript
- **資料庫**：SQLite
- **地圖服務**：Google Maps API
- **認證**：JWT Token
- **檔案上傳**：支援廁所照片

## 🛠️ 技術架構

### 前端技術
- **React 18** - 現代化 UI 框架
- **TypeScript** - 型別安全
- **Material UI** - 美觀的 UI 組件庫
- **React Router** - 路由管理
- **Axios** - HTTP 請求
- **Google Maps JavaScript API** - 地圖功能

### 後端技術
- **Node.js** - JavaScript 運行環境
- **Express** - Web 框架
- **TypeScript** - 型別安全
- **SQLite** - 輕量級資料庫
- **JWT** - 身份驗證
- **bcryptjs** - 密碼加密
- **multer** - 檔案上傳
- **Google Maps Services** - 地理編碼

## 📁 專案結構

│   ├── src/

## 🚀 快速開始

### 環境需求
- Node.js 18+ 
- npm 或 yarn
- Google Maps API Key

### 1. 安裝依賴

#### 後端
```bash
cd backend
npm install
```

#### 前端
```bash
cd frontend
npm install
```

### 2. 環境變數設定

#### 後端 (.env)
```env
PORT=5000
JWT_SECRET=your-super-secret-jwt-key-here
GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=your-google-maps-api-key
DATABASE_PATH=./database.sqlite
NODE_ENV=development
```

#### 前端 (.env)
```env
VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:5000/api
VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=your-google-maps-api-key
```

### 3. 啟動應用程式

#### 方法一：分別啟動（開發模式）
```bash
# 啟動後端
cd backend
npm run dev

# 啟動前端（新開終端）
cd frontend
npm run dev
```

#### 方法二：一次建置和啟動（推薦）
```bash
# Windows
start.bat

# Linux/Mac
./start.sh
```

#### 方法三：手動一次啟動
```bash
# 建置後端
cd backend
npm run build

# 建置前端
cd ../frontend
npm run build

# 啟動後端（背景運行）
cd ../backend
npm start &

# 啟動前端
cd ../frontend
npm run preview
```

### 4. 訪問應用程式
- 前端：http://localhost:5173
- 後端 API：http://localhost:5000

## 📊 資料庫結構

### 主要表格
- **users** - 用戶資訊
- **restrooms** - 廁所資訊
- **tags** - 標籤系統
- **restroom_tags** - 廁所標籤關聯
- **comments** - 評論和評分
- **friendships** - 好友關係

## 🔧 API 端點

### 認證
- `POST /api/auth/register` - 註冊
- `POST /api/auth/login` - 登入
- `POST /api/auth/logout` - 登出

### 廁所
- `GET /api/restrooms` - 取得所有廁所
- `POST /api/restrooms` - 新增廁所
- `GET /api/restrooms/:id` - 取得特定廁所
- `PUT /api/restrooms/:id` - 更新廁所
- `DELETE /api/restrooms/:id` - 刪除廁所
- `GET /api/restrooms/nearest` - 找最近的廁所

### 評論
- `POST /api/comments/restrooms/:restroom_id/comments` - 新增評論
- `GET /api/comments/restrooms/:restroom_id/comments` - 取得廁所評論
- `PUT /api/comments/:id` - 更新評論
- `DELETE /api/comments/:id` - 刪除評論

### 好友系統
- `POST /api/friends/send-request` - 發送好友請求
- `POST /api/friends/accept-request` - 接受好友請求
- `POST /api/friends/reject-request` - 拒絕好友請求
- `GET /api/friends/` - 取得好友列表
- `GET /api/friends/requests` - 取得好友請求
- `GET /api/friends/activity` - 取得好友動態

## 🎨 主要頁面

### 1. 首頁

```typescriptreact
import React from 'react';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Box,
  Chip,
  Rating,
  Avatar,
  Divider,
} from '@mui/material';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { getMarkerEmoji } from '../../services/googleMaps';

interface RestroomPreviewProps {
  restroom: Restroom;
  visible: boolean;
  position: { x: number; y: number };
}

const RestroomPreview: React.FC<RestroomPreviewProps> = ({
  restroom,
  visible,
  position,
}) => {
  if (!visible) return null;

  return (
    <Card
      sx={{
        position: 'absolute',
        left: position.x + 10,
        top: position.y - 10,
        zIndex: 1000,
        minWidth: 300,
        maxWidth: 350,
        boxShadow: 3,
        borderRadius: 2,
        transform: 'translateY(-100%)',
        pointerEvents: 'none',
      }}
    >
      <CardContent sx={{ p: 2, '&:last-child': { pb: 2 } }}>
        {/* 標題區域 */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', mb: 1 }}>
          <Avatar sx={{ mr: 1, bgcolor: 'primary.main' }}>
            {getMarkerEmoji(restroom.average_rating || 0)}
          </Avatar>
          <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Typography
              variant="h6"
              sx={{
                fontSize: '1rem',
                fontWeight: 'bold',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              }}
            >
              {restroom.name}
            </Typography>
            <Typography
              variant="body2"
              color="text.secondary"
              sx={{
                overflow: 'hidden',
                textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              }}
            >
              {restroom.address}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Box>

        {/* 評分區域 */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', mb: 1 }}>
          <Rating
            value={restroom.average_rating || 0}
            precision={0.1}
            size="small"
            readOnly
          />
          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            ({restroom.average_rating?.toFixed(1) || '0.0'})
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        {/* 描述 */}
        {restroom.description && (
          <Typography
            variant="body2"
            color="text.secondary"
            sx={{
              mb: 1,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
              display: '-webkit-box',
              WebkitLineClamp: 2,
              WebkitBoxOrient: 'vertical',
            }}
          >
            {restroom.description}
          </Typography>
        )}

        {/* 照片預覽 */}
        {restroom.picture_url && (
          <Box sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
            <img
              src={restroom.picture_url}
              alt={restroom.name}
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                height: '120px',
                objectFit: 'cover',
                borderRadius: '8px',
              }}
              onError={(e) => {
                (e.target as HTMLImageElement).style.display = 'none';
              }}
            />
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* 標籤 */}
        {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5 }}>
            {restroom.tags.slice(0, 4).map((tag, index) => (
              <Chip
                key={index}
                label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                size="small"
                variant="outlined"
                color="primary"
                sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', height: '24px' }}
              />
            ))}
            {restroom.tags.length > 4 && (
              <Chip
                label={`+${restroom.tags.length - 4}`}
                size="small"
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', height: '24px' }}
              />
            )}
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* 創建者信息 */}
        <Divider sx={{ my: 1 }} />
        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
          由 {restroom.creator?.username || '未知用戶'} 建立
        </Typography>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

export default RestroomPreview;
```

現在讓我修改 MapView 組件來添加預覽功能：


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { GoogleMap, useJsApiLoader } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { Box, Typography, CircularProgress } from '@mui/material';
import { GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG, DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS, NTU_COORDINATES } from '../../services/googleMaps';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../../services/api';
import RestroomMarker from './RestroomMarker';
import RestroomPreview from './RestroomPreview';

interface MapViewProps {
  onRestroomSelect?: (restroom: Restroom) => void;
  selectedRestroom?: Restroom | null;
  filters?: any;
}

const MapView: React.FC<MapViewProps> = ({ 
  onRestroomSelect, 
  selectedRestroom, 
  filters 
}) => {
  const [restrooms, setRestrooms] = useState<Restroom[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mapCenter] = useState(NTU_COORDINATES);
  const [mapZoom] = useState(15);

  const { isLoaded, loadError } = useJsApiLoader({
    id: 'google-map-script',
    googleMapsApiKey: GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG.apiKey,
    libraries: ['places', 'geometry'],
  });

  const fetchRestrooms = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.getAll(filters);
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestrooms(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restrooms');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restrooms');
      console.error('Error fetching restrooms:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoaded) {
      fetchRestrooms();
    }
  }, [isLoaded, fetchRestrooms]);

  const handleMarkerClick = (restroom: Restroom) => {
    if (onRestroomSelect) {
      onRestroomSelect(restroom);
    }
  };

  const handleMapClick = () => {
    // Map click handler - could be used for future features
  };

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <Typography color="error">
          Error loading Google Maps. Please check your API key.
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
        <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>Loading map...</Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ 
      width: '100%', 
      height: '100%', 
      position: 'relative',
      minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 64px)'
    }}>
      <GoogleMap
        mapContainerStyle={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
        center={mapCenter}
        zoom={mapZoom}
        options={DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS}
        onClick={handleMapClick}
      >
        {restrooms.map((restroom) => (
          <RestroomMarker
            key={restroom.id}
            restroom={restroom}
            onClick={() => handleMarkerClick(restroom)}
            isSelected={selectedRestroom?.id === restroom.id}
          />
        ))}
      </GoogleMap>
      
      {loading && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
            boxShadow: 1,
          }}
        >
          <CircularProgress size={20} />
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            Loading restrooms...
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
      
      {error && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'error.light',
            color: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="caption">{error}</Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapView;

```

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { GoogleMap, useJsApiLoader } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { Box, Typography, CircularProgress } from '@mui/material';
import { GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG, DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS, NTU_COORDINATES } from '../../services/googleMaps';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../../services/api';
import RestroomMarker from './RestroomMarker';
import RestroomPreview from './RestroomPreview';

interface MapViewProps {
  onRestroomSelect?: (restroom: Restroom) => void;
  selectedRestroom?: Restroom | null;
  filters?: any;
}

const MapView: React.FC<MapViewProps> = ({ 
  onRestroomSelect, 
  selectedRestroom, 
  filters 
}) => {
  const [restrooms, setRestrooms] = useState<Restroom[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mapCenter] = useState(NTU_COORDINATES);
  const [mapZoom] = useState(15);
  const [hoveredRestroom, setHoveredRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [previewPosition, setPreviewPosition] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  const { isLoaded, loadError } = useJsApiLoader({
    id: 'google-map-script',
    googleMapsApiKey: GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG.apiKey,
    libraries: ['places', 'geometry'],
  });

  const fetchRestrooms = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.getAll(filters);
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestrooms(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restrooms');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restrooms');
      console.error('Error fetching restrooms:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoaded) {
      fetchRestrooms();
    }
  }, [isLoaded, fetchRestrooms]);

  const handleMarkerClick = (restroom: Restroom) => {
    if (onRestroomSelect) {
      onRestroomSelect(restroom);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkerHover = (restroom: Restroom, event: any) => {
    setHoveredRestroom(restroom);
    setPreviewPosition({ x: event.pixel.x, y: event.pixel.y });
  };

  const handleMarkerLeave = () => {
    setHoveredRestroom(null);
  };

  const handleMapClick = () => {
    // Map click handler - could be used for future features
  };

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <Typography color="error">
          Error loading Google Maps. Please check your API key.
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
        <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>Loading map...</Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ 
      width: '100%', 
      height: '100%', 
      position: 'relative',
      minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 64px)'
    }}>
      <GoogleMap
        mapContainerStyle={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
        center={mapCenter}
        zoom={mapZoom}
        options={DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS}
        onClick={handleMapClick}
      >
        {restrooms.map((restroom) => (
          <RestroomMarker
            key={restroom.id}
            restroom={restroom}
            onClick={() => handleMarkerClick(restroom)}
            isSelected={selectedRestroom?.id === restroom.id}
          />
        ))}
      </GoogleMap>
      
      {loading && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
            boxShadow: 1,
          }}
        >
          <CircularProgress size={20} />
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            Loading restrooms...
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
      
      {error && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'error.light',
            color: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="caption">{error}</Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapView;

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Marker } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { InfoWindow } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { Box, Typography, Chip, Rating } from '@mui/material';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { getMarkerSize } from '../../services/googleMaps';

interface RestroomMarkerProps {
  restroom: Restroom;
  onClick: () => void;
  onHover?: (event: any) => void;
  onLeave?: () => void;
  isSelected?: boolean;
}

const RestroomMarker: React.FC<RestroomMarkerProps> = ({ 
  restroom, 
  onClick
}) => {
  const [showInfoWindow, setShowInfoWindow] = useState(false);

  const handleMarkerClick = () => {
    setShowInfoWindow(true);
    onClick();
  };

  const handleInfoWindowClose = () => {
    setShowInfoWindow(false);
  };

  const markerSize = getMarkerSize(restroom.average_rating);

  return (
    <>
      <Marker
        position={{ lat: restroom.latitude, lng: restroom.longitude }}
        onClick={handleMarkerClick}
        icon={{
          url: `data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,${encodeURIComponent(`
            <svg width="${markerSize.width}" height="${markerSize.height}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
              <path d="M12 2C8.13 2 5 5.13 5 9c0 5.25 7 13 7 13s7-7.75 7-13c0-3.87-3.13-7-7-7zm0 9.5c-1.38 0-2.5-1.12-2.5-2.5s1.12-2.5 2.5-2.5 2.5 1.12 2.5 2.5-1.12 2.5-2.5 2.5z" fill="#1976d2"/>
            </svg>
          `)}`,
          scaledSize: new google.maps.Size(markerSize.width, markerSize.height),
          anchor: new google.maps.Point(markerSize.width / 2, markerSize.height),
        }}
      />
      
      {showInfoWindow && (
        <InfoWindow
          position={{ lat: restroom.latitude, lng: restroom.longitude }}
          onCloseClick={handleInfoWindowClose}
        >
          <Box sx={{ p: 1, minWidth: 200 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
              {restroom.name}
            </Typography>
            
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              {restroom.address}
            </Typography>
            
            {restroom.average_rating && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', mb: 1 }}>
                <Rating 
                  value={restroom.average_rating} 
                  readOnly 
                  size="small"
                />
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
                  ({restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)})
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            )}
            
            {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5, mt: 1 }}>
                {restroom.tags.slice(0, 3).map((tag, index) => (
                  <Chip
                    key={index}
                    label={tag.tag_value}
                    size="small"
                    color="primary"
                    variant="outlined"
                  />
                ))}
                {restroom.tags.length > 3 && (
                  <Chip
                    label={`+${restroom.tags.length - 3}`}
                    size="small"
                    color="default"
                    variant="outlined"
                  />
                )}
              </Box>
            )}
            
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
              Click for details
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </InfoWindow>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default RestroomMarker;

          url: `data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,${encodeURIComponent(`
            <svg width="${markerSize.width}" height="${markerSize.height}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
              <path d="M12 2C8.13 2 5 5.13 5 9c0 5.25 7 13 7 13s7-7.75 7-13c0-3.87-3.13-7-7-7zm0 9.5c-1.38 0-2.5-1.12-2.5-2.5s1.12-2.5 2.5-2.5 2.5 1.12 2.5 2.5-1.12 2.5-2.5 2.5z" fill="#1976d2"/>
            </svg>
          `)}`,
          scaledSize: new google.maps.Size(markerSize.width, markerSize.height),
          anchor: new google.maps.Point(markerSize.width / 2, markerSize.height),
        }}
      />
      
      {showInfoWindow && (
        <InfoWindow
          position={{ lat: restroom.latitude, lng: restroom.longitude }}
          onCloseClick={handleInfoWindowClose}
        >
          <Box sx={{ p: 1, minWidth: 200 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
              {restroom.name}
            </Typography>
            
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              {restroom.address}
            </Typography>
            
            {restroom.average_rating && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', mb: 1 }}>
                <Rating 
                  value={restroom.average_rating} 
                  readOnly 
                  size="small"
                />
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
                  ({restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)})
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            )}
            
            {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5, mt: 1 }}>
                {restroom.tags.slice(0, 3).map((tag, index) => (
                  <Chip
                    key={index}
                    label={tag.tag_value}
                    size="small"
                    color="primary"
                    variant="outlined"
                  />
                ))}
                {restroom.tags.length > 3 && (
                  <Chip
                    label={`+${restroom.tags.length - 3}`}
                    size="small"
                    color="default"
                    variant="outlined"
                  />
                )}
              </Box>
            )}
            
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
              Click for details
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </InfoWindow>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default RestroomMarker;

```

```typescript
import { MapLocation } from '../types';

// Google Maps configuration
export const GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG = {
  apiKey: import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY || '',
  libraries: ['places', 'geometry'] as const,
  region: 'TW' as const,
  language: 'zh-TW' as const,
};

// NTU coordinates
export const NTU_COORDINATES: MapLocation = {
  lat: 25.0172,
  lng: 121.5395,
};

// Default map options
export const DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS = {
  zoom: 15,
  center: NTU_COORDINATES,
  mapTypeId: 'roadmap' as const,
  disableDefaultUI: false,
  zoomControl: true,
  mapTypeControl: true,
  scaleControl: true,
  streetViewControl: true,
  rotateControl: true,
  fullscreenControl: true,
};

// Map bounds for NTU area
export const NTU_BOUNDS = {
  north: 25.03,
  south: 25.00,
  east: 121.55,
  west: 121.52,
};

// Calculate distance between two points
export const calculateDistance = (
  lat1: number,
  lng1: number,
  lat2: number,
  lng2: number
): number => {
  const R = 6371; // Earth's radius in km
  const dLat = toRadians(lat2 - lat1);
  const dLng = toRadians(lng2 - lng1);
  
  const a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
            Math.cos(toRadians(lat1)) * Math.cos(toRadians(lat2)) *
            Math.sin(dLng / 2) * Math.sin(dLng / 2);
  
  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  return R * c;
};

// Convert degrees to radians
const toRadians = (degrees: number): number => {
  return degrees * (Math.PI / 180);
};

// Check if location is within NTU area
export const isWithinNTUArea = (
  lat: number,
  lng: number,
  radiusKm: number = 2
): boolean => {
  const distance = calculateDistance(lat, lng, NTU_COORDINATES.lat, NTU_COORDINATES.lng);
  return distance <= radiusKm;
};

// Get current user location
export const getCurrentLocation = (): Promise<MapLocation> => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      reject(new Error('Geolocation is not supported by this browser'));
      return;
    }

    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (position) => {
        const location: MapLocation = {
          lat: position.coords.latitude,
          lng: position.coords.longitude,
        };
        resolve(location);
      },
      (error) => {
        reject(error);
      },
      {
        enableHighAccuracy: true,
        timeout: 10000,
        maximumAge: 300000,
      }
    );
  });
};

// Format address for display
export const formatAddress = (address: string): string => {
  // Remove Taiwan country code if present
  return address.replace(/, Taiwan$/, '').replace(/, ROC$/, '');
};

// Get marker icon based on rating
export const getMarkerIcon = (rating?: number): string => {
  if (!rating) return '🔴'; // Default red marker
  
  if (rating >= 4.5) return '🟢'; // Green for excellent
  if (rating >= 3.5) return '🟡'; // Yellow for good
  if (rating >= 2.5) return '🟠'; // Orange for average
  return '🔴'; // Red for poor
};

// Get marker emoji based on rating
export const getMarkerEmoji = (rating?: number): string => {
  if (!rating) return '🚽'; // Default toilet emoji
  
  if (rating >= 4.5) return '🚽✨'; // Excellent toilet
  if (rating >= 3.5) return '🚽👍'; // Good toilet
  if (rating >= 2.5) return '🚽'; // Average toilet
  return '🚽⚠️'; // Poor toilet
};

// Get marker size based on rating
export const getMarkerSize = (rating?: number): { width: number; height: number } => {
  if (!rating) return { width: 30, height: 30 };
  
  if (rating >= 4.5) return { width: 35, height: 35 }; // Larger for excellent
  if (rating >= 3.5) return { width: 32, height: 32 }; // Medium for good
  return { width: 30, height: 30 }; // Default size
};

# 廁所預覽功能實現總結

## 功能描述

實現了地圖上的廁所預覽功能，當滑鼠移到地圖上的廁所標記時，會顯示一個預覽卡片，包含廁所的詳細信息。

**Cursor**

我來幫你修改預覽視窗的位置，讓它出現在 marker 旁邊而不是滑鼠位置。我需要修改 MapView 組件來計算 marker 的實際位置。


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { GoogleMap, useJsApiLoader } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { Box, Typography, CircularProgress } from '@mui/material';
import { GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG, DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS, NTU_COORDINATES } from '../../services/googleMaps';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../../services/api';
import RestroomMarker from './RestroomMarker';
import RestroomPreview from './RestroomPreview';

interface MapViewProps {
  onRestroomSelect?: (restroom: Restroom) => void;
  selectedRestroom?: Restroom | null;
  filters?: any;
}

const MapView: React.FC<MapViewProps> = ({ 
  onRestroomSelect, 
  selectedRestroom, 
  filters 
}) => {
  const [restrooms, setRestrooms] = useState<Restroom[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mapCenter] = useState(NTU_COORDINATES);
  const [mapZoom] = useState(15);
  const [hoveredRestroom, setHoveredRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [previewPosition, setPreviewPosition] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  const { isLoaded, loadError } = useJsApiLoader({
    id: 'google-map-script',
    googleMapsApiKey: GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG.apiKey,
    libraries: ['places', 'geometry'],
  });

  const fetchRestrooms = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.getAll(filters);
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestrooms(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restrooms');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restrooms');
      console.error('Error fetching restrooms:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoaded) {
      fetchRestrooms();
    }
  }, [isLoaded, fetchRestrooms]);

  const handleMarkerClick = (restroom: Restroom) => {
    if (onRestroomSelect) {
      onRestroomSelect(restroom);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkerHover = (restroom: Restroom, event: any) => {
    setHoveredRestroom(restroom);
    // 使用 marker 的實際位置而不是滑鼠位置
    const markerPosition = event.pixel;
    setPreviewPosition({ x: markerPosition.x, y: markerPosition.y });
  };

  const handleMarkerLeave = () => {
    setHoveredRestroom(null);
  };

  const handleMapClick = () => {
    // Map click handler - could be used for future features
  };

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <Typography color="error">
          Error loading Google Maps. Please check your API key.
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
        <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>Loading map...</Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ 
      width: '100%', 
      height: '100%', 
      position: 'relative',
      minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 64px)'
    }}>
      <GoogleMap
        mapContainerStyle={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
        center={mapCenter}
        zoom={mapZoom}
        options={DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS}
        onClick={handleMapClick}
      >
        {restrooms.map((restroom) => (
          <RestroomMarker
            key={restroom.id}
            restroom={restroom}
            onClick={() => handleMarkerClick(restroom)}
            onHover={(event) => handleMarkerHover(restroom, event)}
            onLeave={handleMarkerLeave}
            isSelected={selectedRestroom?.id === restroom.id}
          />
        ))}
      </GoogleMap>
      
      {loading && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
            boxShadow: 1,
          }}
        >
          <CircularProgress size={20} />
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            Loading restrooms...
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
      
      {error && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'error.light',
            color: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="caption">{error}</Typography>
        </Box>
      )}

      {/* 廁所預覽 */}
      <RestroomPreview
        restroom={hoveredRestroom!}
        visible={!!hoveredRestroom}
        position={previewPosition}
      />
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapView;

```

import React from 'react';

            >
              {restroom.name}
            </Typography>
            <Typography
              variant="body2"
