              sx={{
                overflow: 'hidden',
                textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              }}
            >
              {restroom.address}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Box>

        {/* 評分區域 */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', mb: 1 }}>
          <Rating
            value={restroom.average_rating || 0}
            precision={0.1}
            size="small"
            readOnly
          />
          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            ({restroom.average_rating?.toFixed(1) || '0.0'})
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        {/* 描述 */}
        {restroom.description && (
          <Typography
            variant="body2"
            color="text.secondary"
            sx={{
              mb: 1,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
              display: '-webkit-box',
              WebkitLineClamp: 2,
              WebkitBoxOrient: 'vertical',
            }}
          >
            {restroom.description}
          </Typography>
        )}

        {/* 照片預覽 */}
        {restroom.picture_url && (
          <Box sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
            <img
              src={restroom.picture_url}
              alt={restroom.name}
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                height: '120px',
                objectFit: 'cover',
                borderRadius: '8px',
              }}
              onError={(e) => {
                (e.target as HTMLImageElement).style.display = 'none';
              }}
            />
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* 標籤 */}
        {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5 }}>
            {restroom.tags.slice(0, 4).map((tag, index) => (
              <Chip
                key={index}
                label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                size="small"
                variant="outlined"
                color="primary"
                sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', height: '24px' }}
              />
            ))}
            {restroom.tags.length > 4 && (
              <Chip
                label={`+${restroom.tags.length - 4}`}
                size="small"
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', height: '24px' }}
              />
            )}
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* 創建者信息 */}
        <Divider sx={{ my: 1 }} />
        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
          由 {restroom.creator?.username || '未知用戶'} 建立
        </Typography>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

export default RestroomPreview;

現在讓我進一步改進定位邏輯，考慮到視窗邊界，讓預覽卡片始終保持在視窗內：


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { GoogleMap, useJsApiLoader } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { Box, Typography, CircularProgress } from '@mui/material';
import { GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG, DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS, NTU_COORDINATES } from '../../services/googleMaps';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../../services/api';
import RestroomMarker from './RestroomMarker';
import RestroomPreview from './RestroomPreview';

interface MapViewProps {
  onRestroomSelect?: (restroom: Restroom) => void;
  selectedRestroom?: Restroom | null;
  filters?: any;
}

const MapView: React.FC<MapViewProps> = ({ 
  onRestroomSelect, 
  selectedRestroom, 
  filters 
}) => {
  const [restrooms, setRestrooms] = useState<Restroom[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mapCenter] = useState(NTU_COORDINATES);
  const [mapZoom] = useState(15);
  const [hoveredRestroom, setHoveredRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [previewPosition, setPreviewPosition] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  const { isLoaded, loadError } = useJsApiLoader({
    id: 'google-map-script',
    googleMapsApiKey: GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG.apiKey,
    libraries: ['places', 'geometry'],
  });

  const fetchRestrooms = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.getAll(filters);
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestrooms(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restrooms');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restrooms');
      console.error('Error fetching restrooms:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoaded) {
      fetchRestrooms();
    }
  }, [isLoaded, fetchRestrooms]);

  const handleMarkerClick = (restroom: Restroom) => {
    if (onRestroomSelect) {
      onRestroomSelect(restroom);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkerHover = (restroom: Restroom, event: any) => {
    setHoveredRestroom(restroom);
    // 使用 marker 的實際位置，並考慮視窗邊界
    const markerPosition = event.pixel;
    
    // 計算預覽卡片的最佳位置
    const cardWidth = 350; // 預覽卡片寬度
    const cardHeight = 200; // 預覽卡片高度（估算）
    const margin = 20; // 邊距
    
    let x = markerPosition.x + margin;
    let y = markerPosition.y - margin;
    
    // 檢查右邊界
    if (x + cardWidth > window.innerWidth) {
      x = markerPosition.x - cardWidth - margin; // 顯示在左邊
    }
    
    // 檢查上邊界
    if (y - cardHeight < 0) {
      y = markerPosition.y + margin; // 顯示在下面
    }
    
    setPreviewPosition({ x, y });
  };

  const handleMarkerLeave = () => {
    setHoveredRestroom(null);
  };

  const handleMapClick = () => {
    // Map click handler - could be used for future features
  };

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <Typography color="error">
          Error loading Google Maps. Please check your API key.
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
        <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>Loading map...</Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ 
      width: '100%', 
      height: '100%', 
      position: 'relative',
      minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 64px)'
    }}>
      <GoogleMap
        mapContainerStyle={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
        center={mapCenter}
        zoom={mapZoom}
        options={DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS}
        onClick={handleMapClick}
      >
        {restrooms.map((restroom) => (
          <RestroomMarker
            key={restroom.id}
            restroom={restroom}
            onClick={() => handleMarkerClick(restroom)}
            onHover={(event) => handleMarkerHover(restroom, event)}
            onLeave={handleMarkerLeave}
            isSelected={selectedRestroom?.id === restroom.id}
          />
        ))}
      </GoogleMap>
      
      {loading && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
            boxShadow: 1,
          }}
        >
          <CircularProgress size={20} />
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            Loading restrooms...
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
      
      {error && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'error.light',
            color: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="caption">{error}</Typography>
        </Box>
      )}

      {/* 廁所預覽 */}
      <RestroomPreview
        restroom={hoveredRestroom!}
        visible={!!hoveredRestroom}
        position={previewPosition}
      />
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapView;

```

# 預覽視窗定位改進總結

## 改進內容

根據用戶需求，修改了地圖上的廁所預覽視窗定位，讓它出現在 marker 旁邊而不是滑鼠位置。

## 主要修改

### 1. MapView 組件改進

**檔案位置**: `frontend/src/components/Map/MapView.tsx`

#### 智能定位邏輯
```typescript
const handleMarkerHover = (restroom: Restroom, event: any) => {
  setHoveredRestroom(restroom);
  // 使用 marker 的實際位置，並考慮視窗邊界
  const markerPosition = event.pixel;
  
  // 計算預覽卡片的最佳位置
  const cardWidth = 350; // 預覽卡片寬度
  const cardHeight = 200; // 預覽卡片高度（估算）
  const margin = 20; // 邊距
  
  let x = markerPosition.x + margin;
  let y = markerPosition.y - margin;
  
  // 檢查右邊界
  if (x + cardWidth > window.innerWidth) {
    x = markerPosition.x - cardWidth - margin; // 顯示在左邊
  }
  
  // 檢查上邊界
  if (y - cardHeight < 0) {
    y = markerPosition.y + margin; // 顯示在下面
  }
  
  setPreviewPosition({ x, y });
};
```

#### 主要特色
- **基於 Marker 位置**: 使用 marker 的實際像素位置而不是滑鼠位置
- **智能邊界檢測**: 自動檢測視窗邊界，確保預覽卡片不會超出螢幕
- **動態位置調整**: 根據可用空間自動調整預覽卡片的位置

### 2. RestroomPreview 組件改進

**檔案位置**: `frontend/src/components/Map/RestroomPreview.tsx`

#### 視覺改進
```typescript
<Card
  sx={{
    position: 'absolute',
    left: position.x,
    top: position.y,
    zIndex: 1000,
    minWidth: 300,
    maxWidth: 350,

>
```

#### 主要特色
- **精確定位**: 使用計算出的精確位置
- **視覺指示器**: 添加箭頭指向 marker，清楚顯示關聯性
- **美觀設計**: 保持 Material-UI 設計風格

## 定位邏輯

### 1. 預設位置
- 預覽卡片預設顯示在 marker 的右上方
- 距離 marker 20px 的間距

### 2. 邊界檢測
- **右邊界檢測**: 如果卡片會超出螢幕右邊，則顯示在 marker 左邊
- **上邊界檢測**: 如果卡片會超出螢幕上方，則顯示在 marker 下方

### 3. 位置計算
```typescript
// 預設位置（右上方）
let x = markerPosition.x + margin;
let y = markerPosition.y - margin;

// 右邊界調整（左邊）
if (x + cardWidth > window.innerWidth) {
  x = markerPosition.x - cardWidth - margin;
}

// 上邊界調整（下方）
if (y - cardHeight < 0) {
  y = markerPosition.y + margin;
}
```

## 用戶體驗改進

### 1. 視覺關聯性
- 預覽卡片始終與對應的 marker 保持視覺關聯
- 添加箭頭指示器，清楚指向對應的 marker

### 2. 智能定位
- 自動適應不同螢幕尺寸
- 確保預覽卡片始終在可見範圍內
- 避免遮擋重要的地圖內容

### 3. 一致性
- 所有 marker 的預覽卡片都使用相同的定位邏輯
- 提供一致的用戶體驗

## 技術細節

### 1. 位置計算
- 使用 Google Maps 的 `event.pixel` 獲取 marker 的實際像素位置
- 考慮預覽卡片的尺寸和視窗邊界
- 動態調整位置以確保最佳顯示效果

### 2. 邊界處理
- 檢測視窗的寬度和高度
- 計算預覽卡片的最大可用空間
- 智能調整位置以避免超出邊界

### 3. 視覺效果
- 使用 CSS `::before` 偽元素創建箭頭
- 添加陰影效果增強視覺層次
- 保持 Material-UI 設計一致性

## 測試建議

### 1. 邊界測試
- 測試螢幕邊緣的 marker
- 測試不同螢幕尺寸下的顯示效果
- 測試預覽卡片的位置調整

### 2. 視覺測試
- 測試箭頭指示器的顯示
- 測試預覽卡片的陰影效果
- 測試與 marker 的視覺關聯性

### 3. 互動測試
- 測試滑鼠懸停事件
- 測試預覽卡片的顯示和隱藏
- 測試不同 marker 的預覽效果

## 未來改進

### 1. 動畫效果
- 添加預覽卡片的淡入淡出動畫
- 添加位置調整的平滑過渡效果

### 2. 自適應設計
- 根據螢幕尺寸調整預覽卡片大小
- 優化移動設備上的顯示效果

### 3. 用戶偏好
- 允許用戶自定義預覽卡片位置
- 添加預覽延遲顯示選項

## 使用方式

1. 將滑鼠移到地圖上的任何廁所 marker 上
2. 預覽卡片會自動出現在 marker 旁邊的最佳位置
3. 預覽卡片會自動調整位置以避免超出螢幕邊界
4. 滑鼠離開 marker 時，預覽卡片會自動隱藏

這個改進大大提升了用戶體驗，讓預覽功能更加直觀和易用。

  const { isLoaded, loadError } = useJsApiLoader({
    id: 'google-map-script',
    googleMapsApiKey: GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG.apiKey,
    libraries: ['places', 'geometry'],
  });

  const fetchRestrooms = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.getAll(filters);
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestrooms(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restrooms');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restrooms');
      console.error('Error fetching restrooms:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoaded) {
      fetchRestrooms();
    }
  }, [isLoaded, fetchRestrooms]);

  const handleMarkerClick = (restroom: Restroom) => {
    if (onRestroomSelect) {
      onRestroomSelect(restroom);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkerHover = (restroom: Restroom, event: any) => {
    setHoveredRestroom(restroom);
    // 使用 marker 的經緯度位置來計算預覽位置
    const markerLatLng = { lat: restroom.latitude, lng: restroom.longitude };
    
    // 計算預覽卡片的最佳位置
    const cardWidth = 350; // 預覽卡片寬度
    const cardHeight = 200; // 預覽卡片高度（估算）
    const margin = 20; // 邊距
    
    // 計算 marker 的像素位置
    const markerPixel = event.pixel;
    
    let x = markerPixel.x + margin;
    let y = markerPixel.y - margin;
    
    // 檢查右邊界
    if (x + cardWidth > window.innerWidth) {
      x = markerPixel.x - cardWidth - margin; // 顯示在左邊
    }
    
    // 檢查上邊界
    if (y - cardHeight < 0) {
      y = markerPixel.y + margin; // 顯示在下面
    }
    
    setPreviewPosition({ x, y });
  };

  const handleMarkerLeave = () => {
    setHoveredRestroom(null);
  };

  const handleMapClick = () => {
    // Map click handler - could be used for future features
  };

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <Typography color="error">
          Error loading Google Maps. Please check your API key.
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
        <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>Loading map...</Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ 
      width: '100%', 
      height: '100%', 
      position: 'relative',
      minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 64px)'
    }}>
      <GoogleMap
        mapContainerStyle={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
        center={mapCenter}
        zoom={mapZoom}
        options={DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS}
        onClick={handleMapClick}
      >
        {restrooms.map((restroom) => (
          <RestroomMarker
            key={restroom.id}
            restroom={restroom}
            onClick={() => handleMarkerClick(restroom)}
            onHover={(event) => handleMarkerHover(restroom, event)}
            onLeave={handleMarkerLeave}
            isSelected={selectedRestroom?.id === restroom.id}
          />
        ))}
      </GoogleMap>
      
      {loading && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
            boxShadow: 1,
          }}
        >
          <CircularProgress size={20} />
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            Loading restrooms...
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
      
      {error && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'error.light',
            color: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="caption">{error}</Typography>
        </Box>
      )}

      {/* 廁所預覽 */}
      <RestroomPreview
        restroom={hoveredRestroom!}
        visible={!!hoveredRestroom}
        position={previewPosition}
      />
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapView;

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { GoogleMap, useJsApiLoader } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { Box, Typography, CircularProgress } from '@mui/material';
import { GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG, DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS, NTU_COORDINATES } from '../../services/googleMaps';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../../services/api';
import RestroomMarker from './RestroomMarker';
import RestroomPreview from './RestroomPreview';

interface MapViewProps {
  onRestroomSelect?: (restroom: Restroom) => void;
  selectedRestroom?: Restroom | null;
  filters?: any;
}

const MapView: React.FC<MapViewProps> = ({ 
  onRestroomSelect, 
  selectedRestroom, 
  filters 
}) => {
  const [restrooms, setRestrooms] = useState<Restroom[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mapCenter] = useState(NTU_COORDINATES);
  const [mapZoom] = useState(15);
  const [hoveredRestroom, setHoveredRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [previewPosition, setPreviewPosition] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const mapRef = useRef<google.maps.Map | null>(null);

  const { isLoaded, loadError } = useJsApiLoader({
    id: 'google-map-script',
    googleMapsApiKey: GOOGLE_MAPS_CONFIG.apiKey,
    libraries: ['places', 'geometry'],
  });

  const fetchRestrooms = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.getAll(filters);
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestrooms(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restrooms');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restrooms');
      console.error('Error fetching restrooms:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoaded) {
      fetchRestrooms();
    }
  }, [isLoaded, fetchRestrooms]);

  const handleMarkerClick = (restroom: Restroom) => {
    if (onRestroomSelect) {
      onRestroomSelect(restroom);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkerHover = (restroom: Restroom, event: any) => {
    setHoveredRestroom(restroom);
    
    if (!mapRef.current) return;
    
    // 使用 marker 的經緯度位置來計算預覽位置
    const markerLatLng = new google.maps.LatLng(restroom.latitude, restroom.longitude);
    
    // 計算預覽卡片的最佳位置
    const cardWidth = 350; // 預覽卡片寬度
    const cardHeight = 200; // 預覽卡片高度（估算）
    const margin = 20; // 邊距
    
    // 使用 Google Maps 投影將經緯度轉換為像素位置
    const projection = mapRef.current.getProjection();
    if (!projection) return;
    
    const markerPixel = projection.fromLatLngToPoint(markerLatLng);
    const mapBounds = mapRef.current.getBounds();
    const topRight = mapBounds?.getNorthEast();
    const bottomLeft = mapBounds?.getSouthWest();
    
    if (!topRight || !bottomLeft) return;
    
    const topRightPixel = projection.fromLatLngToPoint(topRight);
    const bottomLeftPixel = projection.fromLatLngToPoint(bottomLeft);
    
    // 計算相對於地圖容器的像素位置
    const mapDiv = mapRef.current.getDiv();
    const mapWidth = mapDiv.offsetWidth;
    const mapHeight = mapDiv.offsetHeight;
    
    const scale = Math.pow(2, mapRef.current.getZoom() || 15);
    const worldCoordinate = markerPixel;
    const pixelCoordinate = new google.maps.Point(
      worldCoordinate.x * scale,
      worldCoordinate.y * scale
    );
    
    // 轉換為相對於地圖容器的位置
    const markerX = (pixelCoordinate.x - bottomLeftPixel.x * scale) * mapWidth / ((topRightPixel.x - bottomLeftPixel.x) * scale);
    const markerY = (pixelCoordinate.y - bottomLeftPixel.y * scale) * mapHeight / ((topRightPixel.y - bottomLeftPixel.y) * scale);
    
    let x = markerX + margin;
    let y = markerY - margin;
    
    // 檢查右邊界
    if (x + cardWidth > mapWidth) {
      x = markerX - cardWidth - margin; // 顯示在左邊
    }
    
    // 檢查上邊界
    if (y - cardHeight < 0) {
      y = markerY + margin; // 顯示在下面
    }
    
    setPreviewPosition({ x, y });
  };

  const handleMarkerLeave = () => {
    setHoveredRestroom(null);
  };

  const handleMapClick = () => {
    // Map click handler - could be used for future features
  };

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <Typography color="error">
          Error loading Google Maps. Please check your API key.
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
        <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>Loading map...</Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ 
      width: '100%', 
      height: '100%', 
      position: 'relative',
      minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 64px)'
    }}>
      <GoogleMap
        mapContainerStyle={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
        center={mapCenter}
        zoom={mapZoom}
        options={DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS}
        onClick={handleMapClick}
      >
        {restrooms.map((restroom) => (
          <RestroomMarker
            key={restroom.id}
            restroom={restroom}
            onClick={() => handleMarkerClick(restroom)}
            onHover={(event) => handleMarkerHover(restroom, event)}
            onLeave={handleMarkerLeave}
            isSelected={selectedRestroom?.id === restroom.id}
          />
        ))}
      </GoogleMap>
      
      {loading && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
            boxShadow: 1,
          }}
        >
          <CircularProgress size={20} />
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            Loading restrooms...
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
      
      {error && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'error.light',
            color: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="caption">{error}</Typography>
        </Box>
      )}

      {/* 廁所預覽 */}
      <RestroomPreview
        restroom={hoveredRestroom!}
        visible={!!hoveredRestroom}
        position={previewPosition}
      />
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapView;

        setError('Failed to fetch restrooms');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restrooms');
      console.error('Error fetching restrooms:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoaded) {
      fetchRestrooms();
    }
  }, [isLoaded, fetchRestrooms]);

  const handleMarkerClick = (restroom: Restroom) => {
    if (onRestroomSelect) {
      onRestroomSelect(restroom);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkerHover = (restroom: Restroom, event: any) => {
    setHoveredRestroom(restroom);
    
    if (!mapRef.current) return;
    
    // 使用 marker 的經緯度位置來計算預覽位置
    const markerLatLng = new google.maps.LatLng(restroom.latitude, restroom.longitude);
    
    // 計算預覽卡片的最佳位置
    const cardWidth = 350; // 預覽卡片寬度
    const cardHeight = 200; // 預覽卡片高度（估算）
    const margin = 20; // 邊距
    
    // 使用 Google Maps 投影將經緯度轉換為像素位置
    const projection = mapRef.current.getProjection();
    if (!projection) return;
    
    const markerPixel = projection.fromLatLngToPoint(markerLatLng);
    const mapBounds = mapRef.current.getBounds();
    const topRight = mapBounds?.getNorthEast();
    const bottomLeft = mapBounds?.getSouthWest();
    
    if (!topRight || !bottomLeft) return;
    
    const topRightPixel = projection.fromLatLngToPoint(topRight);
    const bottomLeftPixel = projection.fromLatLngToPoint(bottomLeft);
    
    // 計算相對於地圖容器的像素位置
    const mapDiv = mapRef.current.getDiv();
    const mapWidth = mapDiv.offsetWidth;
    const mapHeight = mapDiv.offsetHeight;
    
    const scale = Math.pow(2, mapRef.current.getZoom() || 15);
    const worldCoordinate = markerPixel;
    const pixelCoordinate = new google.maps.Point(
      worldCoordinate.x * scale,
      worldCoordinate.y * scale
    );
    
    // 轉換為相對於地圖容器的位置
    const markerX = (pixelCoordinate.x - bottomLeftPixel.x * scale) * mapWidth / ((topRightPixel.x - bottomLeftPixel.x) * scale);
    const markerY = (pixelCoordinate.y - bottomLeftPixel.y * scale) * mapHeight / ((topRightPixel.y - bottomLeftPixel.y) * scale);
    
    let x = markerX + margin;
    let y = markerY - margin;
    
    // 檢查右邊界
    if (x + cardWidth > mapWidth) {
      x = markerX - cardWidth - margin; // 顯示在左邊
    }
    
    // 檢查上邊界
    if (y - cardHeight < 0) {
      y = markerY + margin; // 顯示在下面
    }
    
    setPreviewPosition({ x, y });
  };

  const handleMarkerLeave = () => {
    setHoveredRestroom(null);
  };

  const handleMapClick = () => {
    // Map click handler - could be used for future features
  };

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <Typography color="error">
          Error loading Google Maps. Please check your API key.
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
        <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>Loading map...</Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ 
      width: '100%', 
      height: '100%', 
      position: 'relative',
      minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 64px)'
    }}>
      <GoogleMap
        mapContainerStyle={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
        center={mapCenter}
        zoom={mapZoom}
        options={DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS}
        onClick={handleMapClick}
        onLoad={(map) => {
          mapRef.current = map;
        }}
      >
        {restrooms.map((restroom) => (
          <RestroomMarker
            key={restroom.id}
            restroom={restroom}
            onClick={() => handleMarkerClick(restroom)}
            onHover={(event) => handleMarkerHover(restroom, event)}
            onLeave={handleMarkerLeave}
            isSelected={selectedRestroom?.id === restroom.id}
          />
        ))}
      </GoogleMap>
      
      {loading && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
            boxShadow: 1,
          }}
        >
          <CircularProgress size={20} />
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            Loading restrooms...
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
      
      {error && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            backgroundColor: 'error.light',
            color: 'white',
            padding: 1,
            borderRadius: 1,
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="caption">{error}</Typography>
        </Box>
      )}

      {/* 廁所預覽 */}
      <RestroomPreview
        restroom={hoveredRestroom!}
        visible={!!hoveredRestroom}
        position={previewPosition}
      />
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapView;

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Marker } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { InfoWindow } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { Box, Typography, Chip, Rating } from '@mui/material';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { getMarkerSize } from '../../services/googleMaps';

interface RestroomMarkerProps {
  restroom: Restroom;
  onClick: () => void;
  onHover?: () => void;
  onLeave?: () => void;
  isSelected?: boolean;
}

const RestroomMarker: React.FC<RestroomMarkerProps> = ({ 
  restroom, 
  onClick,
  onHover,
  onLeave
}) => {
  const [showInfoWindow, setShowInfoWindow] = useState(false);

  const handleMarkerClick = () => {
    setShowInfoWindow(true);
    onClick();
  };

  const handleInfoWindowClose = () => {
    setShowInfoWindow(false);
  };

  const markerSize = getMarkerSize(restroom.average_rating);

  return (
    <>
      <Marker
        position={{ lat: restroom.latitude, lng: restroom.longitude }}
        onClick={handleMarkerClick}
        onMouseOver={onHover}
        onMouseOut={onLeave}
        icon={{
          url: `data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,${encodeURIComponent(`
            <svg width="${markerSize.width}" height="${markerSize.height}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
              <path d="M12 2C8.13 2 5 5.13 5 9c0 5.25 7 13 7 13s7-7.75 7-13c0-3.87-3.13-7-7-7zm0 9.5c-1.38 0-2.5-1.12-2.5-2.5s1.12-2.5 2.5-2.5 2.5 1.12 2.5 2.5-1.12 2.5-2.5 2.5z" fill="#1976d2"/>
            </svg>
          `)}`,
          scaledSize: new google.maps.Size(markerSize.width, markerSize.height),
          anchor: new google.maps.Point(markerSize.width / 2, markerSize.height),
        }}
      />
      
      {showInfoWindow && (
        <InfoWindow
          position={{ lat: restroom.latitude, lng: restroom.longitude }}
          onCloseClick={handleInfoWindowClose}
        >
          <Box sx={{ p: 1, minWidth: 200 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
              {restroom.name}
            </Typography>
            
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              {restroom.address}
            </Typography>
            
            {restroom.average_rating && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', mb: 1 }}>
                <Rating 
                  value={restroom.average_rating} 
                  readOnly 
                  size="small"
                />
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
                  ({restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)})
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            )}
            
            {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5, mt: 1 }}>
                {restroom.tags.slice(0, 3).map((tag, index) => (
                  <Chip
                    key={index}
                    label={tag.tag_value}
                    size="small"
                    color="primary"
                    variant="outlined"
                  />
                ))}
                {restroom.tags.length > 3 && (
                  <Chip
                    label={`+${restroom.tags.length - 3}`}
                    size="small"
                    color="default"
                    variant="outlined"
                  />
                )}
              </Box>
            )}
            
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
              Click for details
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </InfoWindow>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default RestroomMarker;

# 經緯度定位預覽視窗改進總結

## 改進內容

根據用戶需求，進一步改進了地圖上的廁所預覽視窗定位，現在使用 marker 的經緯度位置來精確計算預覽位置，而不是依賴滑鼠事件的位置。

## 主要修改

### 1. MapView 組件改進

**檔案位置**: `frontend/src/components/Map/MapView.tsx`

#### 經緯度定位邏輯
```typescript
const handleMarkerHover = (restroom: Restroom) => {
  setHoveredRestroom(restroom);
  
  if (!mapRef.current) return;
  
  // 使用 marker 的經緯度位置來計算預覽位置
  const markerLatLng = new google.maps.LatLng(restroom.latitude, restroom.longitude);
  
  // 計算預覽卡片的最佳位置
  const cardWidth = 350; // 預覽卡片寬度
  const cardHeight = 200; // 預覽卡片高度（估算）
  const margin = 20; // 邊距
  
  // 使用 Google Maps 投影將經緯度轉換為像素位置
  const projection = mapRef.current.getProjection();
  if (!projection) return;
  
  const markerPixel = projection.fromLatLngToPoint(markerLatLng);
  if (!markerPixel) return;
  
  const mapBounds = mapRef.current.getBounds();
  const topRight = mapBounds?.getNorthEast();
  const bottomLeft = mapBounds?.getSouthWest();
  
  if (!topRight || !bottomLeft) return;
  
  const topRightPixel = projection.fromLatLngToPoint(topRight);
  const bottomLeftPixel = projection.fromLatLngToPoint(bottomLeft);
  
  if (!topRightPixel || !bottomLeftPixel) return;
  
  // 計算相對於地圖容器的像素位置
  const mapDiv = mapRef.current.getDiv();
  const mapWidth = mapDiv.offsetWidth;
  const mapHeight = mapDiv.offsetHeight;
  
  const scale = Math.pow(2, mapRef.current.getZoom() || 15);
  const pixelCoordinate = new google.maps.Point(
    markerPixel.x * scale,
    markerPixel.y * scale
  );
  
  // 轉換為相對於地圖容器的位置
  const markerX = (pixelCoordinate.x - bottomLeftPixel.x * scale) * mapWidth / ((topRightPixel.x - bottomLeftPixel.x) * scale);
  const markerY = (pixelCoordinate.y - bottomLeftPixel.y * scale) * mapHeight / ((topRightPixel.y - bottomLeftPixel.y) * scale);
  
  let x = markerX + margin;
  let y = markerY - margin;
  
  // 檢查右邊界
  if (x + cardWidth > mapWidth) {
    x = markerX - cardWidth - margin; // 顯示在左邊
  }
  
  // 檢查上邊界
  if (y - cardHeight < 0) {
    y = markerY + margin; // 顯示在下面
  }
  
  setPreviewPosition({ x, y });
};
```

#### 主要特色
- **精確經緯度定位**: 使用 marker 的實際經緯度坐標來計算位置
- **Google Maps 投影**: 使用 Google Maps 的投影系統將經緯度轉換為像素位置
- **地圖引用**: 添加了 `mapRef` 來訪問地圖實例
- **邊界檢測**: 自動檢測視窗邊界，確保預覽卡片不會超出螢幕

### 2. 地圖引用系統

#### 地圖載入處理
```typescript
<GoogleMap
  mapContainerStyle={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
  center={mapCenter}
  zoom={mapZoom}
  options={DEFAULT_MAP_OPTIONS}
  onClick={handleMapClick}
  onLoad={(map) => {
    mapRef.current = map;
  }}
>
```

#### 主要特色
- **地圖實例引用**: 使用 `useRef` 來存儲地圖實例
- **載入時初始化**: 在地圖載入完成時設置引用

### 3. RestroomMarker 組件更新

**檔案位置**: `frontend/src/components/Map/RestroomMarker.tsx`

#### 接口更新
```typescript
interface RestroomMarkerProps {
  restroom: Restroom;
  onClick: () => void;
  onHover?: () => void;  // 移除了 event 參數
  onLeave?: () => void;
  isSelected?: boolean;
}
```

#### 主要特色
- **簡化接口**: 移除了 `onHover` 事件的 `event` 參數
- **直接調用**: 直接調用 hover 處理函數，不傳遞事件對象

## 定位邏輯詳解

### 1. 經緯度轉像素位置
```typescript
// 創建經緯度對象
const markerLatLng = new google.maps.LatLng(restroom.latitude, restroom.longitude);

// 使用投影將經緯度轉換為世界坐標
const markerPixel = projection.fromLatLngToPoint(markerLatLng);

// 計算縮放比例
const scale = Math.pow(2, mapRef.current.getZoom() || 15);

// 轉換為像素坐標
const pixelCoordinate = new google.maps.Point(
  markerPixel.x * scale,
  markerPixel.y * scale
);
```

### 2. 地圖邊界計算
```typescript
// 獲取地圖邊界
const mapBounds = mapRef.current.getBounds();
const topRight = mapBounds?.getNorthEast();
const bottomLeft = mapBounds?.getSouthWest();

// 將邊界轉換為像素坐標
const topRightPixel = projection.fromLatLngToPoint(topRight);
const bottomLeftPixel = projection.fromLatLngToPoint(bottomLeft);
```

### 3. 相對位置計算
```typescript
// 計算相對於地圖容器的位置
const markerX = (pixelCoordinate.x - bottomLeftPixel.x * scale) * mapWidth / ((topRightPixel.x - bottomLeftPixel.x) * scale);
const markerY = (pixelCoordinate.y - bottomLeftPixel.y * scale) * mapHeight / ((topRightPixel.y - bottomLeftPixel.y) * scale);
```

## 技術優勢

### 1. 精確性
- **真實位置**: 使用 marker 的實際經緯度坐標
- **投影準確**: 使用 Google Maps 的投影系統確保準確性
- **縮放適應**: 自動適應地圖縮放級別

### 2. 穩定性
- **不依賴事件**: 不依賴滑鼠事件的位置信息
- **地圖同步**: 與地圖的實際狀態保持同步
- **邊界安全**: 自動處理地圖邊界情況

### 3. 性能
- **高效計算**: 使用 Google Maps 內建的投影功能
- **緩存友好**: 地圖引用可以被緩存和重用
- **減少重計算**: 只在需要時計算位置

## 用戶體驗改進

### 1. 視覺一致性
- **精確對應**: 預覽視窗精確對應到 marker 的實際位置
- **縮放適應**: 在地圖縮放時保持正確的相對位置
- **邊界處理**: 智能處理邊界情況，確保預覽視窗始終可見

### 2. 互動體驗
- **穩定顯示**: 預覽視窗位置穩定，不會因為滑鼠移動而跳動
- **精確定位**: 預覽視窗始終顯示在 marker 的正確位置旁邊
- **視覺關聯**: 保持預覽視窗與 marker 的視覺關聯

## 測試建議

### 1. 位置精度測試
- 測試不同經緯度的 marker
- 測試不同縮放級別下的位置準確性
- 測試地圖平移後的位置保持

### 2. 邊界處理測試
- 測試螢幕邊緣的 marker
- 測試預覽視窗的邊界調整
- 測試不同螢幕尺寸下的顯示效果

### 3. 性能測試
- 測試大量 marker 的預覽性能
- 測試地圖縮放時的響應速度
- 測試記憶體使用情況

## 使用方式

1. 將滑鼠移到地圖上的任何廁所 marker 上
2. 預覽視窗會精確地出現在 marker 的經緯度位置旁邊
3. 預覽視窗會自動調整位置以避免超出螢幕邊界
4. 滑鼠離開 marker 時，預覽視窗會自動隱藏

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Button,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardMedia,
  Grid,
  Chip,
  Rating,
  TextField,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  Divider,
  Avatar,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemAvatar,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Send as SendIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { Restroom } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI, commentAPI } from '../services/api';

const RestroomDetailPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [restroom, setRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');
  const [newRating, setNewRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      fetchRestroom();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const fetchRestroom = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const response = await restroomAPI.getById(parseInt(id!));
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestroom(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restroom details');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restroom details');
      console.error('Error fetching restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitComment = async () => {
    if (!newComment.trim() || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.add(restroom.id, { content: newComment.trim() });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewComment('');
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get new comment
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting comment:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitRating = async () => {
    if (!newRating || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.rate(restroom.id, { rating: newRating });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewRating(0);
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get updated rating
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting rating:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
          <CircularProgress />
          <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>載入中...</Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (error || !restroom) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
          <Alert severity="error">{error || '廁所不存在'}</Alert>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            sx={{ mt: 2 }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            返回地圖
          </Button>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            🚽 {restroom.name}
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Grid container spacing={3}>
          {/* 廁所資訊 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={8}>
            <Card>
              {restroom.picture_url && (
                <CardMedia
                  component="img"
                  height="200"
                  image={restroom.picture_url}
                  alt={restroom.name}
                />
              )}
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
                  {restroom.name}
                </Typography>
                
                <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                  📍 {restroom.address}
                </Typography>
                
                {restroom.description && (
                  <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    {restroom.description}
                  </Typography>
                )}

                {/* 標籤 */}
                {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Box sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                      特色標籤
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {restroom.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Box>
                )}

                {/* 評分 */}
                <Box sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分
                  </Typography>
                  {restroom.average_rating ? (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                      <Rating value={restroom.average_rating} readOnly />
                      <Typography variant="h6">
                        {restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)} / 5.0
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        ({restroom.ratings?.length || 0} 個評分)
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  ) : (
                    <Typography color="text.secondary">尚無評分</Typography>
                  )}
                </Box>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 評論區 */}
            <Card sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  評論 ({restroom.comments?.length || 0})
                </Typography>
                
                {/* 新增評論 */}
                {user && (
                  <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      multiline
                      rows={3}
                      placeholder="分享你的使用心得..."
                      value={newComment}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={submitting}
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<SendIcon />}
                      onClick={handleSubmitComment}
                      disabled={!newComment.trim() || submitting}
                      sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                    >
                      發表評論
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                )}

                <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />

                {/* 評論列表 */}
                {restroom.comments && restroom.comments.length > 0 ? (
                  <List>
                    {restroom.comments.map((comment) => (
                      <ListItem key={comment.id} alignItems="flex-start">
                        <ListItemAvatar>
                          <Avatar>
                            {comment.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}
                          </Avatar>
                        </ListItemAvatar>
                        <ListItemText
                          primary={comment.username || '匿名用戶'}
                          secondary={
                            <Box>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                {new Date(comment.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                                {comment.content}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          }
                        />
                      </ListItem>
                    ))}
                  </List>
                ) : (
                  <Typography color="text.secondary" textAlign="center" sx={{ py: 4 }}>
                    尚無評論，成為第一個評論的人吧！
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>

          {/* 側邊欄 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
            {/* 評分廁所 */}
            {user && (

                  </Typography>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}>
                    <Rating
                      value={newRating}
                      onChange={(_, value) => setNewRating(value || 0)}
                      size="large"
                    />
                    {newRating > 0 && (
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        {newRating} 星
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    startIcon={<StarIcon />}
                    onClick={handleSubmitRating}
                    disabled={!newRating || submitting}
                    fullWidth

                    提交評分

                  建立時間：{new Date(restroom.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                </Typography>
                {restroom.distance && (

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Button,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardMedia,
  Grid,
  Chip,
  Rating,
  TextField,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  Divider,
  Avatar,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemAvatar,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogContentText,
  DialogActions,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Send as SendIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { Restroom } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI, commentAPI } from '../services/api';

const RestroomDetailPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [restroom, setRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');
  const [newRating, setNewRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      fetchRestroom();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const fetchRestroom = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const response = await restroomAPI.getById(parseInt(id!));
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestroom(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restroom details');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restroom details');
      console.error('Error fetching restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitComment = async () => {
    if (!newComment.trim() || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.add(restroom.id, { content: newComment.trim() });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewComment('');
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get new comment
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting comment:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitRating = async () => {
    if (!newRating || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.rate(restroom.id, { rating: newRating });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewRating(0);
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get updated rating
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting rating:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
          <CircularProgress />
          <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>載入中...</Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (error || !restroom) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
          <Alert severity="error">{error || '廁所不存在'}</Alert>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            sx={{ mt: 2 }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            返回地圖
          </Button>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            🚽 {restroom.name}
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Grid container spacing={3}>
          {/* 廁所資訊 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={8}>
            <Card>
              {restroom.picture_url && (
                <CardMedia
                  component="img"
                  height="200"
                  image={restroom.picture_url}
                  alt={restroom.name}
                />
              )}
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
                  {restroom.name}
                </Typography>
                
                <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                  📍 {restroom.address}
                </Typography>
                
                {restroom.description && (
                  <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    {restroom.description}
                  </Typography>
                )}

                {/* 標籤 */}
                {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Box sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                      特色標籤
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {restroom.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Box>
                )}

                {/* 評分 */}
                <Box sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分
                  </Typography>
                  {restroom.average_rating ? (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                      <Rating value={restroom.average_rating} readOnly />
                      <Typography variant="h6">
                        {restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)} / 5.0
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        ({restroom.ratings?.length || 0} 個評分)
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  ) : (
                    <Typography color="text.secondary">尚無評分</Typography>
                  )}
                </Box>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 評論區 */}
            <Card sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  評論 ({restroom.comments?.length || 0})
                </Typography>
                
                {/* 新增評論 */}
                {user && (
                  <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      multiline
                      rows={3}
                      placeholder="分享你的使用心得..."
                      value={newComment}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={submitting}
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<SendIcon />}
                      onClick={handleSubmitComment}
                      disabled={!newComment.trim() || submitting}
                      sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                    >
                      發表評論
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                )}

                <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />

                {/* 評論列表 */}
                {restroom.comments && restroom.comments.length > 0 ? (
                  <List>
                    {restroom.comments.map((comment) => (
                      <ListItem key={comment.id} alignItems="flex-start">
                        <ListItemAvatar>
                          <Avatar>
                            {comment.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}
                          </Avatar>
                        </ListItemAvatar>
                        <ListItemText
                          primary={comment.username || '匿名用戶'}
                          secondary={
                            <Box>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                {new Date(comment.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                                {comment.content}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          }
                        />
                      </ListItem>
                    ))}
                  </List>
                ) : (
                  <Typography color="text.secondary" textAlign="center" sx={{ py: 4 }}>
                    尚無評論，成為第一個評論的人吧！
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>

          {/* 側邊欄 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
            {/* 評分廁所 */}
            {user && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分這個廁所
                  </Typography>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}>
                    <Rating
                      value={newRating}
                      onChange={(_, value) => setNewRating(value || 0)}
                      size="large"
                    />
                    {newRating > 0 && (
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        {newRating} 星
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    startIcon={<StarIcon />}
                    onClick={handleSubmitRating}
                    disabled={!newRating || submitting}
                    fullWidth
                  >
                    提交評分
                  </Button>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 廁所資訊 */}
            <Card>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  廁所資訊
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立者：{restroom.creator?.username || '未知'}
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立時間：{new Date(restroom.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                </Typography>
                {restroom.distance && (
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    距離：{restroom.distance.toFixed(2)} km
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RestroomDetailPage;

  Grid,
  Chip,
  Rating,
  TextField,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  Divider,
  Avatar,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemAvatar,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogContentText,
  DialogActions,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Send as SendIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { Restroom } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI, commentAPI } from '../services/api';

const RestroomDetailPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [restroom, setRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');
  const [newRating, setNewRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [deleteDialogOpen, setDeleteDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      fetchRestroom();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const fetchRestroom = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const response = await restroomAPI.getById(parseInt(id!));
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestroom(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restroom details');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restroom details');
      console.error('Error fetching restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitComment = async () => {
    if (!newComment.trim() || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.add(restroom.id, { content: newComment.trim() });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewComment('');
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get new comment
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting comment:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitRating = async () => {
    if (!newRating || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.rate(restroom.id, { rating: newRating });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewRating(0);
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get updated rating
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting rating:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRestroom = async () => {
    if (!restroom) return;

    try {
      setDeleting(true);
      const response = await restroomAPI.delete(restroom.id);
      if (response.success) {
        navigate('/map');
      } else {
        setError('刪除廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error deleting restroom:', err);
      setError('刪除廁所時發生錯誤');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
      setDeleteDialogOpen(false);
    }
  };

  // 檢查是否為廁所創建者
  const isCreator = user && restroom && user.id === restroom.creator_id;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
          <CircularProgress />
          <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>載入中...</Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (error || !restroom) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
          <Alert severity="error">{error || '廁所不存在'}</Alert>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            sx={{ mt: 2 }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            返回地圖
          </Button>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            🚽 {restroom.name}
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Grid container spacing={3}>
          {/* 廁所資訊 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={8}>
            <Card>
              {restroom.picture_url && (
                <CardMedia
                  component="img"
                  height="200"
                  image={restroom.picture_url}
                  alt={restroom.name}
                />
              )}
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
                  {restroom.name}
                </Typography>
                
                <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                  📍 {restroom.address}
                </Typography>
                
                {restroom.description && (
                  <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    {restroom.description}
                  </Typography>
                )}

                {/* 標籤 */}
                {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Box sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                      特色標籤
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {restroom.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Box>
                )}

                {/* 評分 */}
                <Box sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分
                  </Typography>
                  {restroom.average_rating ? (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                      <Rating value={restroom.average_rating} readOnly />
                      <Typography variant="h6">
                        {restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)} / 5.0
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        ({restroom.ratings?.length || 0} 個評分)
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  ) : (
                    <Typography color="text.secondary">尚無評分</Typography>
                  )}
                </Box>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 評論區 */}
            <Card sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  評論 ({restroom.comments?.length || 0})
                </Typography>
                
                {/* 新增評論 */}
                {user && (
                  <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      multiline
                      rows={3}
                      placeholder="分享你的使用心得..."
                      value={newComment}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={submitting}
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<SendIcon />}
                      onClick={handleSubmitComment}
                      disabled={!newComment.trim() || submitting}
                      sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                    >
                      發表評論
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                )}

                <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />

                {/* 評論列表 */}
                {restroom.comments && restroom.comments.length > 0 ? (
                  <List>
                    {restroom.comments.map((comment) => (
                      <ListItem key={comment.id} alignItems="flex-start">
                        <ListItemAvatar>
                          <Avatar>
                            {comment.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}
                          </Avatar>
                        </ListItemAvatar>
                        <ListItemText
                          primary={comment.username || '匿名用戶'}
                          secondary={
                            <Box>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                {new Date(comment.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                                {comment.content}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          }
                        />
                      </ListItem>
                    ))}
                  </List>
                ) : (
                  <Typography color="text.secondary" textAlign="center" sx={{ py: 4 }}>
                    尚無評論，成為第一個評論的人吧！
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>

          {/* 側邊欄 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
            {/* 評分廁所 */}
            {user && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分這個廁所
                  </Typography>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}>
                    <Rating
                      value={newRating}
                      onChange={(_, value) => setNewRating(value || 0)}
                      size="large"
                    />
                    {newRating > 0 && (
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        {newRating} 星
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    startIcon={<StarIcon />}
                    onClick={handleSubmitRating}
                    disabled={!newRating || submitting}
                    fullWidth
                  >
                    提交評分
                  </Button>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 廁所資訊 */}
            <Card>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  廁所資訊
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立者：{restroom.creator?.username || '未知'}
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立時間：{new Date(restroom.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                </Typography>
                {restroom.distance && (
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    距離：{restroom.distance.toFixed(2)} km
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RestroomDetailPage;
