  Grid,
  Chip,
  Rating,
  TextField,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  Divider,
  Avatar,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemAvatar,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogContentText,
  DialogActions,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Send as SendIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { Restroom } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI, commentAPI } from '../services/api';

const RestroomDetailPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [restroom, setRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');
  const [newRating, setNewRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [deleteDialogOpen, setDeleteDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      fetchRestroom();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const fetchRestroom = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const response = await restroomAPI.getById(parseInt(id!));
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestroom(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restroom details');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restroom details');
      console.error('Error fetching restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitComment = async () => {
    if (!newComment.trim() || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.add(restroom.id, { content: newComment.trim() });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewComment('');
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get new comment
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting comment:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitRating = async () => {
    if (!newRating || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.rate(restroom.id, { rating: newRating });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewRating(0);
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get updated rating
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting rating:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRestroom = async () => {
    if (!restroom) return;

    try {
      setDeleting(true);
      const response = await restroomAPI.delete(restroom.id);
      if (response.success) {
        navigate('/map');
      } else {
        setError('刪除廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error deleting restroom:', err);
      setError('刪除廁所時發生錯誤');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
      setDeleteDialogOpen(false);
    }
  };

  // 檢查是否為廁所創建者
  const isCreator = user && restroom && user.id === restroom.creator_id;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
          <CircularProgress />
          <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>載入中...</Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (error || !restroom) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
          <Alert severity="error">{error || '廁所不存在'}</Alert>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            sx={{ mt: 2 }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            返回地圖
          </Button>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            🚽 {restroom.name}
          </Typography>
          {isCreator && (
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(true)}
              title="刪除廁所"
            >
              <DeleteIcon />
            </IconButton>
          )}
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Grid container spacing={3}>
          {/* 廁所資訊 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={8}>
            <Card>
              {restroom.picture_url && (
                <CardMedia
                  component="img"
                  height="200"
                  image={restroom.picture_url}
                  alt={restroom.name}
                />
              )}
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
                  {restroom.name}
                </Typography>
                
                <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                  📍 {restroom.address}
                </Typography>
                
                {restroom.description && (
                  <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    {restroom.description}
                  </Typography>
                )}

                {/* 標籤 */}
                {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Box sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                      特色標籤
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {restroom.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Box>
                )}

                {/* 評分 */}
                <Box sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分
                  </Typography>
                  {restroom.average_rating ? (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                      <Rating value={restroom.average_rating} readOnly />
                      <Typography variant="h6">
                        {restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)} / 5.0
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        ({restroom.ratings?.length || 0} 個評分)
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  ) : (
                    <Typography color="text.secondary">尚無評分</Typography>
                  )}
                </Box>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 評論區 */}
            <Card sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  評論 ({restroom.comments?.length || 0})
                </Typography>
                
                {/* 新增評論 */}
                {user && (
                  <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      multiline
                      rows={3}
                      placeholder="分享你的使用心得..."
                      value={newComment}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={submitting}
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<SendIcon />}
                      onClick={handleSubmitComment}
                      disabled={!newComment.trim() || submitting}
                      sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                    >
                      發表評論
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                )}

                <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />

                {/* 評論列表 */}
                {restroom.comments && restroom.comments.length > 0 ? (
                  <List>
                    {restroom.comments.map((comment) => (
                      <ListItem key={comment.id} alignItems="flex-start">
                        <ListItemAvatar>
                          <Avatar>
                            {comment.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}
                          </Avatar>
                        </ListItemAvatar>
                        <ListItemText
                          primary={comment.username || '匿名用戶'}
                          secondary={
                            <Box>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                {new Date(comment.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                                {comment.content}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          }
                        />
                      </ListItem>
                    ))}
                  </List>
                ) : (
                  <Typography color="text.secondary" textAlign="center" sx={{ py: 4 }}>
                    尚無評論，成為第一個評論的人吧！
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>

          {/* 側邊欄 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
            {/* 評分廁所 */}
            {user && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分這個廁所
                  </Typography>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}>
                    <Rating
                      value={newRating}
                      onChange={(_, value) => setNewRating(value || 0)}
                      size="large"
                    />
                    {newRating > 0 && (
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        {newRating} 星
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    startIcon={<StarIcon />}
                    onClick={handleSubmitRating}
                    disabled={!newRating || submitting}
                    fullWidth
                  >
                    提交評分
                  </Button>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 廁所資訊 */}
            <Card>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  廁所資訊
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立者：{restroom.creator?.username || '未知'}
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立時間：{new Date(restroom.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                </Typography>
                {restroom.distance && (
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    距離：{restroom.distance.toFixed(2)} km
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </Container>

      {/* 刪除確認對話框 */}
      <Dialog
        open={deleteDialogOpen}
        onClose={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
        aria-labelledby="delete-dialog-title"
        aria-describedby="delete-dialog-description"
      >
        <DialogTitle id="delete-dialog-title">
          確認刪除廁所
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogContentText id="delete-dialog-description">
            您確定要刪除「{restroom?.name}」這個廁所嗎？此操作無法復原，所有相關的評論和評分也會被刪除。
          </DialogContentText>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button 
            onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
            disabled={deleting}
          >
            取消
          </Button>
          <Button 
            onClick={handleDeleteRestroom}
            color="error"
            variant="contained"
            disabled={deleting}
            startIcon={deleting ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <DeleteIcon />}
          >
            {deleting ? '刪除中...' : '確認刪除'}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RestroomDetailPage;

```

讓我先讀取 README.md 的內容：


```markdown
# NTU 廁所地圖 - 全端網頁應用程式

一個專為台灣大學及周邊地區設計的廁所地圖應用程式，讓用戶可以找到、新增、評分和分享廁所資訊。

## 🚀 功能特色

### 核心功能
- 🗺️ **互動式地圖**：使用 Google Maps 顯示廁所位置
- 🔍 **智能搜尋**：根據位置、評分、標籤篩選廁所
- ➕ **新增廁所**：用戶可以新增新的廁所資訊
- 🗑️ **刪除廁所**：創建者可以刪除自己新增的廁所
- ⭐ **評分系統**：1-5 星評分和評論功能
- 🏷️ **標籤系統**：免治馬桶、無障礙設施、24小時開放等標籤
- 👥 **好友系統**：添加好友、查看好友動態
- 🖱️ **懸停預覽**：滑鼠懸停顯示廁所詳細信息
- 📱 **響應式設計**：支援手機、平板、桌面裝置

### 技術特色
- **前端**：React + TypeScript + Material UI
- **後端**：Node.js + Express + TypeScript
- **資料庫**：SQLite
- **地圖服務**：Google Maps API
- **認證**：JWT Token
- **檔案上傳**：支援廁所照片

## 🛠️ 技術架構

### 前端技術
- **React 18** - 現代化 UI 框架
- **TypeScript** - 型別安全
- **Material UI** - 美觀的 UI 組件庫
- **React Router** - 路由管理
- **Axios** - HTTP 請求
- **Google Maps JavaScript API** - 地圖功能

### 後端技術
- **Node.js** - JavaScript 運行環境
- **Express** - Web 框架
- **TypeScript** - 型別安全
- **SQLite** - 輕量級資料庫
- **JWT** - 身份驗證
- **bcryptjs** - 密碼加密
- **multer** - 檔案上傳
- **Google Maps Services** - 地理編碼

## 📁 專案結構

```
hw4/
├── backend/                 # 後端 API
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── config/         # 資料庫和環境配置
│   │   ├── controllers/    # API 控制器
│   │   ├── middleware/     # 中間件
│   │   ├── models/         # 資料庫模型
│   │   ├── routes/         # API 路由
│   │   ├── services/       # 外部服務
│   │   ├── types/          # TypeScript 型別
│   │   └── server.ts       # 伺服器入口
│   ├── uploads/            # 上傳檔案目錄
│   ├── package.json
│   └── tsconfig.json
├── frontend/               # 前端應用
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── components/     # React 組件
│   │   ├── contexts/       # React Context
│   │   ├── pages/          # 頁面組件
│   │   ├── services/       # API 服務
│   │   ├── types/          # TypeScript 型別
│   │   └── App.tsx         # 應用程式入口
│   ├── public/
│   ├── package.json
│   └── vite.config.ts
└── README.md
```

## 🚀 快速開始

### 環境需求
- Node.js 18+ 
- npm 或 yarn
- Google Maps API Key

### 1. 安裝依賴

#### 後端
```bash
cd backend
npm install
```

#### 前端
```bash
cd frontend
npm install
```

### 2. 環境變數設定

#### 後端 (.env)
```env
PORT=5000
JWT_SECRET=your-super-secret-jwt-key-here
GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=your-google-maps-api-key
DATABASE_PATH=./database.sqlite
NODE_ENV=development
```

#### 前端 (.env)
```env
VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:5000/api
VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=your-google-maps-api-key
```

### 3. 啟動應用程式

#### 方法一：分別啟動（開發模式）
```bash
# 啟動後端
cd backend
npm run dev

# 啟動前端（新開終端）
cd frontend
npm run dev
```

#### 方法二：一次建置和啟動（推薦）
```bash
# Windows
start.bat

# Linux/Mac
./start.sh
```

#### 方法三：手動一次啟動
```bash
# 建置後端
cd backend
npm run build

# 建置前端
cd ../frontend
npm run build

# 啟動後端（背景運行）
cd ../backend
npm start &

# 啟動前端
cd ../frontend
npm run preview
```

### 4. 訪問應用程式
- 前端：http://localhost:5173
- 後端 API：http://localhost:5000

## 📊 資料庫結構

### 主要表格
- **users** - 用戶資訊
- **restrooms** - 廁所資訊
- **tags** - 標籤系統
- **restroom_tags** - 廁所標籤關聯
- **comments** - 評論和評分
- **friendships** - 好友關係

## 🔧 API 端點

### 認證
- `POST /api/auth/register` - 註冊
- `POST /api/auth/login` - 登入
- `POST /api/auth/logout` - 登出

### 廁所
- `GET /api/restrooms` - 取得所有廁所
- `POST /api/restrooms` - 新增廁所
- `GET /api/restrooms/:id` - 取得特定廁所
- `PUT /api/restrooms/:id` - 更新廁所
- `DELETE /api/restrooms/:id` - 刪除廁所
- `GET /api/restrooms/nearest` - 找最近的廁所

### 評論
- `POST /api/comments/restrooms/:restroom_id/comments` - 新增評論
- `GET /api/comments/restrooms/:restroom_id/comments` - 取得廁所評論
- `PUT /api/comments/:id` - 更新評論
- `DELETE /api/comments/:id` - 刪除評論

### 好友系統
- `POST /api/friends/send-request` - 發送好友請求
- `POST /api/friends/accept-request` - 接受好友請求
- `POST /api/friends/reject-request` - 拒絕好友請求
- `GET /api/friends/` - 取得好友列表
- `GET /api/friends/requests` - 取得好友請求
- `GET /api/friends/activity` - 取得好友動態

## 🎨 主要頁面

### 1. 首頁

   - ✅ 只有廁所的創建者才能看到刪除按鈕
   - ✅ 點擊刪除按鈕會彈出確認對話框
   - ✅ 確認對話框會警告用戶此操作無法復原

### 🎯 使用方式：

1. **進入廁所詳情頁面**：點擊地圖上的任何廁所標記
2. **查看刪除按鈕**：如果你是該廁所的創建者，會在頁面頂部看到垃圾桶圖標
3. **確認刪除**：點擊刪除按鈕，會彈出確認對話框
4. **完成刪除**：確認後，廁所及其相關數據會被永久刪除

### 🛡️ 安全特性：

- **權限控制**：只有廁所的創建者才能看到刪除按鈕
- **確認機制**：刪除前會彈出確認對話框，防止誤刪
- **數據完整性**：刪除廁所時會自動刪除相關的評論和評分
- **用戶體驗**：刪除成功後會自動跳轉回地圖頁面

- 🖱️ **懸停預覽**：滑鼠懸停顯示廁所詳細信息

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Button,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardMedia,
  Grid,
  Chip,
  Rating,
  TextField,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  Divider,
  Avatar,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemAvatar,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogContentText,
  DialogActions,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Send as SendIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { Restroom } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI, commentAPI } from '../services/api';

const RestroomDetailPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [restroom, setRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');
  const [newRating, setNewRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [deleteDialogOpen, setDeleteDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      fetchRestroom();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const fetchRestroom = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const response = await restroomAPI.getById(parseInt(id!));
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestroom(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restroom details');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restroom details');
      console.error('Error fetching restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitComment = async () => {
    if (!newComment.trim() || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.add(restroom.id, { content: newComment.trim() });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewComment('');
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get new comment
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting comment:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitRating = async () => {
    if (!newRating || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.rate(restroom.id, { rating: newRating });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewRating(0);
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get updated rating
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting rating:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRestroom = async () => {
    if (!restroom) return;

    try {
      setDeleting(true);
      const response = await restroomAPI.delete(restroom.id);
      if (response.success) {
        navigate('/map');
      } else {
        setError('刪除廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error deleting restroom:', err);
      setError('刪除廁所時發生錯誤');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
      setDeleteDialogOpen(false);
    }
  };

  // 檢查是否為廁所創建者
  const isCreator = user && restroom && user.id === restroom.creator_id;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
          <CircularProgress />
          <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>載入中...</Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (error || !restroom) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
          <Alert severity="error">{error || '廁所不存在'}</Alert>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            sx={{ mt: 2 }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            返回地圖
          </Button>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            🚽 {restroom.name}
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Grid container spacing={3}>
          {/* 廁所資訊 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={8}>
            <Card>
              {restroom.picture_url && (
                <CardMedia
                  component="img"
                  height="200"
                  image={restroom.picture_url}
                  alt={restroom.name}
                />
              )}
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
                  {restroom.name}
                </Typography>
                
                <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                  📍 {restroom.address}
                </Typography>
                
                {restroom.description && (
                  <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    {restroom.description}
                  </Typography>
                )}

                {/* 標籤 */}
                {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Box sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                      特色標籤
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {restroom.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Box>
                )}

                {/* 評分 */}
                <Box sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分
                  </Typography>
                  {restroom.average_rating ? (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                      <Rating value={restroom.average_rating} readOnly />
                      <Typography variant="h6">
                        {restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)} / 5.0
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        ({restroom.ratings?.length || 0} 個評分)
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  ) : (
                    <Typography color="text.secondary">尚無評分</Typography>
                  )}
                </Box>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 評論區 */}
            <Card sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  評論 ({restroom.comments?.length || 0})
                </Typography>
                
                {/* 新增評論 */}
                {user && (
                  <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      multiline
                      rows={3}
                      placeholder="分享你的使用心得..."
                      value={newComment}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={submitting}
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<SendIcon />}
                      onClick={handleSubmitComment}
                      disabled={!newComment.trim() || submitting}
                      sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                    >
                      發表評論
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                )}

                <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />

                {/* 評論列表 */}
                {restroom.comments && restroom.comments.length > 0 ? (
                  <List>
                    {restroom.comments.map((comment) => (
                      <ListItem key={comment.id} alignItems="flex-start">
                        <ListItemAvatar>
                          <Avatar>
                            {comment.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}
                          </Avatar>
                        </ListItemAvatar>
                        <ListItemText
                          primary={comment.username || '匿名用戶'}
                          secondary={
                            <Box>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                {new Date(comment.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                                {comment.content}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          }
                        />
                      </ListItem>
                    ))}
                  </List>
                ) : (
                  <Typography color="text.secondary" textAlign="center" sx={{ py: 4 }}>
                    尚無評論，成為第一個評論的人吧！
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>

          {/* 側邊欄 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
            {/* 評分廁所 */}
            {user && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分這個廁所
                  </Typography>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}>
                    <Rating
                      value={newRating}
                      onChange={(_, value) => setNewRating(value || 0)}
                      size="large"
                    />
                    {newRating > 0 && (
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        {newRating} 星
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    startIcon={<StarIcon />}
                    onClick={handleSubmitRating}
                    disabled={!newRating || submitting}
                    fullWidth
                  >
                    提交評分
                  </Button>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 廁所資訊 */}
            <Card>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  廁所資訊
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立者：{restroom.creator?.username || '未知'}
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立時間：{new Date(restroom.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                </Typography>
                {restroom.distance && (
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    距離：{restroom.distance.toFixed(2)} km
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </Container>

      {/* 刪除確認對話框 */}
      <Dialog
        open={deleteDialogOpen}
        onClose={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
        aria-labelledby="delete-dialog-title"
        aria-describedby="delete-dialog-description"
      >
        <DialogTitle id="delete-dialog-title">
          確認刪除廁所
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogContentText id="delete-dialog-description">
            您確定要刪除「{restroom?.name}」這個廁所嗎？此操作無法復原，所有相關的評論和評分也會被刪除。
          </DialogContentText>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button 
            onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
            disabled={deleting}
          >
            取消
          </Button>
          <Button 
            onClick={handleDeleteRestroom}
            color="error"
            variant="contained"
            disabled={deleting}
            startIcon={deleting ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <DeleteIcon />}
          >
            {deleting ? '刪除中...' : '確認刪除'}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RestroomDetailPage;

                      value={newComment}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={submitting}
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<SendIcon />}
                      onClick={handleSubmitComment}
                      disabled={!newComment.trim() || submitting}
                      sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                    >
                      發表評論
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                )}

                <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />

                {/* 評論列表 */}
                {restroom.comments && restroom.comments.length > 0 ? (
                  <List>
                    {restroom.comments.map((comment) => (
                      <ListItem key={comment.id} alignItems="flex-start">
                        <ListItemAvatar>
                          <Avatar>
                            {comment.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}
                          </Avatar>
                        </ListItemAvatar>
                        <ListItemText
                          primary={comment.username || '匿名用戶'}
                          secondary={
                            <Box>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                {new Date(comment.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                                {comment.content}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          }
                        />
                      </ListItem>
                    ))}
                  </List>
                ) : (
                  <Typography color="text.secondary" textAlign="center" sx={{ py: 4 }}>
                    尚無評論，成為第一個評論的人吧！
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>

          {/* 側邊欄 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
            {/* 評分廁所 */}
            {user && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分這個廁所
                  </Typography>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}>
                    <Rating
                      value={newRating}
                      onChange={(_, value) => setNewRating(value || 0)}
                      size="large"
                    />
                    {newRating > 0 && (
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        {newRating} 星
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    startIcon={<StarIcon />}
                    onClick={handleSubmitRating}
                    disabled={!newRating || submitting}
                    fullWidth
                  >
                    提交評分
                  </Button>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 刪除廁所 */}
            {isCreator && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom color="error">
                    管理廁所
                  </Typography>
                  <Button
                    variant="outlined"
                    color="error"
                    startIcon={<DeleteIcon />}
                    onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(true)}
                    fullWidth
                  >
                    刪除廁所
                  </Button>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 廁所資訊 */}
            <Card>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  廁所資訊
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立者：{restroom.creator?.username || '未知'}
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立時間：{new Date(restroom.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                </Typography>
                {restroom.distance && (
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    距離：{restroom.distance.toFixed(2)} km
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </Container>

      {/* 刪除確認對話框 */}
      <Dialog
        open={deleteDialogOpen}
        onClose={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
        aria-labelledby="delete-dialog-title"
        aria-describedby="delete-dialog-description"
      >
        <DialogTitle id="delete-dialog-title">
          確認刪除廁所
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogContentText id="delete-dialog-description">
            您確定要刪除「{restroom?.name}」這個廁所嗎？此操作無法復原，所有相關的評論和評分也會被刪除。
          </DialogContentText>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button 
            onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
            disabled={deleting}
          >
            取消
          </Button>
          <Button 
            onClick={handleDeleteRestroom}
            color="error"
            variant="contained"
            disabled={deleting}
            startIcon={deleting ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <DeleteIcon />}
          >
            {deleting ? '刪除中...' : '確認刪除'}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RestroomDetailPage;

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Button,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardMedia,
  Grid,
  Chip,
  Rating,
  TextField,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  Divider,
  Avatar,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemAvatar,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogContentText,
  DialogActions,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Send as SendIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { Restroom } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI, commentAPI } from '../services/api';

const RestroomDetailPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [restroom, setRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');
  const [newRating, setNewRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [userRating, setUserRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [hasUserRated, setHasUserRated] = useState(false);
  const [isHovering, setIsHovering] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [deleteDialogOpen, setDeleteDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      fetchRestroom();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const fetchRestroom = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const response = await restroomAPI.getById(parseInt(id!));
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestroom(response.data);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restroom details');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restroom details');
      console.error('Error fetching restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitComment = async () => {
    if (!newComment.trim() || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.add(restroom.id, { content: newComment.trim() });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewComment('');
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get new comment
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting comment:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitRating = async () => {
    if (!newRating || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.rate(restroom.id, { rating: newRating });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewRating(0);
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get updated rating
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting rating:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRestroom = async () => {
    if (!restroom) return;

    try {
      setDeleting(true);
      const response = await restroomAPI.delete(restroom.id);
      if (response.success) {
        navigate('/map');
      } else {
        setError('刪除廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error deleting restroom:', err);
      setError('刪除廁所時發生錯誤');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
      setDeleteDialogOpen(false);
    }
  };

  // 檢查是否為廁所創建者
  const isCreator = user && restroom && user.id === restroom.creator_id;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
          <CircularProgress />
          <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>載入中...</Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (error || !restroom) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
          <Alert severity="error">{error || '廁所不存在'}</Alert>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            sx={{ mt: 2 }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            返回地圖
          </Button>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            🚽 {restroom.name}
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Grid container spacing={3}>
          {/* 廁所資訊 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={8}>
            <Card>
              {restroom.picture_url && (
                <CardMedia
                  component="img"
                  height="200"
                  image={restroom.picture_url}
                  alt={restroom.name}
                />
              )}
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
                  {restroom.name}
                </Typography>
                
                <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                  📍 {restroom.address}
                </Typography>
                
                {restroom.description && (
                  <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    {restroom.description}
                  </Typography>
                )}

                {/* 標籤 */}
                {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Box sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                      特色標籤
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {restroom.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Box>
                )}

                {/* 評分 */}
                <Box sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分
                  </Typography>
                  {restroom.average_rating ? (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                      <Rating value={restroom.average_rating} readOnly />
                      <Typography variant="h6">
                        {restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)} / 5.0
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        ({restroom.ratings?.length || 0} 個評分)
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  ) : (
                    <Typography color="text.secondary">尚無評分</Typography>
                  )}
                </Box>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 評論區 */}
            <Card sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  評論 ({restroom.comments?.length || 0})
                </Typography>
                
                {/* 新增評論 */}
                {user && (
                  <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      multiline
                      rows={3}
                      placeholder="分享你的使用心得..."
                      value={newComment}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={submitting}
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<SendIcon />}
                      onClick={handleSubmitComment}
                      disabled={!newComment.trim() || submitting}
                      sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                    >
                      發表評論
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                )}

                <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />

                {/* 評論列表 */}
                {restroom.comments && restroom.comments.length > 0 ? (
                  <List>
                    {restroom.comments.map((comment) => (
                      <ListItem key={comment.id} alignItems="flex-start">
                        <ListItemAvatar>
                          <Avatar>
                            {comment.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}
                          </Avatar>
                        </ListItemAvatar>
                        <ListItemText
                          primary={comment.username || '匿名用戶'}
                          secondary={
                            <Box>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                {new Date(comment.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                                {comment.content}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          }
                        />
                      </ListItem>
                    ))}
                  </List>
                ) : (
                  <Typography color="text.secondary" textAlign="center" sx={{ py: 4 }}>
                    尚無評論，成為第一個評論的人吧！
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>

          {/* 側邊欄 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
            {/* 評分廁所 */}
            {user && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分這個廁所
                  </Typography>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}>
                    <Rating
                      value={newRating}
                      onChange={(_, value) => setNewRating(value || 0)}
                      size="large"
                    />
                    {newRating > 0 && (
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        {newRating} 星
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    startIcon={<StarIcon />}
                    onClick={handleSubmitRating}
                    disabled={!newRating || submitting}
                    fullWidth
                  >
                    提交評分
                  </Button>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 刪除廁所 */}
            {isCreator && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom color="error">
                    管理廁所
                  </Typography>
                  <Button
                    variant="outlined"
                    color="error"
                    startIcon={<DeleteIcon />}
                    onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(true)}
                    fullWidth
                  >
                    刪除廁所
                  </Button>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 廁所資訊 */}
            <Card>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  廁所資訊
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立者：{restroom.creator?.username || '未知'}
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立時間：{new Date(restroom.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                </Typography>
                {restroom.distance && (
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    距離：{restroom.distance.toFixed(2)} km
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </Container>

      {/* 刪除確認對話框 */}
      <Dialog
        open={deleteDialogOpen}
        onClose={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
        aria-labelledby="delete-dialog-title"
        aria-describedby="delete-dialog-description"
      >
        <DialogTitle id="delete-dialog-title">
          確認刪除廁所
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogContentText id="delete-dialog-description">
            您確定要刪除「{restroom?.name}」這個廁所嗎？此操作無法復原，所有相關的評論和評分也會被刪除。
          </DialogContentText>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button 
            onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
            disabled={deleting}
          >
            取消
          </Button>
          <Button 
            onClick={handleDeleteRestroom}
            color="error"
            variant="contained"
            disabled={deleting}
            startIcon={deleting ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <DeleteIcon />}
          >
            {deleting ? '刪除中...' : '確認刪除'}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RestroomDetailPage;

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Button,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardMedia,
  Grid,
  Chip,
  Rating,
  TextField,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  Divider,
  Avatar,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemAvatar,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogContentText,
  DialogActions,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Send as SendIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { Restroom } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI, commentAPI } from '../services/api';

const RestroomDetailPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [restroom, setRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');
  const [newRating, setNewRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [userRating, setUserRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [hasUserRated, setHasUserRated] = useState(false);
  const [isHovering, setIsHovering] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [deleteDialogOpen, setDeleteDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      fetchRestroom();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const fetchRestroom = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const response = await restroomAPI.getById(parseInt(id!));
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestroom(response.data);
        
        // 檢查用戶是否已經評過分
        if (user && response.data.ratings) {
          const userRatingData = response.data.ratings.find(
            (rating: any) => rating.user_id === user.id
          );
          if (userRatingData) {
            setUserRating(userRatingData.rating);
            setHasUserRated(true);
            setNewRating(userRatingData.rating);
          }
        }
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restroom details');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restroom details');
      console.error('Error fetching restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitComment = async () => {
    if (!newComment.trim() || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.add(restroom.id, { content: newComment.trim() });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewComment('');
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get new comment
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting comment:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

            <Card>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  廁所資訊
                </Typography>

                  </Typography>

      </Container>

      {/* 刪除確認對話框 */}
      <Dialog

        onClose={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
        aria-labelledby="delete-dialog-title"

        <DialogContent>
          <DialogContentText id="delete-dialog-description">

        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button

            disabled={deleting}
          >

          </Button>
          <Button 
            onClick={handleDeleteRestroom}
            color="error"
            variant="contained"
            disabled={deleting}
            startIcon={deleting ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <DeleteIcon />}
          >
            {deleting ? '刪除中...' : '確認刪除'}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RestroomDetailPage;

    if (id) {

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const response = await restroomAPI.getById(parseInt(id!));
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestroom(response.data);
        
        // 檢查用戶是否已經評過分
        if (user && response.data.ratings) {
          const userRatingData = response.data.ratings.find(

            setUserRating(userRatingData.rating);

      if (response.success) {

      console.error('Error submitting comment:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);

      }

          確認刪除廁所
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogContentText id="delete-dialog-description">
            您確定要刪除「{restroom?.name}」這個廁所嗎？此操作無法復原，所有相關的評論和評分也會被刪除。
          </DialogContentText>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button 
            onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
            disabled={deleting}
          >
            取消
          </Button>
          <Button 
            onClick={handleDeleteRestroom}
            color="error"
            variant="contained"
            disabled={deleting}
            startIcon={deleting ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <DeleteIcon />}
          >
            {deleting ? '刪除中...' : '確認刪除'}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RestroomDetailPage;

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,

  DialogContentText,
  DialogActions,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Send as SendIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { Restroom } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI, commentAPI } from '../services/api';

const RestroomDetailPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [restroom, setRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');
  const [newRating, setNewRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [userRating, setUserRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [hasUserRated, setHasUserRated] = useState(false);
  const [isHovering, setIsHovering] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [deleteDialogOpen, setDeleteDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      fetchRestroom();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const fetchRestroom = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const response = await restroomAPI.getById(parseInt(id!));
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestroom(response.data);
        
        // 檢查用戶是否已經評過分
        if (user && response.data.ratings) {
          const userRatingData = response.data.ratings.find(
            (rating: any) => rating.user_id === user.id
          );
          if (userRatingData) {
            setUserRating(userRatingData.rating);
            setHasUserRated(true);
            setNewRating(userRatingData.rating);
          }
        }
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restroom details');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restroom details');
      console.error('Error fetching restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitComment = async () => {
    if (!newComment.trim() || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.add(restroom.id, { content: newComment.trim() });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewComment('');
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get new comment
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting comment:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitRating = async () => {
    if (!newRating || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.rate(restroom.id, { rating: newRating });
      if (response.success) {
        setUserRating(newRating);
        setHasUserRated(true);
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get updated rating
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting rating:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRestroom = async () => {
    if (!restroom) return;

    try {
      setDeleting(true);
      const response = await restroomAPI.delete(restroom.id);
      if (response.success) {
        navigate('/map');
      } else {
        setError('刪除廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error deleting restroom:', err);
      setError('刪除廁所時發生錯誤');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
      setDeleteDialogOpen(false);
    }
  };

  // 檢查是否為廁所創建者
  const isCreator = user && restroom && user.id === restroom.creator_id;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
          <CircularProgress />
          <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>載入中...</Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (error || !restroom) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
          <Alert severity="error">{error || '廁所不存在'}</Alert>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            sx={{ mt: 2 }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            返回地圖
          </Button>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            🚽 {restroom.name}
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Grid container spacing={3}>
          {/* 廁所資訊 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={8}>
            <Card>
              {restroom.picture_url && (
                <CardMedia
                  component="img"
                  height="200"
                  image={restroom.picture_url}
                  alt={restroom.name}
                />
              )}
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
                  {restroom.name}
                </Typography>
                
                <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                  📍 {restroom.address}
                </Typography>
                
                {restroom.description && (
                  <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    {restroom.description}
                  </Typography>
                )}

                {/* 標籤 */}
                {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Box sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                      特色標籤
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {restroom.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Box>
                )}

                {/* 評分 */}
                <Box sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分
                  </Typography>
                  {restroom.average_rating ? (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                      <Rating value={restroom.average_rating} readOnly />
                      <Typography variant="h6">
                        {restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)} / 5.0
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        ({restroom.ratings?.length || 0} 個評分)
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  ) : (
                    <Typography color="text.secondary">尚無評分</Typography>
                  )}
                </Box>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 評論區 */}
            <Card sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  評論 ({restroom.comments?.length || 0})
                </Typography>
                
                {/* 新增評論 */}
                {user && (
                  <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      multiline
                      rows={3}
                      placeholder="分享你的使用心得..."
                      value={newComment}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={submitting}
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<SendIcon />}
                      onClick={handleSubmitComment}
                      disabled={!newComment.trim() || submitting}
                      sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                    >
                      發表評論
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                )}

                <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />

                {/* 評論列表 */}
                {restroom.comments && restroom.comments.length > 0 ? (
                  <List>
                    {restroom.comments.map((comment) => (
                      <ListItem key={comment.id} alignItems="flex-start">
                        <ListItemAvatar>
                          <Avatar>
                            {comment.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}
                          </Avatar>
                        </ListItemAvatar>
                        <ListItemText
                          primary={comment.username || '匿名用戶'}
                          secondary={
                            <Box>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                {new Date(comment.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                                {comment.content}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          }
                        />
                      </ListItem>
                    ))}
                  </List>
                ) : (
                  <Typography color="text.secondary" textAlign="center" sx={{ py: 4 }}>
                    尚無評論，成為第一個評論的人吧！
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>

          {/* 側邊欄 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
            {/* 評分廁所 */}
            {user && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    {hasUserRated ? '我的評分' : '評分這個廁所'}
                  </Typography>
                  <Box 
                    sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}
                    onMouseEnter={() => setIsHovering(true)}
                    onMouseLeave={() => setIsHovering(false)}
                  >
                    <Rating
                      value={hasUserRated && !isHovering ? userRating : newRating}
                      onChange={(_, value) => setNewRating(value || 0)}
                      size="large"
                      readOnly={hasUserRated && !isHovering}
                    />
                    {(hasUserRated && !isHovering) ? (
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">

                      </Typography>
                    ) : newRating > 0 ? (
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">

                  {(!hasUserRated || isHovering) && (
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<StarIcon />}
                      onClick={handleSubmitRating}
                      disabled={!newRating || submitting}
                      fullWidth
                    >

                    </Button>
                  )}
                  {hasUserRated && !isHovering && (
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" textAlign="center">
                      滑鼠移上來修改評分
                    </Typography>
                  )}
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 刪除廁所 */}
            {isCreator && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom color="error">
                    管理廁所
                  </Typography>
                  <Button
                    variant="outlined"
                    color="error"
                    startIcon={<DeleteIcon />}
                    onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(true)}
                    fullWidth
                  >
                    刪除廁所
                  </Button>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 廁所資訊 */}
            <Card>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  廁所資訊
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立者：{restroom.creator?.username || '未知'}
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立時間：{new Date(restroom.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                </Typography>
                {restroom.distance && (
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    距離：{restroom.distance.toFixed(2)} km
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </Container>

      {/* 刪除確認對話框 */}
      <Dialog
        open={deleteDialogOpen}
        onClose={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
        aria-labelledby="delete-dialog-title"
        aria-describedby="delete-dialog-description"
      >
        <DialogTitle id="delete-dialog-title">
          確認刪除廁所
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogContentText id="delete-dialog-description">
            您確定要刪除「{restroom?.name}」這個廁所嗎？此操作無法復原，所有相關的評論和評分也會被刪除。

        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button 
            onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}

          >

          <Button 
            onClick={handleDeleteRestroom}
            color="error"
            variant="contained"
            disabled={deleting}
            startIcon={deleting ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <DeleteIcon />}
          >
            {deleting ? '刪除中...' : '確認刪除'}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RestroomDetailPage;

## ✅ 評分顯示功能已實現完成！

我已經成功實現了你要求的功能：如果用戶已經對廁所評過分，就顯示用戶的評分，只有滑鼠移上去時才允許修改評分。

### 🔧 實現的功能：

1. **狀態管理**：
   - `userRating`：儲存用戶的評分
   - `hasUserRated`：追蹤用戶是否已評分
   - `isHovering`：追蹤滑鼠是否懸停在評分區域

2. **智能評分顯示**：
   - **未評分時**：顯示「評分這個廁所」，允許用戶選擇評分
   - **已評分時**：顯示「我的評分」，顯示用戶的評分
   - **滑鼠懸停時**：允許修改評分，按鈕文字變為「更新評分」

3. **用戶體驗優化**：
   - 已評分時顯示提示文字：「滑鼠移上來修改評分」
   - 評分組件在已評分且未懸停時設為 `readOnly`
   - 按鈕文字動態變化：「提交評分」vs「更新評分」

### 🎯 功能特色：

- **直觀的視覺反饋**：清楚顯示用戶的評分狀態
- **無縫的修改體驗**：滑鼠懸停即可修改評分
- **智能的按鈕狀態**：根據評分狀態顯示不同的按鈕文字
- **數據持久化**：評分修改後會更新到後端並刷新頁面

現在用戶可以清楚地看到自己的評分，並且只有在需要修改時才需要滑鼠懸停來啟用編輯模式！

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

  value: number;
}

function TabPanel(props: TabPanelProps) {
  const { children, value, index, ...other } = props;
  return (
    <div
      role="tabpanel"
      hidden={value !== index}
      id={`friends-tabpanel-${index}`}
      aria-labelledby={`friends-tab-${index}`}
      {...other}
    >
      {value === index && <Box sx={{ p: 3 }}>{children}</Box>}
    </div>
  );
}

const FriendsPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { } = useAuth();

  const [activities, setActivities] = useState<Activity[]>([]);
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState<User[]>([]);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const [searchDialogOpen, setSearchDialogOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchFriendsData();
  }, []);

  const fetchFriendsData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      const [friendsRes, requestsRes, activitiesRes] = await Promise.all([
        friendAPI.getFriends(),
        friendAPI.getRequests(),
        friendAPI.getActivity(),
      ]);

      if (friendsRes.success) setFriends(friendsRes.data || []);
      if (requestsRes.success) setRequests(requestsRes.data || { incoming: [], outgoing: [] });
      if (activitiesRes.success) setActivities(activitiesRes.data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      setError('載入好友資料時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error fetching friends data:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSearchUsers = async () => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return;

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const response = await friendAPI.searchUsers(searchQuery);
      if (response.success) {
        setSearchResults(response.data || []);
        setSearchDialogOpen(true);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('搜尋用戶時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error searching users:', err);
    } finally {

  };

        setSearchDialogOpen(false);
        setSearchQuery('');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('發送好友請求時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error sending friend request:', err);
    }
  };

      const response = await friendAPI.acceptRequest(requestId);

        fetchFriendsData();
      }
    } catch (err) {

      console.error('Error accepting friend request:', err);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveFriend = async (friendId: number) => {
    try {
      const response = await friendAPI.removeFriend(friendId);
      if (response.success) {
        fetchFriendsData();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('移除好友時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error removing friend:', err);
    }
  };

  const handleTabChange = (_event: React.SyntheticEvent, newValue: number) => {
    setTabValue(newValue);
  };

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>

        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
