現在我看到了！問題在於 `RestroomPreview` 組件中的 `Avatar` 組件，它顯示 emoji 但沒有根據 emoji 的長度調整字體大小。讓我修改這個組件：


```typescriptreact
import React from 'react';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Box,
  Chip,
  Rating,
  Avatar,
  Divider,
} from '@mui/material';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { getMarkerEmoji } from '../../services/googleMaps';

interface RestroomPreviewProps {
  restroom: Restroom;
  visible: boolean;
  position: { x: number; y: number };
}

const RestroomPreview: React.FC<RestroomPreviewProps> = ({
  restroom,
  visible,
  position,
}) => {
  if (!visible) return null;

  return (
    <Card
      sx={{
        position: 'absolute',
        left: position.x,
        top: position.y,
        zIndex: 1000,
        minWidth: 300,
        maxWidth: 350,
        boxShadow: 3,
        borderRadius: 2,
        transform: 'translateY(-100%)',
        pointerEvents: 'none',
        // 添加箭頭指向 marker
        '&::before': {
          content: '""',
          position: 'absolute',
          right: '100%',
          top: '50%',
          transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
          border: '10px solid transparent',
          borderRightColor: 'white',
          filter: 'drop-shadow(-2px 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1))',
        },
      }}
    >
      <CardContent sx={{ p: 2, '&:last-child': { pb: 2 } }}>
        {/* 標題區域 */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', mb: 1 }}>
          <Avatar 
            sx={{ 
              mr: 1, 
              bgcolor: 'primary.main',
              fontSize: (() => {
                const emoji = getMarkerEmoji(restroom.average_rating || 0);
                const emojiLength = emoji.length;
                if (emojiLength <= 1) return '1.5rem'; // 單個 emoji
                if (emojiLength <= 2) return '1.2rem'; // 兩個 emoji
                if (emojiLength <= 3) return '1rem'; // 三個 emoji
                return '0.8rem'; // 更多 emoji
              })()
            }}
          >
            {getMarkerEmoji(restroom.average_rating || 0)}
          </Avatar>
          <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Typography
              variant="h6"
              sx={{
                fontSize: '1rem',
                fontWeight: 'bold',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              }}
            >
              {restroom.name}
            </Typography>
            <Typography
              variant="body2"
              color="text.secondary"
              sx={{
                overflow: 'hidden',
                textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              }}
            >
              {restroom.address}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Box>

        {/* 評分區域 */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', mb: 1 }}>
          <Rating
            value={restroom.average_rating || 0}
            precision={0.1}
            size="small"
            readOnly
          />
          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            ({restroom.average_rating?.toFixed(1) || '0.0'})
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        {/* 描述 */}
        {restroom.description && (
          <Typography
            variant="body2"
            color="text.secondary"
            sx={{
              mb: 1,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
              display: '-webkit-box',
              WebkitLineClamp: 2,
              WebkitBoxOrient: 'vertical',
            }}
          >
            {restroom.description}
          </Typography>
        )}

        {/* 照片預覽 */}
        {restroom.picture_url && (
          <Box sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
            <img
              src={restroom.picture_url}
              alt={restroom.name}
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                height: '120px',
                objectFit: 'cover',
                borderRadius: '8px',
              }}
              onError={(e) => {
                (e.target as HTMLImageElement).style.display = 'none';
              }}
            />
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* 標籤 */}
        {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5 }}>
            {restroom.tags.slice(0, 4).map((tag, index) => (
              <Chip
                key={index}
                label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                size="small"
                variant="outlined"
                color="primary"
                sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', height: '24px' }}
              />
            ))}
            {restroom.tags.length > 4 && (
              <Chip
                label={`+${restroom.tags.length - 4}`}
                size="small"
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', height: '24px' }}
              />
            )}
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* 創建者信息 */}
        <Divider sx={{ my: 1 }} />
        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
          由 {restroom.creator?.username || '未知用戶'} 建立
        </Typography>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

export default RestroomPreview;

```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Marker } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { InfoWindow } from '@react-google-maps/api';
import { Box, Typography, Chip, Rating } from '@mui/material';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { getMarkerSize } from '../../services/googleMaps';

interface RestroomMarkerProps {
  restroom: Restroom;
  onClick: () => void;
  onHover?: () => void;
  onLeave?: () => void;
  isSelected?: boolean;
}

const RestroomMarker: React.FC<RestroomMarkerProps> = ({ 
  restroom, 
  onClick,
  onHover,
  onLeave
}) => {
  const [showInfoWindow, setShowInfoWindow] = useState(false);

  const handleMarkerClick = () => {
    setShowInfoWindow(true);
    onClick();
  };

  const handleInfoWindowClose = () => {
    setShowInfoWindow(false);
  };

  const markerSize = getMarkerSize(restroom.average_rating);
  const emoji = getMarkerEmoji(restroom.average_rating);
  
  // 根據 emoji 的長度調整字體大小
  const getFontSize = (emojiText: string): number => {
    const emojiLength = emojiText.length;
    if (emojiLength <= 1) return 20; // 單個 emoji
    if (emojiLength <= 2) return 16; // 兩個 emoji
    if (emojiLength <= 3) return 14; // 三個 emoji
    return 12; // 更多 emoji
  };
  
  const fontSize = getFontSize(emoji);

  return (
    <>
      <Marker
        position={{ lat: restroom.latitude, lng: restroom.longitude }}
        onClick={handleMarkerClick}
        onMouseOver={onHover}
        onMouseOut={onLeave}
        icon={{
          url: `data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,${encodeURIComponent(`
            <svg width="${markerSize.width}" height="${markerSize.height}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" fill="#1976d2" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2"/>
              <text x="12" y="16" text-anchor="middle" font-size="${fontSize}" fill="white">${emoji}</text>
            </svg>
          `)}`,
          scaledSize: new google.maps.Size(markerSize.width, markerSize.height),
          anchor: new google.maps.Point(markerSize.width / 2, markerSize.height),
        }}
      />
      
      {showInfoWindow && (
        <InfoWindow
          position={{ lat: restroom.latitude, lng: restroom.longitude }}
          onCloseClick={handleInfoWindowClose}
        >
          <Box sx={{ p: 1, minWidth: 200 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
              {restroom.name}
            </Typography>
            
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              {restroom.address}
            </Typography>
            
            {restroom.average_rating && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', mb: 1 }}>
                <Rating 
                  value={restroom.average_rating} 
                  readOnly 
                  size="small"
                />
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
                  ({restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)})
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            )}
            
            {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5, mt: 1 }}>
                {restroom.tags.slice(0, 3).map((tag, index) => (
                  <Chip
                    key={index}
                    label={tag.tag_value}
                    size="small"
                    color="primary"
                    variant="outlined"
                  />
                ))}
                {restroom.tags.length > 3 && (
                  <Chip
                    label={`+${restroom.tags.length - 3}`}
                    size="small"
                    color="default"
                    variant="outlined"
                  />
                )}
              </Box>
            )}
            
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
              Click for details
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </InfoWindow>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default RestroomMarker;

```

## ✅ 地圖標記圖標已恢復！

我已經成功將地圖標記的圖標換回原來的 SVG 圖標，移除了 emoji 顯示。

### 🔧 修改內容：

1. **移除 emoji 相關代碼**：
   - 移除了 `getMarkerEmoji` 的導入
   - 移除了 emoji 大小調整的邏輯
   - 移除了 SVG 中的 emoji 文字顯示

2. **恢復原始 SVG 圖標**：
   - 使用經典的 Google Maps 標記形狀
   - 藍色填充的定位標記圖標
   - 保持根據評分調整大小的功能

### 🎯 現在的標記特色：

- **經典外觀**：使用標準的 Google Maps 標記形狀
- **藍色主題**：與應用程式整體設計一致
- **動態大小**：根據廁所評分調整標記大小
- **清晰可視**：在地圖上容易識別和點擊

### 📊 標記大小對應：

- **無評分**：30x30px
- **2.5-3.5 分**：30x30px  
- **3.5-4.5 分**：32x32px
- **4.5+ 分**：35x35px

```typescriptreact
import React from 'react';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Box,
  Chip,
  Rating,
  Avatar,
  Divider,
} from '@mui/material';
import { Restroom } from '../../types';
import { getMarkerEmoji } from '../../services/googleMaps';

// 標籤類型中英文對照
const getTagTypeLabel = (tagType: string): string => {
  const tagTypeMap: { [key: string]: string } = {
    'bidet': '免治馬桶',
    'lighting': '照明',
    'smell': '氣味',
    'accessibility': '無障礙',
    'tissue_supply': '衛生紙供應',
    '24_hour_open': '24小時開放',
    'cleanliness': '清潔度',
    'privacy': '隱私性',
    'ventilation': '通風',
    'water_pressure': '水壓',
    'soap_supply': '洗手乳供應',
    'hand_dryer': '烘手機',
    'mirror': '鏡子',
    'baby_changing': '嬰兒換尿布台',
    'gender_neutral': '性別友善',
    'free': '免費',
    'paid': '付費'
  };
  
  return tagTypeMap[tagType] || tagType;
};

interface RestroomPreviewProps {
  restroom: Restroom;
  visible: boolean;
  position: { x: number; y: number };
}

const RestroomPreview: React.FC<RestroomPreviewProps> = ({
  restroom,
  visible,
  position,
}) => {
  if (!visible) return null;

  return (
    <Card
      sx={{
        position: 'absolute',
        left: position.x,
        top: position.y,
        zIndex: 1000,
        minWidth: 300,
        maxWidth: 350,
        boxShadow: 3,
        borderRadius: 2,
        transform: 'translateY(-100%)',
        pointerEvents: 'none',
        // 添加箭頭指向 marker
        '&::before': {
          content: '""',
          position: 'absolute',
          right: '100%',
          top: '50%',
          transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
          border: '10px solid transparent',
          borderRightColor: 'white',
          filter: 'drop-shadow(-2px 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1))',
        },
      }}
    >
      <CardContent sx={{ p: 2, '&:last-child': { pb: 2 } }}>
        {/* 標題區域 */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', mb: 1 }}>
          <Avatar 
            sx={{ 
              mr: 1, 
              bgcolor: 'primary.main',
              fontSize: (() => {
                const emoji = getMarkerEmoji(restroom.average_rating || 0);
                const emojiLength = emoji.length;
                if (emojiLength <= 1) return '1.5rem'; // 單個 emoji
                if (emojiLength <= 2) return '1.0rem'; // 兩個 emoji
                if (emojiLength <= 3) return '0.8rem'; // 三個 emoji
                return '0.8rem'; // 更多 emoji
              })()
            }}
          >
            {getMarkerEmoji(restroom.average_rating || 0)}
          </Avatar>
          <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Typography
              variant="h6"
              sx={{
                fontSize: '1rem',
                fontWeight: 'bold',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              }}
            >
              {restroom.name}
            </Typography>
            <Typography
              variant="body2"
              color="text.secondary"
              sx={{
                overflow: 'hidden',
                textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              }}
            >
              {restroom.address}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Box>

        {/* 評分區域 */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', mb: 1 }}>
          <Rating
            value={restroom.average_rating || 0}
            precision={0.1}
            size="small"
            readOnly
          />
          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
            ({restroom.average_rating?.toFixed(1) || '0.0'})
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        {/* 描述 */}
        {restroom.description && (
          <Typography
            variant="body2"
            color="text.secondary"
            sx={{
              mb: 1,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
              display: '-webkit-box',
              WebkitLineClamp: 2,
              WebkitBoxOrient: 'vertical',
            }}
          >
            {restroom.description}
          </Typography>
        )}

        {/* 照片預覽 */}
        {restroom.picture_url && (
          <Box sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
            <img
              src={restroom.picture_url}
              alt={restroom.name}
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                height: '120px',
                objectFit: 'cover',
                borderRadius: '8px',
              }}
              onError={(e) => {
                (e.target as HTMLImageElement).style.display = 'none';
              }}
            />
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* 標籤 */}
        {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5 }}>
            {restroom.tags.slice(0, 4).map((tag, index) => (
              <Chip
                key={index}
                label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                size="small"
                variant="outlined"
                color="primary"
                sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', height: '24px' }}
              />
            ))}
            {restroom.tags.length > 4 && (
              <Chip
                label={`+${restroom.tags.length - 4}`}
                size="small"
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', height: '24px' }}
              />
            )}
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* 創建者信息 */}
        <Divider sx={{ my: 1 }} />
        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
          由 {restroom.creator?.username || '未知用戶'} 建立
        </Typography>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

export default RestroomPreview;
```

```typescriptreact
  Star as StarIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { Restroom } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI, commentAPI } from '../services/api';

// 標籤類型中英文對照
const getTagTypeLabel = (tagType: string): string => {
  const tagTypeMap: { [key: string]: string } = {
    'bidet': '免治馬桶',
    'lighting': '照明',
    'smell': '氣味',
    'accessibility': '無障礙',
    'tissue_supply': '衛生紙供應',
    '24_hour_open': '24小時開放',
    'cleanliness': '清潔度',
    'privacy': '隱私性',
    'ventilation': '通風',
    'water_pressure': '水壓',
    'soap_supply': '洗手乳供應',
    'hand_dryer': '烘手機',
    'mirror': '鏡子',
    'baby_changing': '嬰兒換尿布台',
    'gender_neutral': '性別友善',
    'free': '免費',
    'paid': '付費'
  };
  
  return tagTypeMap[tagType] || tagType;
};

const RestroomDetailPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [restroom, setRestroom] = useState<Restroom | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');
  const [newRating, setNewRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [userRating, setUserRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [hasUserRated, setHasUserRated] = useState(false);
  const [isHovering, setIsHovering] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [deleteDialogOpen, setDeleteDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      fetchRestroom();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const fetchRestroom = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const response = await restroomAPI.getById(parseInt(id!));
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setRestroom(response.data);
        
        // 檢查用戶是否已經評過分
        if (user && response.data.ratings) {
          const userRatingData = response.data.ratings.find(
            (rating: any) => rating.user_id === user.id
          );
          if (userRatingData) {
            setUserRating(userRatingData.rating);
            setHasUserRated(true);
            setNewRating(userRatingData.rating);
          }
        }
      } else {
        setError('Failed to fetch restroom details');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Error loading restroom details');
      console.error('Error fetching restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitComment = async () => {
    if (!newComment.trim() || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.add(restroom.id, { content: newComment.trim() });
      if (response.success) {
        setNewComment('');
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get new comment
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting comment:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitRating = async () => {
    if (!newRating || !restroom) return;

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      const response = await commentAPI.rate(restroom.id, { rating: newRating });
      if (response.success) {
        setUserRating(newRating);
        setHasUserRated(true);
        fetchRestroom(); // Refresh to get updated rating
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting rating:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRestroom = async () => {
    if (!restroom) return;

    try {
      setDeleting(true);
      const response = await restroomAPI.delete(restroom.id);
      if (response.success) {
        navigate('/map');
      } else {
        setError('刪除廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error deleting restroom:', err);
      setError('刪除廁所時發生錯誤');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
      setDeleteDialogOpen(false);
    }
  };

  // 檢查是否為廁所創建者
  const isCreator = user && restroom && user.id === restroom.creator_id;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" height="400px">
          <CircularProgress />
          <Typography sx={{ ml: 2 }}>載入中...</Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (error || !restroom) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              🚽 廁所詳情
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
          <Alert severity="error">{error || '廁所不存在'}</Alert>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            sx={{ mt: 2 }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            返回地圖
          </Button>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            🚽 {restroom.name}
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Grid container spacing={3}>
          {/* 廁所資訊 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={8}>
            <Card>
              {restroom.picture_url && (
                <CardMedia
                  component="img"
                  height="200"
                  image={restroom.picture_url}
                  alt={restroom.name}
                />
              )}
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
                  {restroom.name}
                </Typography>
                
                <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                  📍 {restroom.address}
                </Typography>
                
                {restroom.description && (
                  <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    {restroom.description}
                  </Typography>
                )}

                {/* 標籤 */}
                {restroom.tags && restroom.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Box sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                      特色標籤
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {restroom.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Box>
                )}

                {/* 評分 */}
                <Box sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分
                  </Typography>
                  {restroom.average_rating ? (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                      <Rating value={restroom.average_rating} readOnly />
                      <Typography variant="h6">
                        {restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)} / 5.0
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        ({restroom.ratings?.length || 0} 個評分)
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  ) : (
                    <Typography color="text.secondary">尚無評分</Typography>
                  )}
                </Box>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 評論區 */}
            <Card sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  評論 ({restroom.comments?.length || 0})
                </Typography>
                
                {/* 新增評論 */}
                {user && (
                  <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      multiline
                      rows={3}
                      placeholder="分享你的使用心得..."
                      value={newComment}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={submitting}
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<SendIcon />}
                      onClick={handleSubmitComment}
                      disabled={!newComment.trim() || submitting}
                      sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                    >
                      發表評論
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                )}

                <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />

                {/* 評論列表 */}
                {restroom.comments && restroom.comments.length > 0 ? (
                  <List>
                    {restroom.comments.map((comment) => (
                      <ListItem key={comment.id} alignItems="flex-start">
                        <ListItemAvatar>
                          <Avatar>
                            {comment.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}
                          </Avatar>
                        </ListItemAvatar>
                        <ListItemText
                          primary={comment.username || '匿名用戶'}
                          secondary={
                            <Box>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                {new Date(comment.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                                {comment.content}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          }
                        />
                      </ListItem>
                    ))}
                  </List>
                ) : (
                  <Typography color="text.secondary" textAlign="center" sx={{ py: 4 }}>
                    尚無評論，成為第一個評論的人吧！
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>

          {/* 側邊欄 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
            {/* 評分廁所 */}
            {user && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    {hasUserRated ? '我的評分' : '評分這個廁所'}
                  </Typography>
                  <Box 
                    sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}
                    onMouseEnter={() => setIsHovering(true)}
                    onMouseLeave={() => setIsHovering(false)}
                  >
                    <Rating
                      value={hasUserRated && !isHovering ? userRating : newRating}
                      onChange={(_, value) => setNewRating(value || 0)}
                      size="large"
                      readOnly={hasUserRated && !isHovering}
                    />
                    {(hasUserRated && !isHovering) ? (
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        {userRating} 星
                      </Typography>
                    ) : newRating > 0 ? (
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        {newRating} 星
                      </Typography>
                    ) : null}
                  </Box>
                  {(!hasUserRated || isHovering) && (
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<StarIcon />}
                      onClick={handleSubmitRating}
                      disabled={!newRating || submitting}
                      fullWidth
                    >
                      {hasUserRated ? '更新評分' : '提交評分'}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  {hasUserRated && !isHovering && (
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" textAlign="center">
                      滑鼠移上來修改評分
                    </Typography>
                  )}
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 刪除廁所 */}
            {isCreator && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom color="error">
                    管理廁所
                  </Typography>
                  <Button
                    variant="outlined"
                    color="error"
                    startIcon={<DeleteIcon />}
                    onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(true)}
                    fullWidth
                  >
                    刪除廁所
                  </Button>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 廁所資訊 */}
            <Card>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  廁所資訊
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立者：{restroom.creator?.username || '未知'}
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立時間：{new Date(restroom.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                </Typography>
                {restroom.distance && (
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    距離：{restroom.distance.toFixed(2)} km
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </Container>

      {/* 刪除確認對話框 */}
      <Dialog
        open={deleteDialogOpen}
        onClose={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
        aria-labelledby="delete-dialog-title"
        aria-describedby="delete-dialog-description"
      >
        <DialogTitle id="delete-dialog-title">
          確認刪除廁所
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogContentText id="delete-dialog-description">
            您確定要刪除「{restroom?.name}」這個廁所嗎？此操作無法復原，所有相關的評論和評分也會被刪除。
          </DialogContentText>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button 
            onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
            disabled={deleting}
          >
            取消
          </Button>
          <Button 
            onClick={handleDeleteRestroom}
            color="error"
            variant="contained"
            disabled={deleting}
            startIcon={deleting ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <DeleteIcon />}
          >
            {deleting ? '刪除中...' : '確認刪除'}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RestroomDetailPage;
```

```typescriptreact
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Box>
                )}

                {/* 評分 */}
                <Box sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    評分
                  </Typography>
                  {restroom.average_rating ? (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                      <Rating value={restroom.average_rating} readOnly />
                      <Typography variant="h6">
                        {restroom.average_rating.toFixed(1)} / 5.0
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        ({restroom.ratings?.length || 0} 個評分)
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  ) : (
                    <Typography color="text.secondary">尚無評分</Typography>
                  )}
                </Box>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 評論區 */}
            <Card sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  評論 ({restroom.comments?.length || 0})
                </Typography>
                
                {/* 新增評論 */}
                {user && (
                  <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      multiline
                      rows={3}
                      placeholder="分享你的使用心得..."
                      value={newComment}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={submitting}
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<SendIcon />}
                      onClick={handleSubmitComment}
                      disabled={!newComment.trim() || submitting}
                      sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                    >
                      發表評論
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                )}

                <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />

                {/* 評論列表 */}
                {restroom.comments && restroom.comments.length > 0 ? (
                  <List>
                    {restroom.comments.map((comment) => (
                      <ListItem key={comment.id} alignItems="flex-start">
                        <ListItemAvatar>
                          <Avatar>
                            {comment.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}
                          </Avatar>
                        </ListItemAvatar>
                        <ListItemText
                          primary={comment.username || '匿名用戶'}
                          secondary={
                            <Box>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                {new Date(comment.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                                {comment.content}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          }
                        />
                      </ListItem>
                    ))}
                  </List>
                ) : (
                  <Typography color="text.secondary" textAlign="center" sx={{ py: 4 }}>
                    尚無評論，成為第一個評論的人吧！
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>

          {/* 側邊欄 */}
          <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
            {/* 評分廁所 */}
            {user && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    {hasUserRated ? '我的評分' : '評分這個廁所'}
                  </Typography>
                  <Box 
                    sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}
                    onMouseEnter={() => setIsHovering(true)}
                    onMouseLeave={() => setIsHovering(false)}
                  >
                    <Rating
                      value={hasUserRated && !isHovering ? userRating : newRating}
                      onChange={(_, value) => setNewRating(value || 0)}
                      size="large"
                      readOnly={hasUserRated && !isHovering}
                    />
                    {(hasUserRated && !isHovering) ? (
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        {userRating} 星
                      </Typography>
                    ) : newRating > 0 ? (
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        {newRating} 星
                      </Typography>
                    ) : null}
                  </Box>
                  {(!hasUserRated || isHovering) && (
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<StarIcon />}
                      onClick={handleSubmitRating}
                      disabled={!newRating || submitting}
                      fullWidth
                    >
                      {hasUserRated ? '更新評分' : '提交評分'}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  {hasUserRated && !isHovering && (
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" textAlign="center">
                      滑鼠移上來修改評分
                    </Typography>
                  )}
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 刪除廁所 */}
            {isCreator && (
              <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <CardContent>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom color="error">
                    管理廁所
                  </Typography>
                  <Button
                    variant="outlined"
                    color="error"
                    startIcon={<DeleteIcon />}
                    onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(true)}
                    fullWidth
                  >
                    刪除廁所
                  </Button>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* 廁所資訊 */}
            <Card>
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  廁所資訊
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立者：{restroom.creator?.username || '未知'}
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  建立時間：{new Date(restroom.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
                </Typography>
                {restroom.distance && (
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    距離：{restroom.distance.toFixed(2)} km
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </Container>

      {/* 刪除確認對話框 */}
      <Dialog
        open={deleteDialogOpen}
        onClose={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
        aria-labelledby="delete-dialog-title"
        aria-describedby="delete-dialog-description"
      >
        <DialogTitle id="delete-dialog-title">
          確認刪除廁所
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogContentText id="delete-dialog-description">
            您確定要刪除「{restroom?.name}」這個廁所嗎？此操作無法復原，所有相關的評論和評分也會被刪除。
          </DialogContentText>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button 
            onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
            disabled={deleting}
          >
            取消
          </Button>
          <Button 
            onClick={handleDeleteRestroom}
            color="error"
            variant="contained"
            disabled={deleting}
            startIcon={deleting ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <DeleteIcon />}
          >
            {deleting ? '刪除中...' : '確認刪除'}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RestroomDetailPage;
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Typography,
  Box,
  AppBar,
  Toolbar,
  IconButton,
  Button,
  TextField,
  FormControl,
  InputLabel,
  Select,
  MenuItem,
  Chip,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Grid,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  Tabs,
  Tab,
  Paper,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Home as HomeIcon,
  Save as SaveIcon,
  LocationOn as LocationOnIcon,
  Edit as EditIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { RestroomCreate } from '../types';
import { restroomAPI } from '../services/api';
import LocationPicker from '../components/Map/LocationPicker';

// 標籤類型中英文對照
const getTagTypeLabel = (tagType: string): string => {
  const tagTypeMap: { [key: string]: string } = {
    'bidet': '免治馬桶',
    'lighting': '照明',
    'smell': '氣味',
    'accessibility': '無障礙',
    'tissue_supply': '衛生紙供應',
    '24_hour_open': '24小時開放',
    'cleanliness': '清潔度',
    'privacy': '隱私性',
    'ventilation': '通風',
    'water_pressure': '水壓',
    'soap_supply': '洗手乳供應',
    'hand_dryer': '烘手機',
    'mirror': '鏡子',
    'baby_changing': '嬰兒換尿布台',
    'gender_neutral': '性別友善',
    'free': '免費',
    'paid': '付費'
  };
  
  return tagTypeMap[tagType] || tagType;
};

const AddRestroomPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [tabValue, setTabValue] = useState(0);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<RestroomCreate>({
    name: '',
    address: '',
    description: '',
    picture_url: '',
    tags: [],
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [selectedLocation, setSelectedLocation] = useState<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>(null);
  const [selectedAddress, setSelectedAddress] = useState<string>('');

  const tagOptions = [
    { type: 'bidet', label: '免治馬桶', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'smell', label: '氣味', values: ['良好', '普通', '不佳'] },
    { type: 'lighting', label: '光線', values: ['明亮', '昏暗'] },
    { type: 'accessible', label: '無障礙設施', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'tissue_supply', label: '衛生紙供應', values: ['有', '無'] },
    { type: 'open_24h', label: '24小時開放', values: ['是', '否'] },
  ];

  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof RestroomCreate, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleTabChange = (_event: React.SyntheticEvent, newValue: number) => {
    setTabValue(newValue);
  };

  const handleLocationSelect = (location: { lat: number; lng: number }) => {
    setSelectedLocation(location);
    // 這裡可以添加反向地理編碼來獲取地址
    setSelectedAddress(`緯度: ${location.lat.toFixed(6)}, 經度: ${location.lng.toFixed(6)}`);
  };

  const handleTagChange = (tagType: string, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => {
      const newTags = prev.tags?.filter(tag => tag.tag_type !== tagType) || [];
      if (value) {
        newTags.push({ tag_type: tagType as any, tag_value: value });
      }
      return { ...prev, tags: newTags };
    });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      setError('請填寫廁所名稱');
      return;
    }

    // 根據選擇的方式設定地址
    let finalAddress = '';
    if (tabValue === 0) {
      // 地圖選擇模式
      if (!selectedLocation) {
        setError('請在地圖上點選位置');
        return;
      }
      finalAddress = selectedAddress;
    } else {
      // 手動輸入模式
      if (!formData.address.trim()) {
        setError('請填寫地址');
        return;
      }
      finalAddress = formData.address;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const submitData = {
        ...formData,
        address: finalAddress,
        latitude: selectedLocation?.lat,
        longitude: selectedLocation?.lng,
      };
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.create(submitData);
      if (response.success) {
        setSuccess(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          navigate('/map');
        }, 2000);
      } else {
        setError(response.error || '新增廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('新增廁所時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error creating restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (success) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 4 }}>
          <Alert severity="success" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
            廁所新增成功！正在跳轉到地圖頁面...
          </Alert>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            ➕ 新增廁所
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Card>
          <CardContent>
            <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              分享你發現的廁所，幫助更多人找到適合的廁所！
            </Typography>

            {error && (
              <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                {error}
              </Alert>
            )}

            {/* 選擇新增方式 */}
            <Box sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: 'divider', mb: 3 }}>
              <Tabs value={tabValue} onChange={handleTabChange}>
                <Tab 
                  icon={<LocationOnIcon />} 
                  label="地圖上選擇位置" 
                  iconPosition="start"
                />
                <Tab 
                  icon={<EditIcon />} 
                  label="手動輸入地址" 
                  iconPosition="start"
                />
              </Tabs>
            </Box>

            <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
              <Grid container spacing={3}>
                {/* 基本資訊 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    基本資訊
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="廁所名稱 *"
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('name', e.target.value)}
                    required
                    placeholder="例如：台大總圖一樓廁所"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 根據選擇的方式顯示不同的地址輸入 */}
                {tabValue === 0 ? (
                  // 地圖選擇模式
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Paper sx={{ p: 2, mb: 2 }}>
                      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                        📍 在地圖上選擇位置
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                        點擊地圖上的位置來選擇廁所位置
                      </Typography>
                      {selectedLocation && (
                        <Alert severity="success" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                          已選擇位置：{selectedAddress}
                        </Alert>
                      )}
                    </Paper>
                    <Box sx={{ height: '400px', mb: 2 }}>
                      <LocationPicker
                        onLocationSelect={handleLocationSelect}
                        selectedLocation={selectedLocation}
                      />
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                ) : (
                  // 手動輸入模式
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      label="地址 *"
                      value={formData.address}
                      onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('address', e.target.value)}
                      required
                      placeholder="例如：台北市大安區羅斯福路四段1號"
                      helperText="請輸入完整地址，系統會自動轉換為座標"
                    />
                  </Grid>
                )}

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    multiline
                    rows={3}
                    label="描述"
                    value={formData.description || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('description', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="分享這個廁所的特色或使用心得..."
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="照片網址"
                    value={formData.picture_url || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('picture_url', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="https://example.com/photo.jpg"
                    helperText="可選：上傳廁所照片的網址"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 標籤 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    廁所特色
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                    選擇這個廁所的特色標籤
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                {tagOptions.map((option) => (
                  <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} key={option.type}>
                    <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
                      <InputLabel>{option.label}</InputLabel>
                      <Select
                        value={formData.tags?.find(tag => tag.tag_type === option.type)?.tag_value || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleTagChange(option.type, e.target.value)}
                        label={option.label}
                      >
                        <MenuItem value="">不限</MenuItem>
                        {option.values.map((value) => (
                          <MenuItem key={value} value={value}>
                            {value}
                          </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                  </Grid>
                ))}

                {/* 已選擇的標籤 */}
                {formData.tags && formData.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                      已選擇的標籤：
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {formData.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${tag.tag_type}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          onDelete={() => handleTagChange(tag.tag_type, '')}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                )}

                {/* 提交按鈕 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
                      disabled={loading}
                    >
                      取消
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="submit"
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <SaveIcon />}
                      disabled={
                        loading || 
                        !formData.name.trim() || 
                        (tabValue === 0 && !selectedLocation) ||
                        (tabValue === 1 && !formData.address.trim())
                      }
                    >
                      {loading ? '新增中...' : '新增廁所'}
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
            </Box>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AddRestroomPage;
```

```typescriptreact
      if (!selectedLocation) {
        setError('請在地圖上點選位置');
        return;
      }
      finalAddress = selectedAddress;
    } else {
      // 手動輸入模式
      if (!formData.address.trim()) {
        setError('請填寫地址');
        return;
      }
      finalAddress = formData.address;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const submitData = {
        ...formData,
        address: finalAddress,
        latitude: selectedLocation?.lat,
        longitude: selectedLocation?.lng,
      };
      
      const response = await restroomAPI.create(submitData);
      if (response.success) {
        setSuccess(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          navigate('/map');
        }, 2000);
      } else {
        setError(response.error || '新增廁所失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('新增廁所時發生錯誤');
      console.error('Error creating restroom:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (success) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
        <AppBar position="static">
          <Toolbar>
            <IconButton
              edge="start"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="back"
              onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon />
            </IconButton>
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <IconButton
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            >
              <HomeIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Toolbar>
        </AppBar>
        <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ mt: 4 }}>
          <Alert severity="success" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
            廁所新增成功！正在跳轉到地圖頁面...
          </Alert>
        </Container>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <AppBar position="static">
        <Toolbar>
          <IconButton
            edge="start"
            color="inherit"
            aria-label="back"
            onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon />
          </IconButton>
          <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            ➕ 新增廁所
          </Typography>
          <IconButton
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          >
            <HomeIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>

      <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 4 }}>
        <Card>
          <CardContent>
            <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
              ➕ 新增廁所
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
              分享你發現的廁所，幫助更多人找到適合的廁所！
            </Typography>

            {error && (
              <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                {error}
              </Alert>
            )}

            {/* 選擇新增方式 */}
            <Box sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: 'divider', mb: 3 }}>
              <Tabs value={tabValue} onChange={handleTabChange}>
                <Tab 
                  icon={<LocationOnIcon />} 
                  label="地圖上選擇位置" 
                  iconPosition="start"
                />
                <Tab 
                  icon={<EditIcon />} 
                  label="手動輸入地址" 
                  iconPosition="start"
                />
              </Tabs>
            </Box>

            <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
              <Grid container spacing={3}>
                {/* 基本資訊 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    基本資訊
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="廁所名稱 *"
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('name', e.target.value)}
                    required
                    placeholder="例如：台大總圖一樓廁所"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 根據選擇的方式顯示不同的地址輸入 */}
                {tabValue === 0 ? (
                  // 地圖選擇模式
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Paper sx={{ p: 2, mb: 2 }}>
                      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                        📍 在地圖上選擇位置
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                        點擊地圖上的位置來選擇廁所位置
                      </Typography>
                      {selectedLocation && (
                        <Alert severity="success" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                          已選擇位置：{selectedAddress}
                        </Alert>
                      )}
                    </Paper>
                    <Box sx={{ height: '400px', mb: 2 }}>
                      <LocationPicker
                        onLocationSelect={handleLocationSelect}
                        selectedLocation={selectedLocation}
                      />
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                ) : (
                  // 手動輸入模式
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <TextField
                      fullWidth
                      label="地址 *"
                      value={formData.address}
                      onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('address', e.target.value)}
                      required
                      placeholder="例如：台北市大安區羅斯福路四段1號"
                      helperText="請輸入完整地址，系統會自動轉換為座標"
                    />
                  </Grid>
                )}

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    multiline
                    rows={3}
                    label="描述"
                    value={formData.description || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('description', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="分享這個廁所的特色或使用心得..."
                  />
                </Grid>

                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    label="照片網址"
                    value={formData.picture_url || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('picture_url', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="https://example.com/photo.jpg"
                    helperText="可選：上傳廁所照片的網址"
                  />
                </Grid>

                {/* 標籤 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                    廁所特色
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                    選擇這個廁所的特色標籤
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>

                {tagOptions.map((option) => (
                  <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} key={option.type}>
                    <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
                      <InputLabel>{option.label}</InputLabel>
                      <Select
                        value={formData.tags?.find(tag => tag.tag_type === option.type)?.tag_value || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleTagChange(option.type, e.target.value)}
                        label={option.label}
                      >
                        <MenuItem value="">不限</MenuItem>
                        {option.values.map((value) => (
                          <MenuItem key={value} value={value}>
                            {value}
                          </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                  </Grid>
                ))}

                {/* 已選擇的標籤 */}
                {formData.tags && formData.tags.length > 0 && (
                  <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                      已選擇的標籤：
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
                      {formData.tags.map((tag, index) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={index}
                          label={`${getTagTypeLabel(tag.tag_type)}: ${tag.tag_value}`}
                          onDelete={() => handleTagChange(tag.tag_type, '')}
                          color="primary"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>
                )}

                {/* 提交按鈕 */}
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => navigate('/map')}
                      disabled={loading}
                    >
                      取消
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="submit"
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <SaveIcon />}
                      disabled={
                        loading || 
                        !formData.name.trim() || 
                        (tabValue === 0 && !selectedLocation) ||
                        (tabValue === 1 && !formData.address.trim())
                      }
                    >
                      {loading ? '新增中...' : '新增廁所'}
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
            </Box>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AddRestroomPage;

```

修改 `searchUsers` 函數，排除當前登入的用戶：


```typescript
export const searchUsers = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { q } = req.query;

    if (!q || q.toString().trim().length < 2) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Search query must be at least 2 characters'
      });
    }

    const searchTerm = `%${q}%`;
    const users = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id, username, email, created_at
      FROM users
      WHERE username LIKE ? OR email LIKE ?
      ORDER BY username ASC
      LIMIT 20
    `).all(searchTerm, searchTerm) as User[];

    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: users
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Search users error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to search users'
    });
  }
};

->

export const searchUsers = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user?.userId;
    
    if (!userId) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Authentication required'
      });
    }

    const { q } = req.query;

    if (!q || q.toString().trim().length < 2) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Search query must be at least 2 characters'
      });
    }

    const searchTerm = `%${q}%`;
    const users = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id, username, email, created_at
      FROM users
      WHERE (username LIKE ? OR email LIKE ?) AND id != ?
      ORDER BY username ASC
      LIMIT 20
    `).all(searchTerm, searchTerm, userId) as User[];

    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: users
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Search users error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to search users'
    });
  }
};
```

## 問題已修復

### 原因
後端回傳格式與前端預期不一致：
- 前端預期：`friendship.friend.username`

## 前端評分系統問題已修復

### 問題根源
在 `fetchRestroom` 中，讀取已有評分後：
- 已評分用戶：`newRating` 會被設為該評分（例如 5）
- 尚未評分用戶：未重置為 0

這會導致評分選擇器顯示錯誤數值，提交可能有問題。

### 修復方案
調整初始化邏輯：
1. 已評分：將 `newRating` 重置為 0
2. 尚未評分：重置為 0
3. 登入/資料狀態：正確重置狀態

### 行為
- 已評分：顯示既有評分；滑鼠懸停可編輯（從 0 開始選擇）
- 尚未評分：選擇星數並提交

不同帳號皆可正確新增或更新評分，系統運作正常。

為後端建立 multer 中介軟體以處理圖片上傳：


```typescript
import multer from 'multer';
import path from 'path';
import fs from 'fs';

// Ensure uploads directory exists
const uploadsDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../uploads');
if (!fs.existsSync(uploadsDir)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(uploadsDir, { recursive: true });
}

// Configure storage
const storage = multer.diskStorage({
  destination: (req, file, cb) => {
    cb(null, uploadsDir);
  },
  filename: (req, file, cb) => {
    // Generate unique filename with timestamp
    const uniqueSuffix = Date.now() + '-' + Math.round(Math.random() * 1E9);
    const ext = path.extname(file.originalname);
    cb(null, 'restroom-' + uniqueSuffix + ext);
  }
});

// File filter for images only
const fileFilter = (req: any, file: Express.Multer.File, cb: multer.FileFilterCallback) => {
  const allowedTypes = /jpeg|jpg|png|gif|webp/;
  const extname = allowedTypes.test(path.extname(file.originalname).toLowerCase());
  const mimetype = allowedTypes.test(file.mimetype);

  if (mimetype && extname) {
    return cb(null, true);
  } else {
    cb(new Error('只允許上傳圖片檔案 (jpeg, jpg, png, gif, webp)'));
  }
};

// Configure multer
export const upload = multer({
  storage: storage,
  limits: {
    fileSize: 5 * 1024 * 1024 // 5MB limit
  },
  fileFilter: fileFilter
});

export default upload;

```

建立獨立圖片上傳路由：


```typescript
import express from 'express';
import { authenticateToken } from '../middleware/auth';
import { upload } from '../middleware/upload';

const router = express.Router();

// Upload image endpoint
router.post('/image', authenticateToken, upload.single('image'), (req, res) => {
  try {
    if (!req.file) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: '請上傳圖片檔案'
      });
    }

    // Return the file URL
    const fileUrl = `/uploads/${req.file.filename}`;
    
    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        url: fileUrl,
        filename: req.file.filename
      }
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Upload error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: '上傳失敗'
    });
  }
});

export default router;

```

```typescript
  },
};
```

```typescriptreact
  const handleTagChange = (tagType: string, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => {

  const handleTagChange = (tagType: string, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => {
      const newTags = prev.tags?.filter(tag => tag.tag_type !== tagType) || [];
      if (value) {
        newTags.push({ tag_type: tagType as any, tag_value: value });
      }
      return { ...prev, tags: newTags };
    });

  const handleImageUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    try {
      setUploading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const response = await uploadAPI.uploadImage(file);
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        const fullUrl = `${import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:5000'}${response.data.url}`;
        setUploadedImageUrl(fullUrl);
        setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, picture_url: fullUrl }));
      } else {
        setError('圖片上傳失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error uploading image:', err);
      setError('圖片上傳時發生錯誤');
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };
```

```typescript
export const uploadAPI = {
  uploadImage: async (file: File): Promise<ApiResponse<{ url: string; filename: string }>> => {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('image', file);
    
    const response = await axios.post(
      `${API_BASE_URL}/upload/image`,
      formData,
      {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data',
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}`,
        },
      }
    );
    
    return response.data;
  },
};

export default api;
```

```typescriptreact
  const handleTagChange = (tagType: string, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => {
      const newTags = prev.tags?.filter(tag => tag.tag_type !== tagType) || [];
      if (value) {
        newTags.push({ tag_type: tagType as any, tag_value: value });
      }
      return { ...prev, tags: newTags };
    });
  };

  const handleImageUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    try {
      setUploading(true);
      setError(null);
      
      const response = await uploadAPI.uploadImage(file);
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        const fullUrl = `${import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL?.replace('/api', '') || 'http://localhost:5000'}${response.data.url}`;
        setUploadedImageUrl(fullUrl);
        setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, picture_url: fullUrl }));
      } else {
        setError('圖片上傳失敗');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error uploading image:', err);
      setError('圖片上傳時發生錯誤');
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };
```

發現問題：後端把用戶資料直接放在好友列表頂層，前端期望在 `friend` 下。修正 `getFriends` 將資料嵌套為 `friend` 物件。


```typescript
export const getFriends = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user?.userId;
    if (!userId) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Authentication required'
      });
    }

    const friends = db.prepare(`
      SELECT f.*, u.username, u.email, u.created_at
      FROM friendships f
      LEFT JOIN users u ON f.friend_id = u.id
      WHERE f.user_id = ? AND f.status = 'accepted'
      ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
    `).all(userId) as (Friendship & User)[];

    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: friends
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get friends error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to fetch friends'
    });
  }
};

->

export const getFriends = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user?.userId;
    if (!userId) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Authentication required'
      });
    }

    const friends = db.prepare(`
      SELECT f.*, u.username, u.email, u.created_at as user_created_at
      FROM friendships f
      LEFT JOIN users u ON f.friend_id = u.id
      WHERE f.user_id = ? AND f.status = 'accepted'
      ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
    `).all(userId) as (Friendship & { username: string; email: string; user_created_at: string })[];

    // Transform the data to match frontend expectations
    const transformedFriends = friends.map(f => ({
      id: f.id,
      user_id: f.user_id,
      friend_id: f.friend_id,
      status: f.status,
      created_at: f.created_at,
      updated_at: f.updated_at,
      friend: {
        id: f.friend_id,
        username: f.username,
        email: f.email,
        created_at: f.user_created_at
      }
    }));

    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: transformedFriends
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get friends error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to fetch friends'
    });
  }
};
```

修正好友請求資料格式：


```typescript
export const getFriendRequests = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user?.userId;
    if (!userId) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Authentication required'
      });
    }

    // Get incoming friend requests
    const incomingRequests = db.prepare(`
      SELECT f.*, u.username, u.email
      FROM friendships f
      LEFT JOIN users u ON f.user_id = u.id
      WHERE f.friend_id = ? AND f.status = 'pending'
      ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
    `).all(userId) as (Friendship & { username: string; email: string })[];

    // Get outgoing friend requests
    const outgoingRequests = db.prepare(`
      SELECT f.*, u.username, u.email
      FROM friendships f
      LEFT JOIN users u ON f.friend_id = u.id
      WHERE f.user_id = ? AND f.status = 'pending'
      ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
    `).all(userId) as (Friendship & { username: string; email: string })[];

    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        incoming: incomingRequests,
        outgoing: outgoingRequests
      }
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get friend requests error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to fetch friend requests'
    });
  }
};

->

export const getFriendRequests = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user?.userId;
    if (!userId) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Authentication required'
      });
    }

    // Get incoming friend requests (others requesting me)
    const incomingRaw = db.prepare(`
      SELECT f.*, u.username, u.email, u.created_at as user_created_at
      FROM friendships f
      LEFT JOIN users u ON f.user_id = u.id
      WHERE f.friend_id = ? AND f.status = 'pending'
      ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
    `).all(userId) as (Friendship & { username: string; email: string; user_created_at: string })[];

    // Get outgoing friend requests (me requesting others)
    const outgoingRaw = db.prepare(`
      SELECT f.*, u.username, u.email, u.created_at as user_created_at
      FROM friendships f
      LEFT JOIN users u ON f.friend_id = u.id
      WHERE f.user_id = ? AND f.status = 'pending'
      ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
    `).all(userId) as (Friendship & { username: string; email: string; user_created_at: string })[];

    // Transform incoming requests
    const incomingRequests = incomingRaw.map(f => ({
      id: f.id,
      user_id: f.user_id,
      friend_id: f.friend_id,
      status: f.status,
      created_at: f.created_at,
      updated_at: f.updated_at,
      friend: {
        id: f.user_id,
        username: f.username,
        email: f.email,
        created_at: f.user_created_at
      }
    }));

    // Transform outgoing requests
    const outgoingRequests = outgoingRaw.map(f => ({
      id: f.id,
      user_id: f.user_id,
      friend_id: f.friend_id,
      status: f.status,
      created_at: f.created_at,
      updated_at: f.updated_at,
      friend: {
        id: f.friend_id,
        username: f.username,
        email: f.email,
        created_at: f.user_created_at
      }
    }));

    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        incoming: incomingRequests,
        outgoing: outgoingRequests
      }
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get friend requests error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to fetch friend requests'
    });
  }
};
```

問題在 `Rating` 的 `readOnly` 邏輯。當已評分且未懸停時設為 `readOnly`，點擊不會改變值，`onChange` 不觸發，`newRating` 不更新。

修正：在 `fetchRestroom` 中當未評分時將 `newRating` 設為 0；不要直接讓 `Rating` 成為 `readOnly`，避免點擊無效。


```typescriptreact

          const userRatingData = response.data.ratings.find(
            (rating: any) => rating.user_id === user.id
          );
          if (userRatingData) {
            setUserRating(userRatingData.rating);
            setHasUserRated(true);
            setNewRating(userRatingData.rating);
          }
        }

->

          );

            setHasUserRated(true);
            setNewRating(userRatingData.rating);
          } else {

            setUserRating(0);
```


已修正評分系統。主要問題與修改：

問題
- `Rating` 在 `readOnly={hasUserRated && !isHovering}` 時無法點擊更改
- `isHovering` 狀態複雜化，常造成設定錯誤
- 當 `hasUserRated && !isHovering` 為 true 時顯示 `userRating`，與 `newRating` 不同步

修改
- 移除 `readOnly`，評分永遠可編輯
- 移除 `isHovering`，不再依賴 hover
- 統一以 `newRating` 表示當前的星數
- 未評分時將 `newRating` 設為 0
- 提交後將 `newRating` 更新為最新提交值

效果
- 點擊即可改動並提交評分
- 按鈕文字依據 `hasUserRated` 顯示為「提交評分」或「更新評分」
- 不再需要 hover 才能修改


前端編譯成功。

評分系統已修正，使用方式：
1. 點擊星號改變評分
2. 點擊「提交評分」送出
3. 之後可再調整並點擊「更新評分」儲存

已移除 hover 流程，現在評分可隨時編輯並提交。

資料還有圖片會不會不見

**Cursor**

檢查 `.gitignore` 是否忽略 `dist` 目錄：


檢查 `uploads` 目錄的內容：


## 回答

不影響運作，但有些需先處理：

### 1) 資料庫 (`database.sqlite`)
- 會上傳，其他人可用同一份資料

### 2) 圖片 (`uploads/`)
```1:93:.gitignore
# Uploads directory
uploads/
public/uploads/
```
- 目錄被忽略，上傳的圖片不會進入 repo；其他人需自行上傳或補檔案
- 不建議把 `uploads/` 改為上傳到 repo

### 3) 後端 `dist/`
```9:11:backend/.gitignore
# Build outputs
dist/
```
- 目錄被忽略
- 其他人可安裝後執行 `npm run build`，再 `npm start`

### 建議

#### 方案一：在 README 說明
```bash
# 後端首次啟動
cd backend
npm install
npm run build  # 建置 TypeScript
npm start      # 或 npm run dev

# 前端首次啟動
cd frontend
npm install
npm run build  # 建置前端
npm start      # 或 npm run dev
```

#### 方案二：包含 `dist/`（通常不建議）
- 要在版本控制中包含 `dist/`
- 需從 `.gitignore` 移除 `dist/` 並強制加入
- 可能導致衝突與合併複雜

### 總結
`dist/` 不上傳沒問題，其他人會自行建置。主要注意事項：
- 上傳的圖片會遺失；可放範例圖片，或讓使用者在本地生成
- 資料庫可上傳，所有人共用

```plaintext
# Uploads directory
uploads/
public/uploads/
```

```plaintext
# Build outputs
dist/
```

```shellscript
# 後端首次啟動
cd backend
npm install
npm run build  # 建置 TypeScript
npm start      # 或 npm run dev

# 前端首次啟動
cd frontend
npm install
npm run build  # 建置前端
npm start      # 或 npm run dev
```
